🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Israeli strikes in Gaza kill seven including senior security official

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 10:27:13 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The ‌Israeli military and the Shin ‌Bet domestic ​security service said in ⁠a joint statement they ‌had struck a senior Hamas member, without identifying ‌him, adding ​that further details would ⁠be provided later

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli airstrikes in Gaza on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) killed seven people including Hamas’s director of internal security, Palestinian officials and Israel said, despite a ceasefire in place since last year. Israel’s military said it “eliminated the terrorist Naim Muhammad Ashour Abu Nahal”, adding that he had been appointed to his post only two months ago but had been part of Hamas for a long time. “His elimination constitutes a blow to the apparatus’s management capabilities,” it said in a joint statement with Israel’s Shin Bet security agency. Israel’s caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defence Minister Israel Katz congratulated security forces, saying “no terrorist will escape the long arm” of their country. Mahmoud Bassal, spokesman for Gaza’s civil defence agency, which operates under Hamas authority, told AFP that several other people were in critical condition following the strike in Gaza City that killed Abu Nahal. The attack comes with talks underway in Israel to form a new government after October legislative elections produced no clear winner. Centrist Gadi Eisenkot is seeking to form a coalition to end Mr. Netanyahu’s long tenure. But Mr. Netanyahu, who has staked his reputation on ensuring security for Israel after the Hamas attack of October 7, 2023, remains in charge of military operations while negotiations continue. Mr. Bassal said earlier on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that three people, including a 17-year-old, had been killed in a separate Israeli airstrike near Gaza City.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Three more were also killed in a third strike on a police station in the Al-Mawasi area in southern Gaza, he added.

articles.title: Indian space companies sign largest-of-its-kind deal on satellite systems
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Bellatrix Aerospace to supply in-space propulsion systems for GalaxEye’s 30 satellites

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Indian space companies GalaxEye and Bellatrix Aerospace on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) signed a multi-year contract in which Bellatrix Aerospace will supply in-space propulsion systems for the next 30 satellites GalaxEye is building. This made the deal the “largest business-to-business order” one Indian private space company has placed with another since the space sector opened to private players in 2020, a press release noted. While private companies have participated in India’s space sector since inception, it has usually been as suppliers to the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). The GalaxEye-Bellatrix deal was unveiled at the 5th India International Space Conclave, organised by the Indian Space Association (ISpA). The financial details of the contract were not disclosed. GalaxEye is building the world’s first OptoSAR satellite constellation. OptoSAR is a proprietary imaging technology that allows customers to see any place on Earth through clouds, smoke, and darkness. Bellatrix builds the thrusters that steer and position satellites once they reach orbit, with hardware already flight-tested on ISRO missions. “OptoSAR satellites are demanding customers. They need precise, repeatable orbits across a whole constellation, not a single demonstration. Our thrusters have already fired in orbit on ISRO missions, and we have built the production lines to deliver that same performance at constellation scale,” Rohan M. Ganapathy, co-founder and CEO of Bellatrix Aerospace, said in a statement. Bellatrix makes electric and green propulsion systems for satellites and orbital transfer vehicles. Mission Drishti, launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 on May 3, 2026, became the world’s first OptoSAR satellite in orbit. It validated GalaxEye’s spacecraft deployment, attitude control, onboard computing and in-house mission operations before contact was lost after a geomagnetic storm, the company stated. In September, the Department of Science and Technology’s Technology Development Board committed ₹63.84 crore from the Government of India’s Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund for GalaxEye’s next multi-sensor satellite, which targets imagery sharper than 0.5 metres. Sourcing propulsion from a partner in the same city gives GalaxEye closer engineering control and shorter lead times as it builds that satellite. “Drishti taught us that every critical system on a satellite has to be one we can see, test and improve up close,” Suyash Singh, co-founder and CEO of GalaxEye, said in a statement. ISRO chairman V. Narayanan said that private industry was now indispensable to India’s space ecosystem. “Today, we are extremely happy that 440 start-up companies are working in the space area. Whenever a launch vehicle lifts off or we place a satellite, 70-80% of the budget is pumped into the Indian industry. Without the support of Indian industry, we would not have reached the present level.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Other officials, however, pointed out while India was putting in place a system to increase capacity, it had to work towards increasing demand for products from the private space ecosystem. “The first phase of India’s space reforms opened the sector and created an institutional framework for private participation. Now India has to work on generating heavy demand. I have less concern about capacity being created; I see a bigger need for demand to be created. The second is to have enough money coming into the sector, and number three, to have procedures at all levels. Space is not a sector that is going to give you a payback in six months or nine months. Perseverance is required, and the government must continue to have policy stability,” said Pawan Goenka, chairman, InSpace, India’s single-window regulatory and promotional body for the private space sector.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — एक प्रेस विज्ञप्ति में कहा गया है कि 2020 में अंतरिक्ष क्षेत्र को निजी खिलाड़ियों के लिए खोलने के बाद से यह सौदा एक भारतीय निजी अंतरिक्ष कंपनी द्वारा दूसरे के साथ किया गया "सबसे बड़ा बिजनेस-टू-बिजनेस ऑर्डर" बन गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: While private companies have participated in India’s space sector since inception, it has usually been as suppliers to the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — जबकि निजी कंपनियों ने शुरुआत से ही भारत के अंतरिक्ष क्षेत्र में भाग लिया है, यह आमतौर पर भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (इसरो) के आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के रूप में रही है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The GalaxEye-Bellatrix deal was unveiled at the 5th India International Space Conclave, organised by the Indian Space Association (ISpA).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — भारतीय अंतरिक्ष संघ (आईएसपीए) द्वारा आयोजित 5वें भारत अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अंतरिक्ष कॉन्क्लेव में गैलेक्सआई-बेलाट्रिक्स सौदे का अनावरण किया गया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The financial details of the contract were not disclosed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अनुबंध के वित्तीय विवरण का खुलासा नहीं किया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: GalaxEye is building the world’s first OptoSAR satellite constellation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — गैलेक्सआई दुनिया का पहला ऑप्टोएसएआर उपग्रह समूह बना रहा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constellation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Constellation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: OptoSAR is a proprietary imaging technology that allows customers to see any place on Earth through clouds, smoke, and darkness.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — OptoSAR एक मालिकाना इमेजिंग तकनीक है जो ग्राहकों को बादलों, धुएं और अंधेरे के माध्यम से पृथ्वी पर किसी भी स्थान को देखने की अनुमति देती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Bellatrix builds the thrusters that steer and position satellites once they reach orbit, with hardware already flight-tested on ISRO missions.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — बेलाट्रिक्स ऐसे थ्रस्टर्स का निर्माण करता है जो कक्षा में पहुंचने के बाद उपग्रहों को संचालित करते हैं और उनकी स्थिति निर्धारित करते हैं, हार्डवेयर का इसरो मिशनों में पहले ही उड़ान-परीक्षण किया जा चुका है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “OptoSAR satellites are demanding customers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “ऑप्टोएसएआर उपग्रह ग्राहकों की मांग कर रहे हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: They need precise, repeatable orbits across a whole constellation, not a single demonstration.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्हें पूरे तारामंडल में सटीक, दोहराने योग्य कक्षाओं की आवश्यकता है, एक भी प्रदर्शन की नहीं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constellation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Constellation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Our thrusters have already fired in orbit on ISRO missions, and we have built the production lines to deliver that same performance at constellation scale,” Rohan M.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हमारे थ्रस्टर्स पहले ही इसरो मिशनों पर कक्षा में फायर कर चुके हैं, और हमने तारामंडल पैमाने पर वही प्रदर्शन देने के लिए उत्पादन लाइनें बनाई हैं, ”रोहन एम।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constellation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Constellation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Ganapathy, co-founder and CEO of Bellatrix Aerospace, said in a statement.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — बेलाट्रिक्स एयरोस्पेस के सह-संस्थापक और सीईओ गणपति ने एक बयान में कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Bellatrix makes electric and green propulsion systems for satellites and orbital transfer vehicles.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — बेलाट्रिक्स उपग्रहों और कक्षीय स्थानांतरण वाहनों के लिए विद्युत और हरित प्रणोदन प्रणाली बनाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Mission Drishti, launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 on May 3, 2026, became the world’s first OptoSAR satellite in orbit.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 3 मई, 2026 को स्पेसएक्स फाल्कन 9 पर लॉन्च किया गया मिशन दृष्टि, कक्षा में दुनिया का पहला ऑप्टोसार उपग्रह बन गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: It validated GalaxEye’s spacecraft deployment, attitude control, onboard computing and in-house mission operations before contact was lost after a geomagnetic storm, the company stated.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — कंपनी ने कहा कि भू-चुंबकीय तूफान के बाद संपर्क टूटने से पहले इसने गैलेक्सआई के अंतरिक्ष यान की तैनाती, रवैया नियंत्रण, ऑनबोर्ड कंप्यूटिंग और इन-हाउस मिशन संचालन को मान्य किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: In September, the Department of Science and Technology’s Technology Development Board committed ₹63.84 crore from the Government of India’s Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund for GalaxEye’s next multi-sensor satellite, which targets imagery sharper than 0.5 metres.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सितंबर में, विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी विभाग के प्रौद्योगिकी विकास बोर्ड ने गैलेक्सआई के अगले मल्टी-सेंसर उपग्रह के लिए भारत सरकार के अनुसंधान, विकास और नवाचार (आरडीआई) फंड से ₹63.84 करोड़ का योगदान दिया, जो 0.5 मीटर से अधिक तेज इमेजरी को लक्षित करता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Sourcing propulsion from a partner in the same city gives GalaxEye closer engineering control and shorter lead times as it builds that satellite.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उसी शहर में एक भागीदार से प्रणोदन प्राप्त करने से गैलेक्सआई को करीबी इंजीनियरिंग नियंत्रण और उस उपग्रह के निर्माण में कम समय लगता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Drishti taught us that every critical system on a satellite has to be one we can see, test and improve up close,” Suyash Singh, co-founder and CEO of GalaxEye, said in a statement.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — गैलेक्सआई के सह-संस्थापक और सीईओ सुयश सिंह ने एक बयान में कहा, "दृष्टि ने हमें सिखाया कि उपग्रह पर प्रत्येक महत्वपूर्ण प्रणाली ऐसी होनी चाहिए जिसे हम करीब से देख सकें, परीक्षण कर सकें और सुधार सकें।"।

hinglishTracks.en: ISRO chairman V.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसरो अध्यक्ष वी.।

hinglishTracks.en: Narayanan said that private industry was now indispensable to India’s space ecosystem.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नारायणन ने कहा कि निजी उद्योग अब भारत के अंतरिक्ष पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र के लिए अपरिहार्य है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Today, we are extremely happy that 440 start-up companies are working in the space area.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “आज, हमें बेहद खुशी है कि 440 स्टार्ट-अप कंपनियां अंतरिक्ष क्षेत्र में काम कर रही हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Whenever a launch vehicle lifts off or we place a satellite, 70-80% of the budget is pumped into the Indian industry.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जब भी कोई प्रक्षेपण यान उड़ान भरता है या हम उपग्रह स्थापित करते हैं, तो बजट का 70-80% भारतीय उद्योग में डाला जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Without the support of Indian industry, we would not have reached the present level.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — भारतीय उद्योग के समर्थन के बिना, हम वर्तमान स्तर तक नहीं पहुंच पाते।।

hinglishTracks.en: Other officials, however, pointed out while India was putting in place a system to increase capacity, it had to work towards increasing demand for products from the private space ecosystem.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हालाँकि, अन्य अधिकारियों ने बताया कि जब भारत क्षमता बढ़ाने के लिए एक प्रणाली स्थापित कर रहा था, तो उसे निजी अंतरिक्ष पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र से उत्पादों की मांग बढ़ाने की दिशा में काम करना था।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The first phase of India’s space reforms opened the sector and created an institutional framework for private participation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — “भारत के अंतरिक्ष सुधारों के पहले चरण ने इस क्षेत्र को खोला और निजी भागीदारी के लिए एक संस्थागत ढांचा तैयार किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: Now India has to work on generating heavy demand.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अब भारत को भारी मांग पैदा करने पर काम करना होगा.।

hinglishTracks.en: I have less concern about capacity being created; I see a bigger need for demand to be created.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — मुझे क्षमता निर्माण के बारे में कम चिंता है; मैं मांग पैदा करने की एक बड़ी आवश्यकता देखता हूं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The second is to have enough money coming into the sector, and number three, to have procedures at all levels.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — दूसरा, क्षेत्र में पर्याप्त पैसा आना और तीसरा, सभी स्तरों पर प्रक्रियाएं होना।।

hinglishTracks.en: Space is not a sector that is going to give you a payback in six months or nine months.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अंतरिक्ष कोई ऐसा क्षेत्र नहीं है जो आपको छह महीने या नौ महीने में भुगतान कर देगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Perseverance is required, and the government must continue to have policy stability,” said Pawan Goenka, chairman, InSpace, India’s single-window regulatory and promotional body for the private space sector.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — दृढ़ता की आवश्यकता है, और सरकार को नीतिगत स्थिरता जारी रखनी चाहिए, ”निजी अंतरिक्ष क्षेत्र के लिए भारत की एकल-खिड़की नियामक और प्रचार संस्था, इनस्पेस के अध्यक्ष, पवन गोयनका ने कहा।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Indian space companies sign largest-of-its-kind deal on satellite systems

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 09:27:58 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Bellatrix Aerospace to supply in-space propulsion systems for GalaxEye’s 30 satellites

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Indian space companies GalaxEye and Bellatrix Aerospace on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) signed a multi-year contract in which Bellatrix Aerospace will supply in-space propulsion systems for the next 30 satellites GalaxEye is building. This made the deal the “largest business-to-business order” one Indian private space company has placed with another since the space sector opened to private players in 2020, a press release noted. While private companies have participated in India’s space sector since inception, it has usually been as suppliers to the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). The GalaxEye-Bellatrix deal was unveiled at the 5th India International Space Conclave, organised by the Indian Space Association (ISpA). The financial details of the contract were not disclosed. GalaxEye is building the world’s first OptoSAR satellite constellation. OptoSAR is a proprietary imaging technology that allows customers to see any place on Earth through clouds, smoke, and darkness. Bellatrix builds the thrusters that steer and position satellites once they reach orbit, with hardware already flight-tested on ISRO missions. “OptoSAR satellites are demanding customers. They need precise, repeatable orbits across a whole constellation, not a single demonstration. Our thrusters have already fired in orbit on ISRO missions, and we have built the production lines to deliver that same performance at constellation scale,” Rohan M. Ganapathy, co-founder and CEO of Bellatrix Aerospace, said in a statement. Bellatrix makes electric and green propulsion systems for satellites and orbital transfer vehicles. articles.title: What do lemurs and opera singers share?
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Recently, a study showed how indri lemurs use the same method opera singers use to ensure their vocals reach the audience at the back. In conversation with one of the researchers, Dr Chiara De Gregorio from the University of Warwick

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Have you seen opera performers sing? You might notice how their mouths move according to how high their pitch needs to be. Imagine finding out a primate in the rainforests of Madagascar has been doing the same, possibly even before opera began? With a pointy snout, large eyes and usually a long tail, you might have encountered this primate in one of your favourite movies, Madagascar. Remember King Julien, who loved to sing and dance? He was a type of lemur! So were Maurice and Mort, the two characters always around him. Endemic (naturally found only in) to the island of Madagascar, lemurs are primates with diverse activity patterns, and even though they share a resemblance with other primates, they evolved independently from monkeys, apes, etc. They are considered to be the world’s most endangered mammals by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN). This is mostly due to habitat loss, hunting and even unstable conservation efforts due to political and financial instabilities. While most lemurs might survive in captivity, there are specific species like the indri which can only survive in their natural habitat, making it extremely important for us to protect the forests and their home. Today, let’s talk about this very species — the indri or babakoto! One of the larger lemur species, the indri is the only singing lemur in the world. | Photo Credit: Special arrangement One of the larger lemur species, the indri is the only singing lemur in the world. These black-and-white-coated primates are known for their loud, often complex, and haunting territorial songs. They often sing as duets or group choruses and even use opera-like vocal techniques to reach higher pitches. This was, in fact, a quite recent discovery. Researchers from the University of Warwick and the University of Turin found that the world’s only singing lemur opens its mouth wider on higher notes, just like a trained soprano. The new study, published in PLOS Computational Biology , shows the first direct evidence that wild indris coordinate their mouth opening with the frequency of their songs. The research team analysed 83 video recordings of 19 wild indris, combining field audio with markerless motion-tracking technology. | Photo Credit: Special arrangement “The opera singers back in the day, before mics became a thing, used to tweak the shape of their mouth to sing louder and to reach farther to the audience sitting at the back. Imagine finding the same technique being used in the middle of a rainforest in Madagascar,” laughed Dr Chiara De Gregorio, corresponding author and Honorary Research Fellow at the University of Warwick.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Human singers are trained to widen their mouths as pitch rises, aligning the resonant frequencies of the vocal tract with the harmonics of the voice and amplifying the sound. For an animal communicating through a thick forest, it could make the difference between a song that carries and one that doesn’t.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 What do lemurs and opera singers share?

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 05:46:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Recently, a study showed how indri lemurs use the same method opera singers use to ensure their vocals reach the audience at the back. In conversation with one of the researchers, Dr Chiara De Gregorio from the University of Warwick

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Have you seen opera performers sing? You might notice how their mouths move according to how high their pitch needs to be. Imagine finding out a primate in the rainforests of Madagascar has been doing the same, possibly even before opera began? With a pointy snout, large eyes and usually a long tail, you might have encountered this primate in one of your favourite movies, Madagascar. Remember King Julien, who loved to sing and dance? He was a type of lemur! So were Maurice and Mort, the two characters always around him. Endemic (naturally found only in) to the island of Madagascar, lemurs are primates with diverse activity patterns, and even though they share a resemblance with other primates, they evolved independently from monkeys, apes, etc. They are considered to be the world’s most endangered mammals by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN). This is mostly due to habitat loss, hunting and even unstable conservation efforts due to political and financial instabilities. While most lemurs might survive in captivity, there are specific species like the indri which can only survive in their natural habitat, making it extremely important for us to protect the forests and their home. Today, let’s talk about this very species — the indri or babakoto! One of the larger lemur species, the indri is the only singing lemur in the world. | Photo Credit: Special arrangement One of the larger lemur species, the indri is the only singing lemur in the world. These black-and-white-coated primates are known for their loud, often complex, and haunting territorial songs. They often sing as duets or group choruses and even use opera-like vocal techniques to reach higher pitches. This was, in fact, a quite recent discovery. Researchers from the University of Warwick and the University of Turin found that the world’s only singing lemur opens its mouth wider on higher notes, just like a trained soprano. The new study, published in PLOS Computational Biology , shows the first direct evidence that wild indris coordinate their mouth opening with the frequency of their songs. The research team analysed 83 video recordings of 19 wild indris, combining field audio with markerless motion-tracking technology. | Photo Credit: Special arrangement “The opera singers back in the day, before mics became a thing, used to tweak the shape of their mouth to sing louder and to reach farther to the audience sitting at the back. Imagine finding the same technique being used in the middle of a rainforest in Madagascar,” laughed Dr Chiara De Gregorio, corresponding author and Honorary Research Fellow at the University of Warwick.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Human singers are trained to widen their mouths as pitch rises, aligning the resonant frequencies of the vocal tract with the harmonics of the voice and amplifying the sound. For an animal communicating through a thick forest, it could make the difference between a song that carries and one that doesn’t.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
International (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Computational (Adjective)
कम्प्यूटेशनल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Computational' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Conversation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Conversation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Conservation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Conservation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "What do lemurs and opera singers share?", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Recently, a study showed how indri lemurs use the same method opera singers use to ensure their vocals reach the audience at the back.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'What do lemurs and opera singers share?' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'What do lemurs and opera singers share?' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'What do lemurs and opera singers share?' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Recently, a study showed how indri lemurs use the same method opera singers use to ensure their vocals reach the audience at the back." (Hinglish Arth: हाल ही में, एक अध्ययन से पता चला है कि इंद्री लेमर्स उसी पद्धति का उपयोग करते हैं जो ओपेरा गायक यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए करते हैं कि उनकी आवाज़ पीछे बैठे दर्शकों तक पहुंचे।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "What do lemurs and opera singers share?"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. For an animal communicating through a thick forest, it could make the difference between a song that carries and one that doesn’t.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "For an animal communicating through a thick forest, it could make the difference between a song that carries and one that doesn’t." (Hinglish Arth: घने जंगल में संचार करने वाले एक जानवर के लिए, यह उस गीत के बीच अंतर कर सकता है जो प्रसारित होता है और जो नहीं करता है।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had resigned due to an alleged Chinese spy scandal on November 12, 2026.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Jensen Huang, co-founder of Nvidia, who had stepped down as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the chipmaker, was re-instated in the top job on November 23, 2026. Mr Huang had resigned due to an alleged Chinese spy scandal on November 12, and CFO Colette Kress was appointed as interim CEO. The board voted unanimously to bring Mr Huang back as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately, after a series of meetings left directors satisfied with his “candor and ability to lead”, Nvidia said in a statement. Huang’s return has put the spotlight on the ouster and return of other top bosses. Here’s a look at some of the major names. Former Twitter CEO Jack Dorsey | Photo Credit: Sandeep Saxena

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The return of Mr Jensen Huang at the helm of Nvidia is unique, as reports suggest that senior U.S. government officials left the company’s board confident that he posed no national security risk amid concerns of China vying for the company’s advanced chips. U.S. President Donald Trump also welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision.” I believe my ​intervention was very important to get Jensen Huang back,” Mr Trump told CNBC after Mr Huang’s reinstatement, marking an unprecedented intervention by U.S. government officials into the matters of a publicly traded company.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO: 6 CEOs who reclaimed their top positions

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 04:34:01 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had resigned due to an alleged Chinese spy scandal on November 12, 2026.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Jensen Huang, co-founder of Nvidia, who had stepped down as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the chipmaker, was re-instated in the top job on November 23, 2026. Mr Huang had resigned due to an alleged Chinese spy scandal on November 12, and CFO Colette Kress was appointed as interim CEO. The board voted unanimously to bring Mr Huang back as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately, after a series of meetings left directors satisfied with his “candor and ability to lead”, Nvidia said in a statement. Huang’s return has put the spotlight on the ouster and return of other top bosses. Here’s a look at some of the major names. Former Twitter CEO Jack Dorsey | Photo Credit: Sandeep Saxena

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The return of Mr Jensen Huang at the helm of Nvidia is unique, as reports suggest that senior U.S. government officials left the company’s board confident that he posed no national security risk amid concerns of China vying for the company’s advanced chips. U.S. President Donald Trump also welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision.” I believe my ​intervention was very important to get Jensen Huang back,” Mr Trump told CNBC after Mr Huang’s reinstatement, marking an unprecedented intervention by U.S. government officials into the matters of a publicly traded company.

articles.title: Webinar on autoimmune conditions to be held on November 28
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The webinar will examine how autoimmune conditions develop, their common symptoms, the challenges in diagnosis, and current approaches to treatment and long-term management

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Hindu will conduct a free health webinar on Saturday, November 28, 2026, on the topic ‘Understanding Autoimmune Conditions’. The webinar will be held from 11.30 a.m. to 12.30 p.m. Autoimmune conditions occur when the immune system mistakenly attacks the body’s own tissues and organs. These disorders can affect different parts of the body, including the joints, skin, nervous system and other organs, and may present with a wide range of symptoms. The session will explore how autoimmune conditions develop, the role of the immune system, and the common signs and symptoms associated with these disorders. It will also discuss early warning signs, including persistent fatigue, joint pain, muscle weakness and neurological symptoms, and explain when these warrant medical attention. The discussion will examine the challenges involved in diagnosing autoimmune conditions, the role of clinical evaluation and diagnostic tests, and the treatment options available. The panellists will also discuss long-term disease management, monitoring, and the importance of timely diagnosis and appropriate treatment. Expert panellists include Aishwarya G., Consultant Rheumatologist and Clinical Immunologist, Apollo Speciality Hospitals, Chennai. She will discuss the immune mechanisms underlying autoimmune conditions, common rheumatological disorders, their symptoms, diagnostic approaches and current treatment options. The panel will also feature Prabash Prabhakaran, Director and Senior Consultant – Neurology, SIMS Hospital, Vadapalani, Chennai. He will discuss autoimmune conditions affecting the nervous system, the neurological symptoms they can cause, approaches to diagnosis and treatment, and the importance of recognising neurological manifestations. The session will be moderated by Zubeda Hamid, Senior Assistant Editor, The Hindu .

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The webinar will examine how autoimmune conditions develop, their common symptoms, the challenges in diagnosis, and current approaches to treatment and long-term management
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Hindu will conduct a free health webinar on Saturday, November 28, 2026, on the topic ‘Understanding Autoimmune Conditions’. The webinar will be held from 11.30 a.m. to 12.30 p.m. Autoimmune conditions occur when the immune system mistakenly attacks the body’s own tissues and organs. These disorders can affect different parts of the body, including the joints, skin, nervous system and other organs, and may present with a wide range of symptoms. The session will explore how autoimmune conditions develop, the role of the immune system, and the common signs and symptoms associated with these disorders. It will also discuss early warning signs, including persistent fatigue, joint pain, muscle weakness and neurological symptoms, and explain when these warrant medical attention. The discussion will examine the challenges involved in diagnosing autoimmune conditions, the role of clinical evaluation and diagnostic tests, and the treatment options available. The panellists will also discuss long-term disease management, monitoring, and the importance of timely diagnosis and appropriate treatment. Expert panellists include Aishwarya G., Consultant Rheumatologist and Clinical Immunologist, Apollo Speciality Hospitals, Chennai. She will discuss the immune mechanisms underlying autoimmune conditions, common rheumatological disorders, their symptoms, diagnostic approaches and current treatment options. The panel will also feature Prabash Prabhakaran, Director and Senior Consultant – Neurology, SIMS Hospital, Vadapalani, Chennai. He will discuss autoimmune conditions affecting the nervous system, the neurological symptoms they can cause, approaches to diagnosis and treatment, and the importance of recognising neurological manifestations. The session will be moderated by Zubeda Hamid, Senior Assistant Editor, The Hindu .
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: To register, click here or scan the QR code given below.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In August, for the first time, Namma Metro had successfully facilitated the transportation of an organ

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: After a successful organ transport in August for the first time, Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL) has once again facilitated the movement of a human organ. On September 11, a live human heart arranged by Sparsh Hospital was transported via Namma Metro from Yeshwanthpur station to South End Circle station en route to Apollo Hospital. According to BMRCL, the transport operation commenced at 11.01 p.m. and concluded at 11.21 p.m. covering seven stations in just 20 minutes. The BMRCL stated that the heart was carried inside Train ID 12, Train Set 29, accompanied by the hospital’s medical team. To ensure smooth movement, the Assistant Security Officer coordinated with the Sparsh team and metro security personnel, making special arrangements to avoid delays and provide a safe corridor for the critical transfer. Bengaluru Metro facilitates transportation of donor heart from Goraguntepalya to Bommasandra A live human heart arranged by Sparsh Hospital was transported via Namma Metro from Yeshwanthpur station to South End Circle station en route to Apollo Hospital on September 11, 2025. The organ was accompanied by the hospital’s medical team. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement In August, for the first time, Namma Metro had successfully facilitated the transportation of an organ. A donated human liver, meant for transplantation, was transported from Vydehi Hospital at Whitefield to Sparsh Hospital at R.R. Nagar. The operation was executed using a combination of ambulance and metro, significantly reducing travel time during peak traffic hours. After its first organ transport in August, #Bengaluru 's Namma Metro again facilitated an organ transport on Sept 11. A live human heart was moved from Yeshwanthpur to South End Circle in just 20 minutes for a transplant at Apollo Hospital. @the_hindu @THBengaluru pic.twitter.com/g3ZrWNMZ7M
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Bengaluru / public transport / health / medical service

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Bengaluru metro facilitates organ transport for second time

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 04:16:45 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In August, for the first time, Namma Metro had successfully facilitated the transportation of an organ

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: After a successful organ transport in August for the first time, Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL) has once again facilitated the movement of a human organ. On September 11, a live human heart arranged by Sparsh Hospital was transported via Namma Metro from Yeshwanthpur station to South End Circle station en route to Apollo Hospital. According to BMRCL, the transport operation commenced at 11.01 p.m. and concluded at 11.21 p.m. covering seven stations in just 20 minutes. The BMRCL stated that the heart was carried inside Train ID 12, Train Set 29, accompanied by the hospital’s medical team. To ensure smooth movement, the Assistant Security Officer coordinated with the Sparsh team and metro security personnel, making special arrangements to avoid delays and provide a safe corridor for the critical transfer. Bengaluru Metro facilitates transportation of donor heart from Goraguntepalya to Bommasandra A live human heart arranged by Sparsh Hospital was transported via Namma Metro from Yeshwanthpur station to South End Circle station en route to Apollo Hospital on September 11, 2025. The organ was accompanied by the hospital’s medical team. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement In August, for the first time, Namma Metro had successfully facilitated the transportation of an organ. A donated human liver, meant for transplantation, was transported from Vydehi Hospital at Whitefield to Sparsh Hospital at R.R. Nagar. The operation was executed using a combination of ambulance and metro, significantly reducing travel time during peak traffic hours. After its first organ transport in August, #Bengaluru 's Namma Metro again facilitated an organ transport on Sept 11. A live human heart was moved from Yeshwanthpur to South End Circle in just 20 minutes for a transplant at Apollo Hospital. @the_hindu @THBengaluru pic.twitter.com/g3ZrWNMZ7M

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Bengaluru / public transport / health / medical service

articles.title: Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnataka
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Karnataka needs a coherent policy on urban mobility

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While Karnataka has spent years disputing motorcycle owners’ right to carry paying passengers, Bengaluru — with the dubious distinction of having one of the world’s highest travel times per unit distance — struggles with inadequate public transport capacity and lacklustre intermediate options. The Supreme Court ruling on November 20 to dismiss Karnataka’s appeal was thus straightforward, allowing motorcycles to be registered as transport vehicles. The State has often called bike taxis unsafe, yet has not improved the prospects of safer options. Earlier this year, the Centre for Science and Environment estimated the number of buses in urban centres nationwide to be 70% short of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs benchmark and that 400 cities with populations between a lakh and 10 lakh altogether lacked organised bus services. In March, the BMTC reported a fleet of around 7,000 buses in Bengaluru, versus the 13,000 by 2025 envisaged by the Comprehensive Mobility Plan. Expanding the number of Metro stations also creates more demand for travel to and from stations, but the operating costs of the public transport corporation expected to serve that demand are not covered by the resulting increase in rail ridership. Overall, Karnataka has struggled to set up a consistent transport policy. An expert committee recommended against bike taxis in Bengaluru for first- and last-mile connectivity and in favour of better walking infrastructure and bicycle rentals in 2019, only for the State to launch the electric bike-taxi scheme in 2021, then rescind it in 2024 over safety concerns and drivers’ disputes. The market for short booked journeys is also dysfunctional. But while allowing bike taxis could temper autorickshaw fares, the State must investigate drivers’ operating costs, the difference between the paid and the received amounts, and prevent large platforms from exploiting the market. Finally, while the Union Road Transport Ministry has reported that 46.2% of all road deaths involved two-wheeler users, two-wheelers’ safety relative to autorickshaws and cabs, by the number and distance of journeys, is unclear. The State should require aggregators to report injuries and fatalities and investigate the consequences of drivers’ earnings being linked to the number of trips undertaken. The Union government’s 2025 Motor Vehicle Aggregator Guidelines already address passenger security, fares, and insurance while allowing States to authorise privately registered motorcycles through aggregators. Karnataka should exercise this additional power. A large national programme is required to address funding for public transport, which is necessary even when it is not immediately profitable.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka / scooters and motorbikes / public transport / court / population / urban planning / Bengaluru Metro / Electric vehicles / road accident / road transport / insurance

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #2 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnataka

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 12:02:31 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Karnataka needs a coherent policy on urban mobility

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While Karnataka has spent years disputing motorcycle owners’ right to carry paying passengers, Bengaluru — with the dubious distinction of having one of the world’s highest travel times per unit distance — struggles with inadequate public transport capacity and lacklustre intermediate options. The Supreme Court ruling on November 20 to dismiss Karnataka’s appeal was thus straightforward, allowing motorcycles to be registered as transport vehicles. The State has often called bike taxis unsafe, yet has not improved the prospects of safer options. Earlier this year, the Centre for Science and Environment estimated the number of buses in urban centres nationwide to be 70% short of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs benchmark and that 400 cities with populations between a lakh and 10 lakh altogether lacked organised bus services. In March, the BMTC reported a fleet of around 7,000 buses in Bengaluru, versus the 13,000 by 2025 envisaged by the Comprehensive Mobility Plan. Expanding the number of Metro stations also creates more demand for travel to and from stations, but the operating costs of the public transport corporation expected to serve that demand are not covered by the resulting increase in rail ridership. Overall, Karnataka has struggled to set up a consistent transport policy. An expert committee recommended against bike taxis in Bengaluru for first- and last-mile connectivity and in favour of better walking infrastructure and bicycle rentals in 2019, only for the State to launch the electric bike-taxi scheme in 2021, then rescind it in 2024 over safety concerns and drivers’ disputes. The market for short booked journeys is also dysfunctional. But while allowing bike taxis could temper autorickshaw fares, the State must investigate drivers’ operating costs, the difference between the paid and the received amounts, and prevent large platforms from exploiting the market. Finally, while the Union Road Transport Ministry has reported that 46.2% of all road deaths involved two-wheeler users, two-wheelers’ safety relative to autorickshaws and cabs, by the number and distance of journeys, is unclear. The State should require aggregators to report injuries and fatalities and investigate the consequences of drivers’ earnings being linked to the number of trips undertaken. The Union government’s 2025 Motor Vehicle Aggregator Guidelines already address passenger security, fares, and insurance while allowing States to authorise privately registered motorcycles through aggregators. Karnataka should exercise this additional power. A large national programme is required to address funding for public transport, which is necessary even when it is not immediately profitable.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka / scooters and motorbikes / public transport / court / population / urban planning / Bengaluru Metro / Electric vehicles / road accident / road transport / insurance

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnataka", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Karnataka needs a coherent policy on urban mobility.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnataka' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnata' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnata' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Karnataka needs a coherent policy on urban mobility." (Hinglish Arth: कर्नाटक को शहरी गतिशीलता पर एक सुसंगत नीति की आवश्यकता है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnataka"?

B. Karnataka / scooters and motorbikes / public transport / court / population / urban planning / Bengaluru Metro / Electric vehicles / road accident /...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Karnataka / scooters and motorbikes / public transport / court / population / urban planning / Bengaluru Metro / Electric vehicles / road accident /..." fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Kerala State Human Rights Commission (SHRC) has directed the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) to complete the installation of streetlights on the 17-Km-long, accident-prone Container Road.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Subsequently, the agency’s project director must report the matter to the Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB). The KSEB must take steps to provide power connection within two weeks, the Commission directed the agency’s executive engineer.

articles.title: Chennai Regional Passport Office notice led to CJP’s Saurav Das being stopped at Delhi airport
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Saurav Das was served the notice at 7.30 p.m. by email on November 23, hours before his flight; the government has not issued any statement on the reasons for stopping him at the Delhi airport

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Saurav Das, co-convenor of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), was stopped from boarding a flight to London at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGI) on Monday night (November 23, 2026) after failing to respond to a show-cause notice issued by the Regional Passport Office (RPO), Chennai, over alleged discrepancies between his passport and other identity documents, a senior government official told The Hindu . His passport was issued in 2019 and the notice was served at 7.30 p.m. by email on November 23, hours before he was to board the flight at 1 a.m. on November 24. The government has issued no official statement on the reasons for stopping him at the airport. According to the notice, the RPO, Chennai, said that it has received inputs about Mr. Das’ passport application dated August 8, 2019, stating that “particulars (place of birth) furnished in it are incorrect” and his passport dated August 21, 2019 was “obtained by material suppression of facts.” “You are hereby called upon to provide a suitable clarification with respect to your place of birth along with supporting documents within seven days. Failure to produce a satisfactory response or a lack of response may result in impounding of your passport under Section 10(3)(b) of the Passports Act, 1967. You are advised not to use this passport till submission of response,” the notice seen by The Hindu said. Mr. Das said he saw the email with a show-cause notice about “discrepancies” in his passport only after he was stopped at the immigration counter at the Delhi airport. “I have no issue in providing any explanation. But I only received a show-cause notice five hours prior to my flight scheduled at 1 a.m. I did not see it before I was stopped at the airport. It says they have received an input over mismatch in my data. Can a citizen be stopped from travelling on such an input without disclosing any details of it?” He questioned why no issue was flagged in the verification process when an Indian passport was issued to him in 2019. “I have travelled abroad twice since without being stopped. The issue is being raised this time because I am associated with the CJP movement. My place of birth, my parents are being dragged into this. But we are not scared of cheap tactics.” The notice followed a September 30 order by the Madras High Court , which acted on a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) petition seeking a probe by the Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) into the nationality of Mr. Das and sought to cancel his passport and Aadhaar card if he is not found to be an Indian. The First Division Bench of Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan also ordered notice to Mr. Das on the PIL petition filed by R. Ganesh Kumar, a businessman from Chennai. The official said that Mr. Das was asked to explain why his passport should not be impounded, as there is a mismatch in documents submitted to obtain his passport and Aadhaar. “There appears to be a mismatch regarding his date of birth, place of birth and name of father in various documents — Aadhaar, birth certificate and passport. He was asked by the RPO, Chennai to explain his stance but he did not, following which his passport was flagged and he was stopped by the immigration,” said the official.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Addressing a press conference in Delhi, Mr. Das said, “Let alone being stopped from going abroad, we have not been allowed to speak inside the country. We were stopped from going to Jantar Mantar and then Ramlila Maidan. When we took to online spaces, attempts to stop were made even there.”

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सौरव दास को शाम 7.30 बजे नोटिस दिया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: by email on November 23, hours before his flight; the government has not issued any statement on the reasons for stopping him at the Delhi airport
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उनकी उड़ान से कुछ घंटे पहले 23 नवंबर को ईमेल द्वारा; दिल्ली एयरपोर्ट पर उन्हें रोकने के कारणों पर सरकार ने कोई बयान जारी नहीं किया है।

hinglishTracks.en: Saurav Das, co-convenor of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), was stopped from boarding a flight to London at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGI) on Monday night (November 23, 2026) after failing to respond to a show-cause notice issued by the Regional Passport Office (RPO), Chennai, over alleged discrepancies between his passport and other identity documents, a senior government official told The Hindu .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — एक वरिष्ठ सरकारी अधिकारी ने द हिंदू को बताया कि कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (सीजेपी) के सह-संयोजक सौरव दास को उनके पासपोर्ट और अन्य पहचान दस्तावेजों के बीच कथित विसंगतियों पर क्षेत्रीय पासपोर्ट कार्यालय (आरपीओ), चेन्नई द्वारा जारी कारण बताओ नोटिस का जवाब देने में विफल रहने के बाद सोमवार रात (23 नवंबर, 2026) को दिल्ली के इंदिरा गांधी अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डे (आईजीआई) पर लंदन के लिए उड़ान भरने से रोक दिया गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: His passport was issued in 2019 and the notice was served at 7.30 p.m.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उनका पासपोर्ट 2019 में जारी किया गया था और नोटिस शाम 7.30 बजे दिया गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: by email on November 23, hours before he was to board the flight at 1 a.m.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 23 नवंबर को दोपहर 1 बजे उड़ान भरने से कुछ घंटे पहले ईमेल द्वारा।।

hinglishTracks.en: on November 24.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — 24 नवंबर को.।

hinglishTracks.en: The government has issued no official statement on the reasons for stopping him at the airport.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सरकार ने उन्हें हवाईअड्डे पर रोके जाने के कारणों पर कोई आधिकारिक बयान जारी नहीं किया है.।

hinglishTracks.en: According to the notice, the RPO, Chennai, said that it has received inputs about Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — नोटिस के मुताबिक, आरपीओ, चेन्नई ने कहा कि उसे श्री के बारे में इनपुट मिले हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Das’ passport application dated August 8, 2019, stating that “particulars (place of birth) furnished in it are incorrect” and his passport dated August 21, 2019 was “obtained by material suppression of facts.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — दास के 8 अगस्त, 2019 के पासपोर्ट आवेदन में कहा गया है कि "इसमें दिए गए विवरण (जन्म स्थान) गलत हैं" और उनका 21 अगस्त, 2019 का पासपोर्ट "तथ्यों को छिपाकर प्राप्त किया गया था।"। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Application' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Application' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: “You are hereby called upon to provide a suitable clarification with respect to your place of birth along with supporting documents within seven days.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “आपको सात दिनों के भीतर सहायक दस्तावेजों के साथ अपने जन्म स्थान के संबंध में उचित स्पष्टीकरण प्रदान करने के लिए कहा जाता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Clarification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Clarification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Failure to produce a satisfactory response or a lack of response may result in impounding of your passport under Section 10(3)(b) of the Passports Act, 1967.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — संतोषजनक उत्तर देने में विफलता या प्रतिक्रिया की कमी के परिणामस्वरूप पासपोर्ट अधिनियम, 1967 की धारा 10(3)(बी) के तहत आपका पासपोर्ट जब्त किया जा सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: You are advised not to use this passport till submission of response,” the notice seen by The Hindu said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आपको सलाह दी जाती है कि प्रतिक्रिया प्रस्तुत करने तक इस पासपोर्ट का उपयोग न करें, ”द हिंदू द्वारा देखे गए नोटिस में कहा गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Das said he saw the email with a show-cause notice about “discrepancies” in his passport only after he was stopped at the immigration counter at the Delhi airport.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — दास ने कहा कि दिल्ली हवाई अड्डे पर आव्रजन काउंटर पर रोके जाने के बाद ही उन्होंने अपने पासपोर्ट में "विसंगतियों" के बारे में कारण बताओ नोटिस वाला ईमेल देखा।।

hinglishTracks.en: “I have no issue in providing any explanation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — “मुझे कोई स्पष्टीकरण देने में कोई परेशानी नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: But I only received a show-cause notice five hours prior to my flight scheduled at 1 a.m.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लेकिन मुझे दोपहर 1 बजे निर्धारित मेरी उड़ान से केवल पांच घंटे पहले ही कारण बताओ नोटिस मिला।।

hinglishTracks.en: I did not see it before I was stopped at the airport.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हवाई अड्डे पर रोके जाने से पहले मैंने इसे नहीं देखा था।।

hinglishTracks.en: It says they have received an input over mismatch in my data.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इसमें कहा गया है कि उन्हें मेरे डेटा में बेमेल होने का इनपुट मिला है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Can a citizen be stopped from travelling on such an input without disclosing any details of it?”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — क्या किसी नागरिक को इस तरह के इनपुट पर बिना कोई विवरण बताए यात्रा करने से रोका जा सकता है?”।

hinglishTracks.en: He questioned why no issue was flagged in the verification process when an Indian passport was issued to him in 2019.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उन्होंने सवाल किया कि जब 2019 में उन्हें भारतीय पासपोर्ट जारी किया गया था तो सत्यापन प्रक्रिया में कोई मुद्दा क्यों नहीं उठाया गया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Verification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सत्यापन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Verification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: “I have travelled abroad twice since without being stopped.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “तब से मैंने बिना रुके दो बार विदेश यात्रा की है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The issue is being raised this time because I am associated with the CJP movement.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इस बार यह मुद्दा इसलिए उठाया जा रहा है क्योंकि मैं सीजेपी आंदोलन से जुड़ा हूं.।

hinglishTracks.en: My place of birth, my parents are being dragged into this.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इसमें मेरे जन्म स्थान, मेरे माता-पिता को घसीटा जा रहा है।'।

hinglishTracks.en: But we are not scared of cheap tactics.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लेकिन हम घटिया हथकंडों से नहीं डरते।”।

hinglishTracks.en: The notice followed a September 30 order by the Madras High Court , which acted on a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) petition seeking a probe by the Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) into the nationality of Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह नोटिस मद्रास उच्च न्यायालय के 30 सितंबर के आदेश का पालन करता है, जिसने श्री की राष्ट्रीयता की केंद्रीय गृह मंत्रालय (एमएचए) से जांच की मांग करने वाली एक जनहित याचिका (पीआईएल) याचिका पर कार्रवाई की थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Das and sought to cancel his passport and Aadhaar card if he is not found to be an Indian.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — दास से मांग की कि अगर वह भारतीय नहीं पाए गए तो उनका पासपोर्ट और आधार कार्ड रद्द कर दिया जाए।।

hinglishTracks.en: The First Division Bench of Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मुख्य न्यायाधीश सुश्रुत अरविंद धर्माधिकारी और न्यायमूर्ति जी की प्रथम खंडपीठ ने...।

hinglishTracks.en: Arul Murugan also ordered notice to Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अरुल मुरुगन ने भी श्रीमान को नोटिस देने का आदेश दिया.।

hinglishTracks.en: Das on the PIL petition filed by R.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — आर द्वारा दायर जनहित याचिका याचिका पर दास.।

hinglishTracks.en: Ganesh Kumar, a businessman from Chennai.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — गणेश कुमार, चेन्नई के एक व्यापारी।।

hinglishTracks.en: The official said that Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अधिकारी ने कहा कि श्री.।

hinglishTracks.en: Das was asked to explain why his passport should not be impounded, as there is a mismatch in documents submitted to obtain his passport and Aadhaar.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — दास से यह बताने के लिए कहा गया था कि उनका पासपोर्ट क्यों जब्त नहीं किया जाना चाहिए, क्योंकि उनके पासपोर्ट और आधार प्राप्त करने के लिए जमा किए गए दस्तावेजों में विसंगति है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “There appears to be a mismatch regarding his date of birth, place of birth and name of father in various documents — Aadhaar, birth certificate and passport.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “ऐसा प्रतीत होता है कि विभिन्न दस्तावेजों - आधार, जन्म प्रमाण पत्र और पासपोर्ट - में उनकी जन्मतिथि, जन्म स्थान और पिता के नाम में विसंगति है।।

hinglishTracks.en: He was asked by the RPO, Chennai to explain his stance but he did not, following which his passport was flagged and he was stopped by the immigration,” said the official.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — आरपीओ, चेन्नई द्वारा उनसे अपना रुख स्पष्ट करने के लिए कहा गया था, लेकिन उन्होंने ऐसा नहीं किया, जिसके बाद उनके पासपोर्ट को चिह्नित किया गया और उन्हें आव्रजन द्वारा रोक दिया गया, ”अधिकारी ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Addressing a press conference in Delhi, Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — दिल्ली में एक संवाददाता सम्मेलन को संबोधित करते हुए श्री...।

hinglishTracks.en: Das said, “Let alone being stopped from going abroad, we have not been allowed to speak inside the country.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — दास ने कहा, ''विदेश जाने से रोकना तो दूर, हमें देश के अंदर भी बोलने की इजाजत नहीं दी गई है.।

hinglishTracks.en: We were stopped from going to Jantar Mantar and then Ramlila Maidan.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हमें जंतर-मंतर और फिर रामलीला मैदान जाने से रोका गया.।

hinglishTracks.en: When we took to online spaces, attempts to stop were made even there.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जब हम ऑनलाइन स्थानों पर गए तो वहां भी रोकने की कोशिश की गई।”।

1. Core Context & Background: Saurav Das was served the notice at 7.30 p.m. by email on November 23, hours before his flight; the government has not issued any statement on the reasons for stopping him at the Delhi airport

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Saurav Das, co-convenor of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), was stopped from boarding a flight to London at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGI) on Monday night (November 23, 2026) after failing to respond to a show-cause notice issued by the Regional Passport Office (RPO), Chennai, over alleged discrepancies between his passport and other identity documents, a senior government official told The Hindu . His passport was issued in 2019 and the notice was served at 7.30 p.m. by email on November 23, hours before he was to board the flight at 1 a.m. on November 24. The government has issued no official statement on the reasons for stopping him at the airport. According to the notice, the RPO, Chennai, said that it has received inputs about Mr. Das’ passport application dated August 8, 2019, stating that “particulars (place of birth) furnished in it are incorrect” and his passport dated August 21, 2019 was “obtained by material suppression of facts.” “You are hereby called upon to provide a suitable clarification with respect to your place of birth along with supporting documents within seven days. Failure to produce a satisfactory response or a lack of response may result in impounding of your passport under Section 10(3)(b) of the Passports Act, 1967. You are advised not to use this passport till submission of response,” the notice seen by The Hindu said. Mr. Das said he saw the email with a show-cause notice about “discrepancies” in his passport only after he was stopped at the immigration counter at the Delhi airport. “I have no issue in providing any explanation. But I only received a show-cause notice five hours prior to my flight scheduled at 1 a.m. I did not see it before I was stopped at the airport. It says they have received an input over mismatch in my data. Can a citizen be stopped from travelling on such an input without disclosing any details of it?” He questioned why no issue was flagged in the verification process when an Indian passport was issued to him in 2019. “I have travelled abroad twice since without being stopped. The issue is being raised this time because I am associated with the CJP movement. My place of birth, my parents are being dragged into this. But we are not scared of cheap tactics.” The notice followed a September 30 order by the Madras High Court , which acted on a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) petition seeking a probe by the Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) into the nationality of Mr. Das and sought to cancel his passport and Aadhaar card if he is not found to be an Indian. The First Division Bench of Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan also ordered notice to Mr. Das on the PIL petition filed by R. Ganesh Kumar, a businessman from Chennai. The official said that Mr. Das was asked to explain why his passport should not be impounded, as there is a mismatch in documents submitted to obtain his passport and Aadhaar. “There appears to be a mismatch regarding his date of birth, place of birth and name of father in various documents — Aadhaar, birth certificate and passport. articles.title: Karthigai deepam lit only at traditional spot atop Thirupparankundram hills
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Madurai Collector submitted before the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court that the administration was taking steps to comply with the Supreme Court order

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Defying the Supreme Court’s direction to allow, as a “limited one-time arrangement”, the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at the newly identified deepathoon on Thirupparankundram hillock, the ceremonial lamp was on Tuesday lit only at the traditional spot. Earlier in the day, the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court had recorded an undertaking by Madurai Collector Nishant Krishna that he will continue to act in strict compliance with the Supreme Court’s orders. The failure to fulfil this undertaking triggered massive protest by the leaders and cadres of the BJP and Hindu outfits at the foothills, while the ruling TVK’s allies, including the Left parties, the VCK, and the MDMK, hailed the government for sticking to tradition. “The Karthigai Mahadeepam has been lit in the Deepa Mandapam near the Uchchipillaiyar Temple located directly above the head of the presiding deity at Thirupparankundram,” Law Minister C.T.R. Nirmal Kumar said in a social media post. Shortly after the Deepam was lit, the Executive Officer of Arulmigu Subramaniya Swamy Temple, G. Selvi, and Board of Trustees Chairman V. Shanmugasundaram, in a joint press release, said the temple followed the age-old practice and agama rules in lighting the lamp. The Board of Trustees, including C. Rajapandian, K. Alagappan, K. Regina Devi, and K. Chitra, passed a resolution unanimously, resolving to follow the rituals and ensure the festival is conducted in a peaceful environment. The press release said the temple, known as the first abode of Lord Muruga (Arupadai Veedu), had been following the rituals from time immemorial. The temple, which has been conducting various festivals all through the year, adopted custom and rituals and age old continued practice as per the agama rules. In line with this, the Deepam was lit as per the old practice at the designated deepa mandapam atop the Uchipillayar temple and the light was lit at 6 p.m., the release said. The district administration, in a statement, said all arrangements were made as directed by the Supreme Court. The temple Devasthanam was requested, instructed in writing, and reminded to authorise its team and proceed. However, the Devasthanam did not authorise a team till the last moment. Instead, its Board of Trustees passed a resolution to light the lamp at the usual place, and the lamp was lit at the Deepa Mandapam, it added. Earlier, the police detained several senior leaders of the BJP, including State president Nainar Nagenthran, and Hindu outfits to prevent them from proceeding to Thirupparankundram.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Thousands of police personnel, deployed for security at the foothills, detained protesters and took them away. A section of the protesters damaged buses and other public property.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Karthigai deepam lit only at traditional spot atop Thirupparankundram hills

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:12:50 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Madurai Collector submitted before the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court that the administration was taking steps to comply with the Supreme Court order

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Defying the Supreme Court’s direction to allow, as a “limited one-time arrangement”, the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at the newly identified deepathoon on Thirupparankundram hillock, the ceremonial lamp was on Tuesday lit only at the traditional spot. Earlier in the day, the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court had recorded an undertaking by Madurai Collector Nishant Krishna that he will continue to act in strict compliance with the Supreme Court’s orders. The failure to fulfil this undertaking triggered massive protest by the leaders and cadres of the BJP and Hindu outfits at the foothills, while the ruling TVK’s allies, including the Left parties, the VCK, and the MDMK, hailed the government for sticking to tradition. “The Karthigai Mahadeepam has been lit in the Deepa Mandapam near the Uchchipillaiyar Temple located directly above the head of the presiding deity at Thirupparankundram,” Law Minister C.T.R. Nirmal Kumar said in a social media post. Shortly after the Deepam was lit, the Executive Officer of Arulmigu Subramaniya Swamy Temple, G. Selvi, and Board of Trustees Chairman V. Shanmugasundaram, in a joint press release, said the temple followed the age-old practice and agama rules in lighting the lamp. The Board of Trustees, including C. Rajapandian, K. Alagappan, K. Regina Devi, and K. Chitra, passed a resolution unanimously, resolving to follow the rituals and ensure the festival is conducted in a peaceful environment. The press release said the temple, known as the first abode of Lord Muruga (Arupadai Veedu), had been following the rituals from time immemorial. The temple, which has been conducting various festivals all through the year, adopted custom and rituals and age old continued practice as per the agama rules. In line with this, the Deepam was lit as per the old practice at the designated deepa mandapam atop the Uchipillayar temple and the light was lit at 6 p.m., the release said. The district administration, in a statement, said all arrangements were made as directed by the Supreme Court. The temple Devasthanam was requested, instructed in writing, and reminded to authorise its team and proceed. However, the Devasthanam did not authorise a team till the last moment. Instead, its Board of Trustees passed a resolution to light the lamp at the usual place, and the lamp was lit at the Deepa Mandapam, it added. Earlier, the police detained several senior leaders of the BJP, including State president Nainar Nagenthran, and Hindu outfits to prevent them from proceeding to Thirupparankundram.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Thousands of police personnel, deployed for security at the foothills, detained protesters and took them away. A section of the protesters damaged buses and other public property.
