Core Context & Background: This report has evoked interest against the backdrop of the latest dispute over the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam atop Thirupparankundram hill, which has taken centre stage, following the Supreme Court’s decision to permit the lighting of the lamp at the newly identified deepathoon as a limited, one-time arrangement

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 2026 report compiled by the Departments of Survey and Settlement and Archaeology of the Tamil Nadu government ascertains that the pillar near the Sikandar Badusha Dargah in Thirupparankundram hill is a Great Trigonometrical Survey (GTS) pillar erected by the British. The map prepared by the Departments identifies the original Deepathoon (lamp pillar) to be below the dargah. This report has evoked interest against the backdrop of the latest dispute over the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam atop Thirupparankundram hill has taken centre stage, following the Supreme Court’s decision to permit the lighting of the lamp at the newly identified deepathoon as a limited, one-time arrangement. The report says the triangulation bearings from Sikandarmalai hill station (Tiruparankundrum) to other stations such as Nagamalai, Sadragiri, Gopalswami, Kutiparai, Madurai temple (Meenakshi Amman temple), Ponurikimalai and Perumalmalai, taken in the present survey, are consistent with values given in the GTS report of the colonial period. Great Trigonometrical Survey location with pillar and the Deepam pillar (Deepathoon) with inscription located at the lower point on the Sikandarmalai hill (Thirupparankundram). | Photo Credit: Tamil Nadu Departments of Survey and Settlement and Archaeology “These values suggest that the pillar installed at Sikandarmalai and the associated station marks engraved in situ on the rocky surface having circle with a dot is a survey pillar,” says the report prepared by officials from the Survey and Settlement and Archaeology Departments. In the five-volume report, running over 1,800 pages, more than 800 stations were identified in the survey’s first phase. Of these, 484 stations, comprising 210 primary and 274 secondary stations, were physically documented. Thirupparankundram was a secondary station with stone pillar and stone mark. The Great Trigonometrical Survey station (pillar) and the control points forming a triangle at Sikandarmalai hill (Thirupparankundram). | Photo Credit: Tamil Nadu Departments of Survey and Settlement and Archaeology The report was based on the order issued by the Revenue and Disaster Management Department of Tamil Nadu in December 2025, to systematically identify and document all GTS stations. In August, 2026, the Revenue Department granted permission to publish the report. The Department of Survey and Settlement comes under the administrative control of the Revenue and Disaster Management Department. The Government Order issued by the Tamil Nadu Revenue Department in December 2025, to systematically identify and document all GTS stations. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In the Survey, stations were established through triangulation, which involves measuring angles between contiguous points relative to a baseline. Landscapes with hills provided clear lines of sight, making it easier to fix triangulation points, whereas flat areas required more stations due to limited visibility.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 What stands atop Thirupparankundram hill is a survey pillar, ascertains Tamil Nadu government report

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 01:24:39 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: This report has evoked interest against the backdrop of the latest dispute over the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam atop Thirupparankundram hill, which has taken centre stage, following the Supreme Court’s decision to permit the lighting of the lamp at the newly identified deepathoon as a limited, one-time arrangement

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 2026 report compiled by the Departments of Survey and Settlement and Archaeology of the Tamil Nadu government ascertains that the pillar near the Sikandar Badusha Dargah in Thirupparankundram hill is a Great Trigonometrical Survey (GTS) pillar erected by the British. The map prepared by the Departments identifies the original Deepathoon (lamp pillar) to be below the dargah. This report has evoked interest against the backdrop of the latest dispute over the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam atop Thirupparankundram hill has taken centre stage, following the Supreme Court’s decision to permit the lighting of the lamp at the newly identified deepathoon as a limited, one-time arrangement. The report says the triangulation bearings from Sikandarmalai hill station (Tiruparankundrum) to other stations such as Nagamalai, Sadragiri, Gopalswami, Kutiparai, Madurai temple (Meenakshi Amman temple), Ponurikimalai and Perumalmalai, taken in the present survey, are consistent with values given in the GTS report of the colonial period. Great Trigonometrical Survey location with pillar and the Deepam pillar (Deepathoon) with inscription located at the lower point on the Sikandarmalai hill (Thirupparankundram). | Photo Credit: Tamil Nadu Departments of Survey and Settlement and Archaeology “These values suggest that the pillar installed at Sikandarmalai and the associated station marks engraved in situ on the rocky surface having circle with a dot is a survey pillar,” says the report prepared by officials from the Survey and Settlement and Archaeology Departments. In the five-volume report, running over 1,800 pages, more than 800 stations were identified in the survey’s first phase. Of these, 484 stations, comprising 210 primary and 274 secondary stations, were physically documented. Thirupparankundram was a secondary station with stone pillar and stone mark. The Great Trigonometrical Survey station (pillar) and the control points forming a triangle at Sikandarmalai hill (Thirupparankundram). | Photo Credit: Tamil Nadu Departments of Survey and Settlement and Archaeology The report was based on the order issued by the Revenue and Disaster Management Department of Tamil Nadu in December 2025, to systematically identify and document all GTS stations. In August, 2026, the Revenue Department granted permission to publish the report. The Department of Survey and Settlement comes under the administrative control of the Revenue and Disaster Management Department. The Government Order issued by the Tamil Nadu Revenue Department in December 2025, to systematically identify and document all GTS stations. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In the Survey, stations were established through triangulation, which involves measuring angles between contiguous points relative to a baseline. Landscapes with hills provided clear lines of sight, making it easier to fix triangulation points, whereas flat areas required more stations due to limited visibility.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Permissibility (Noun)
कानूनी अनुमति या स्वीकार्यता — किसी कार्य को करने की वैध छूट।
✓ Syn: Admissibility, Legality, Allowance  |  ✖ Ant: Prohibition, Ban, Illegality
Trigonometrical (Adjective)
त्रिकोणमितीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Trigonometrical' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Administrative (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Administrative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Triangulation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Triangulation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "What stands atop Thirupparankundram hill is a survey pillar, ascertains Tamil Nadu government report", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. This report has evoked interest against the backdrop of the latest dispute over the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam atop Thirupparankundram hill,...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'What stands atop Thirupparankundram hill is a su' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'What stands atop Thirupparankundram hill is a' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'What stands atop Thirupparankundram hill is a' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "This report has evoked interest against the backdrop of the latest dispute over the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam atop Thirupparankundram hill,..." (Hinglish Arth: इस रिपोर्ट ने थिरुप्पारनकुंड्रम पहाड़ी के ऊपर कार्तिगई दीपम की रोशनी पर नवीनतम विवाद की पृष्ठभूमि में रुचि पैदा की है, जिसने सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के फैसले के बाद केंद्र का मंच ले लिया है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "What stands atop Thirupparankundram hill is a survey pillar, ascertains Tamil Nadu government report"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Landscapes with hills provided clear lines of sight, making it easier to fix triangulation points, whereas flat areas required more stations due to...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Landscapes with hills provided clear lines of sight, making it easier to fix triangulation points, whereas flat areas required more stations due to..." (Hinglish Arth: पहाड़ियों वाले परिदृश्यों ने दृष्टि की स्पष्ट रेखाएँ प्रदान कीं, जिससे त्रिकोणासन बिंदुओं को ठीक करना आसान हो गया, जबकि समतल क्षेत्रों में सीमित दृश्यता के कारण अधिक स्टेशनों की आवश्यकता थी।)

articles.title: Punjab Assembly polls: BJP-SAD announce alliance
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: “On this occasion of Guru Purab today, NDA’s oldest member, Shiromani Akali Dal, has returned to the alliance,” Amit Shah said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “The next Punjab Assembly elections, BJP and SAD will contest in alliance,” Union Home Minister Amit Shah said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), announcing the widely anticipated return of Shiromani Akali Dali (SAD) into the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) fold. “On this occasion of Guru Purab today, NDA’s oldest member has returned to the alliance,” he added. “Prime Minister, Badal Sahib, Atal Ji, and Advani Ji have shared a deep relationship for many years. The Bharatiya Janata Party and the Akali Dal also share a very deep relationship.” Responding to a question, Mr. Shah said that SAD will play the role of the elder brother in this alliance, as further details on the seat-sharing matrix were not immediately available. However, he was quick to clarify that it is the elder brother who becomes the Chief Minister, indicating that the alliance will front a SAD face for the Chief Minsiterial position “This alliance will become the symbol of Hindu-Sikh brotherhood,” the Union Home Minister said, adding that the alliance will contest the elections of some key platforms including 1. eradication of substance-abuse and narcotics addiction from Punjab, 2. removal of corruption from Punjab, and 3. strengthen nationalist forces in the State. “The current government of Punjab had promised to eradicate the problem of substance abuse within three months. That has not happened, and in fact cases of addiction have increased,” Mr. Shah said. Mr. Shah went on to reiterate an earlier statement of his, saying that of the alliance comes to power then by December 31, 2029, Punjab will be completely free of the problem of drug-abuse. Negotiations on seat-sharing between the BJP and the SAD for the 2027 Punjab Assembly polls had been underway for some time. The SAD had snapped its 24-year-old alliance with the BJP in September 2020 over the now-scrapped three farm laws.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Earlier, Lok Sabha MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal was also part of the Modi government as a Minister with Cabinet rank.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Punjab Assembly polls: BJP-SAD announce alliance

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 01:24:22 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: “On this occasion of Guru Purab today, NDA’s oldest member, Shiromani Akali Dal, has returned to the alliance,” Amit Shah said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “The next Punjab Assembly elections, BJP and SAD will contest in alliance,” Union Home Minister Amit Shah said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), announcing the widely anticipated return of Shiromani Akali Dali (SAD) into the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) fold. “On this occasion of Guru Purab today, NDA’s oldest member has returned to the alliance,” he added. “Prime Minister, Badal Sahib, Atal Ji, and Advani Ji have shared a deep relationship for many years. The Bharatiya Janata Party and the Akali Dal also share a very deep relationship.” Responding to a question, Mr. Shah said that SAD will play the role of the elder brother in this alliance, as further details on the seat-sharing matrix were not immediately available. However, he was quick to clarify that it is the elder brother who becomes the Chief Minister, indicating that the alliance will front a SAD face for the Chief Minsiterial position “This alliance will become the symbol of Hindu-Sikh brotherhood,” the Union Home Minister said, adding that the alliance will contest the elections of some key platforms including 1. eradication of substance-abuse and narcotics addiction from Punjab, 2. removal of corruption from Punjab, and 3. strengthen nationalist forces in the State. “The current government of Punjab had promised to eradicate the problem of substance abuse within three months. That has not happened, and in fact cases of addiction have increased,” Mr. Shah said. Mr. Shah went on to reiterate an earlier statement of his, saying that of the alliance comes to power then by December 31, 2029, Punjab will be completely free of the problem of drug-abuse. Negotiations on seat-sharing between the BJP and the SAD for the 2027 Punjab Assembly polls had been underway for some time. The SAD had snapped its 24-year-old alliance with the BJP in September 2020 over the now-scrapped three farm laws.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Earlier, Lok Sabha MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal was also part of the Modi government as a Minister with Cabinet rank.

Minsiterial (Adjective)
लघुचित्र — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Minsiterial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Eradication' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Democratic (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Democratic' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Corruption (Noun)
भ्रष्टाचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Corruption' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Punjab Assembly polls: BJP-SAD announce alliance", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. “On this occasion of Guru Purab today, NDA’s oldest member, Shiromani Akali Dal, has returned to the alliance,” Amit Shah said.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Punjab Assembly polls: BJP-SAD announce alliance' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Punjab Assembly polls: BJP-SAD announce allia' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Punjab Assembly polls: BJP-SAD announce allia' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "“On this occasion of Guru Purab today, NDA’s oldest member, Shiromani Akali Dal, has returned to the alliance,” Amit Shah said." (Hinglish Arth: अमित शाह ने कहा, "गुरु पर्व के इस अवसर पर आज एनडीए का सबसे पुराना सदस्य शिरोमणि अकाली दल गठबंधन में वापस आ गया है।")
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Punjab Assembly polls: BJP-SAD announce alliance"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Earlier, Lok Sabha MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal was also part of the Modi government as a Minister with Cabinet rank.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Earlier, Lok Sabha MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal was also part of the Modi government as a Minister with Cabinet rank." (Hinglish Arth: इससे पहले लोकसभा सांसद हरसिमरत कौर बादल भी कैबिनेट रैंक की मंत्री के तौर पर मोदी सरकार का हिस्सा थीं।)

articles.title: President Murmu to inaugurate Bali Jatra in Cuttack during two-day Odisha visit
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: She will stay overnight at Lok Bhavan and attend the National Scientific Convention on Homoeopathy in Bhubaneswar on November 25

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: President Droupadi Murmu will arrive in Odisha on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) afternoon on a two-day visit, during which she will inaugurate the Bali Jatra festival in Cuttack and attend a national convention on homoeopathy in Bhubaneswar, officials said. After arriving at the Biju Patnaik International Airport in Bhubaneswar, Ms. Murmu will proceed to Lok Bhavan before travelling to Cuttack to inaugurate the annual trade fair this evening, they said. She will stay overnight at Lok Bhavan and attend the National Scientific Convention on Homoeopathy in Bhubaneswar on Wednesday (November 25). Security has been tightened in the twin cities of Bhubaneswar and Cuttack ahead of the President's visit. DGP Vinaytosh Mishra reviewed security arrangements at the Bali Jatra ground in Cuttack on Monday (November 23). Around 70 platoons of police personnel will be deployed to manage security and crowd movement, he said. Police have also set up 38 watchtowers and installed 1,400 CCTV cameras at the venue, another official said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In Bhubaneswar, arrangements have been made to ensure smooth traffic movement. Traffic restrictions will be imposed for brief periods to facilitate the movement of the President's convoy, he said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 President Murmu to inaugurate Bali Jatra in Cuttack during two-day Odisha visit

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 01:21:58 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: She will stay overnight at Lok Bhavan and attend the National Scientific Convention on Homoeopathy in Bhubaneswar on November 25

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: President Droupadi Murmu will arrive in Odisha on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) afternoon on a two-day visit, during which she will inaugurate the Bali Jatra festival in Cuttack and attend a national convention on homoeopathy in Bhubaneswar, officials said. After arriving at the Biju Patnaik International Airport in Bhubaneswar, Ms. Murmu will proceed to Lok Bhavan before travelling to Cuttack to inaugurate the annual trade fair this evening, they said. She will stay overnight at Lok Bhavan and attend the National Scientific Convention on Homoeopathy in Bhubaneswar on Wednesday (November 25). Security has been tightened in the twin cities of Bhubaneswar and Cuttack ahead of the President's visit. DGP Vinaytosh Mishra reviewed security arrangements at the Bali Jatra ground in Cuttack on Monday (November 23). Around 70 platoons of police personnel will be deployed to manage security and crowd movement, he said. Police have also set up 38 watchtowers and installed 1,400 CCTV cameras at the venue, another official said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In Bhubaneswar, arrangements have been made to ensure smooth traffic movement. Traffic restrictions will be imposed for brief periods to facilitate the movement of the President's convoy, he said.

articles.title: Thirupparankundram row: when politics invades a syncretic hill town
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In Thirupparankundram in Madurai, Hindus and Muslims live in camaraderie, but that has not kept the hill, which holds a couple of temples, a dargah, and some Jain beds, out of dispute. Here, we outline the history of judgments involving different petitioners through the years, in an attempt to understand the current crisis.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Thirupparankundram, a name that is on the lips of any Murugan devotee, is now ringing across the nation. Foremost among the six locations in Tamil Nadu – known as Aaru Padai Veedu – deemed as abodes of Lord Murugan, Thirupparankundram in Madurai city has been known primarily as a temple town, quaint and attracting devotees in droves. Notably, there is rich religious fusion and syncretism on the Thirupparankundram hill, where – besides the Subramaniya Swamy Temple – the Kasi Viswanathar Temple, the Sikandar Badusha Dargah, and also some ancient Jain beds are located. In recent months, however, it has found itself in a maelstrom of legal battles and intense ideological sparring. Though Thirupparankundram is no stranger to litigation – the first suit being filed as early as 1920 – this time, a petition to light a lamp on a pillar on the hill during the Karthigai Deepam festival is the source of the conflagration. The crisis, this time, also had links to the history of the litigation, which hinged on the ownership of the Thirupparankundram hill, the contention arising between the temple and the dargah located there. Significantly, a Privy Council in London had ruled that the hill would be vested with the temple, and at the same time, it had protected the dargah and the access steps to it. In November 2025, petitions were filed in the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, seeking a direction to the temple management to light a deepam , on the occasion of the Karthigai Deepam festival, on a pillar on one of the two peaks of the Thirupparankundram hill. The petitioners called the pillar a deepathoon , meaning a pillar on which the lamp would be lit. The State government had argued against it, citing law-and-order concerns, the presence of a dargah at the hillock, and a lack of evidence that the stone pillar was meant to light the Karthigai Deepam.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / Madurai / The Sunday Story / state politics / religion and belief / crime, law and justice / court / judiciary (system of justice) / history

hinglishTracks.en: In November 2025, petitions were filed in the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, seeking a direction to the temple management to light a deepam , on the occasion of the Karthigai Deepam festival, on a pillar on one of the two peaks of the Thirupparankundram hill.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Thirupparankundram row: when politics invades a syncretic hill town

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 01:19:40 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In Thirupparankundram in Madurai, Hindus and Muslims live in camaraderie, but that has not kept the hill, which holds a couple of temples, a dargah, and some Jain beds, out of dispute. Here, we outline the history of judgments involving different petitioners through the years, in an attempt to understand the current crisis.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Thirupparankundram, a name that is on the lips of any Murugan devotee, is now ringing across the nation. Foremost among the six locations in Tamil Nadu – known as Aaru Padai Veedu – deemed as abodes of Lord Murugan, Thirupparankundram in Madurai city has been known primarily as a temple town, quaint and attracting devotees in droves. Notably, there is rich religious fusion and syncretism on the Thirupparankundram hill, where – besides the Subramaniya Swamy Temple – the Kasi Viswanathar Temple, the Sikandar Badusha Dargah, and also some ancient Jain beds are located. In recent months, however, it has found itself in a maelstrom of legal battles and intense ideological sparring. Though Thirupparankundram is no stranger to litigation – the first suit being filed as early as 1920 – this time, a petition to light a lamp on a pillar on the hill during the Karthigai Deepam festival is the source of the conflagration. The crisis, this time, also had links to the history of the litigation, which hinged on the ownership of the Thirupparankundram hill, the contention arising between the temple and the dargah located there. Significantly, a Privy Council in London had ruled that the hill would be vested with the temple, and at the same time, it had protected the dargah and the access steps to it. In November 2025, petitions were filed in the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, seeking a direction to the temple management to light a deepam , on the occasion of the Karthigai Deepam festival, on a pillar on one of the two peaks of the Thirupparankundram hill. The petitioners called the pillar a deepathoon , meaning a pillar on which the lamp would be lit. The State government had argued against it, citing law-and-order concerns, the presence of a dargah at the hillock, and a lack of evidence that the stone pillar was meant to light the Karthigai Deepam.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / Madurai / The Sunday Story / state politics / religion and belief / crime, law and justice / court / judiciary (system of justice) / history

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: In Thirupparankundram in Madurai, Hindus and Muslims live in camaraderie, but that has not kept the hill, which holds a couple of temples, a dargah, and some Jain beds, out of dispute. Here, we outline the history of judgments involving different petitioners through the years, in an attempt to understand the current crisis.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Thirupparankundram, a name that is on the lips of any Murugan devotee, is now ringing across the nation. Foremost among the six locations in Tamil Nadu – known as Aaru Padai Veedu – deemed as abodes of Lord Murugan, Thirupparankundram in Madurai city has been known primarily as a temple town, quaint and attracting devotees in droves. Notably, there is rich religious fusion and syncretism on the Thirupparankundram hill, where – besides the Subramaniya Swamy Temple – the Kasi Viswanathar Temple, the Sikandar Badusha Dargah, and also some ancient Jain beds are located. In recent months, however, it has found itself in a maelstrom of legal battles and intense ideological sparring. Though Thirupparankundram is no stranger to litigation – the first suit being filed as early as 1920 – this time, a petition to light a lamp on a pillar on the hill during the Karthigai Deepam festival is the source of the conflagration. The crisis, this time, also had links to the history of the litigation, which hinged on the ownership of the Thirupparankundram hill, the contention arising between the temple and the dargah located there. Significantly, a Privy Council in London had ruled that the hill would be vested with the temple, and at the same time, it had protected the dargah and the access steps to it. In November 2025, petitions were filed in the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, seeking a direction to the temple management to light a deepam , on the occasion of the Karthigai Deepam festival, on a pillar on one of the two peaks of the Thirupparankundram hill. The petitioners called the pillar a deepathoon , meaning a pillar on which the lamp would be lit. The State government had argued against it, citing law-and-order concerns, the presence of a dargah at the hillock, and a lack of evidence that the stone pillar was meant to light the Karthigai Deepam.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / Madurai / The Sunday Story / state politics / religion and belief / crime, law and justice / court / judiciary (system of justice) / history

articles.title: Wall Street roars back as Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Nvidia shares surged 32.2%, on track for their biggest one-day jump in more than two decades after an extraordinary reversal, which followed President Donald Trump’s call for Jensen Huang’s return

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Wall Street’s main indexes rallied sharply on Monday (November 23, 2026), led by a ​nearly 7% jump in the tech-heavy Nasdaq, as investors rushed back into AI-linked stocks ⁠after Nvidia said it had reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive. Nvidia shares surged 32.2%, on track for their biggest one-day jump in more than two decades after an extraordinary reversal, which followed President Donald Trump’s call for Mr. Huang’s return. Mr. Huang resigned ‌as chief executive earlier this month over revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy. The chipmaker is widely regarded as a cornerstone of the AI trade, and ‌its sharp rebound helped lift sentiment across the sector after weeks of heavy selling. “Huang’s return ‌marks ⁠one of the biggest reversals in the history of the stock market. Never has so ⁠much value rested on the shoulders of a single executive,” said David Russell, global head of market strategy at TradeStation. “Wall Street envisioned a stock market without his leadership and didn’t like what it saw.” The Nasdaq-100 was on track to add more than $2 trillion ​in market value on Monday (November 23). The Nasdaq ‌Composite and the S&P 500 were on track for their biggest one-day gains since markets surged after Mr. Trump paused his “Liberation Day” tariff package in April 2025. Chip stocks gained, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 13.4% and also on track for its best session since April 2025.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The rally was broad-based in ‌the tech sphere, with the so-called Magnificent Seven stocks Tesla, Amazon , Microsoft, Meta and Alphabet climbing ​between 5.8% and 12.4%.

articles.title: India, Canada ‘very close’ to concluding trade pact negotiations: Official
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The engagements are important as both sides aim to conclude the talks by the end of this year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Negotiators from India and Canada are holding daily discussions on the proposed Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) and are "very close" to concluding the negotiations, an official said. The engagements are important as both sides aim to conclude the talks by the end of this year. "Both teams are talking every day. We are very close," the official said. Last week (November 11-20), the two countries concluded the sixth round of negotiations for the agreement, aimed at unlocking new opportunities in trade and investment, and diversifying supply chains. The negotiations covered key areas, including trade in goods, trade in services, rules of origin, trade remedies, intellectual property and investment promotion. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal also held a meeting with Glenn Purves, Vice Minister of International Trade of Canada, and his delegation to review the progress of these negotiations. The ongoing negotiations mark the resumption of talks, as the two countries had earlier engaged in a similar exercise, but Canada paused it in 2023. Now, they have decided to resume talks this year because much has changed on the global trade front during those two years. The India-Canada CEPA was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney in March.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The negotiations are important as the two sides have set a target to increase the bilateral trade to $50 billion by 2030. It declined by 8.23% to $7.95 billion ($4.67 billion exports and $3.28 billion imports) in 2025-26 from $8.66 billion in 2024-25. The trade gap was in favour of India at $1.38 billion.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 India, Canada ‘very close’ to concluding trade pact negotiations: Official

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 12:51:41 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The engagements are important as both sides aim to conclude the talks by the end of this year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Negotiators from India and Canada are holding daily discussions on the proposed Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) and are "very close" to concluding the negotiations, an official said. The engagements are important as both sides aim to conclude the talks by the end of this year. "Both teams are talking every day. We are very close," the official said. Last week (November 11-20), the two countries concluded the sixth round of negotiations for the agreement, aimed at unlocking new opportunities in trade and investment, and diversifying supply chains. The negotiations covered key areas, including trade in goods, trade in services, rules of origin, trade remedies, intellectual property and investment promotion. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal also held a meeting with Glenn Purves, Vice Minister of International Trade of Canada, and his delegation to review the progress of these negotiations. The ongoing negotiations mark the resumption of talks, as the two countries had earlier engaged in a similar exercise, but Canada paused it in 2023. Now, they have decided to resume talks this year because much has changed on the global trade front during those two years. The India-Canada CEPA was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney in March.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The negotiations are important as the two sides have set a target to increase the bilateral trade to $50 billion by 2030. It declined by 8.23% to $7.95 billion ($4.67 billion exports and $3.28 billion imports) in 2025-26 from $8.66 billion in 2024-25. The trade gap was in favour of India at $1.38 billion.

articles.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after U.S. government input
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nvidia on Monday (November 23, 2026) reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive after input from senior U.S. government officials left its board confident he posed no national security risk, less than two weeks after the co-founder resigned due to an alleged spy scandal. U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision.” The board voted unanimously to bring Mr. Huang back as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately, after a series of meetings left directors satisfied with his “candor and ability to lead”, the company said in a statement. Nvidia did not name the government officials it consulted or say what they told the board. Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO: 6 other CEOs who reclaimed their top positions The decision came three days after Mr. Trump publicly urged Nvidia to take Mr. Huang back, calling him “one of the truly most brilliant minds in the world” and saying he would “love to see Jensen be given a second chance.” Mr. Trump described Mr. Huang as “a good man” who “made some bad decisions" and said the company should rehire him “if they were smart". Mr. Huang had offered to return, but the board initially refused. Board chair Harvey Jones had said on an earnings call last week that directors had unanimously accepted his resignation and did “not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO".

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment,” Mr. Huang said, thanking the board, staff, shareholders and his family. “I can’t wait to get back to work.”

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after U.S. government input

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 12:40:52 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nvidia on Monday (November 23, 2026) reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive after input from senior U.S. government officials left its board confident he posed no national security risk, less than two weeks after the co-founder resigned due to an alleged spy scandal. U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision.” The board voted unanimously to bring Mr. Huang back as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately, after a series of meetings left directors satisfied with his “candor and ability to lead”, the company said in a statement. Nvidia did not name the government officials it consulted or say what they told the board. Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO: 6 other CEOs who reclaimed their top positions The decision came three days after Mr. Trump publicly urged Nvidia to take Mr. Huang back, calling him “one of the truly most brilliant minds in the world” and saying he would “love to see Jensen be given a second chance.” Mr. Trump described Mr. Huang as “a good man” who “made some bad decisions" and said the company should rehire him “if they were smart". Mr. Huang had offered to return, but the board initially refused. Board chair Harvey Jones had said on an earnings call last week that directors had unanimously accepted his resignation and did “not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO".

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment,” Mr. Huang said, thanking the board, staff, shareholders and his family. “I can’t wait to get back to work.”

articles.title: Nvidia and board still face legal risks after Jensen Huang's return

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Nvidia’s board reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO, pressured by U.S. authorities, sparked a rapid stock rally but left the company facing multiple investigations, including an SEC probe and a shareholder lawsuit over governance

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO at the urging of U.S. President Donald Trump, less than two weeks after the co-founder of the AI chip powerhouse resigned following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged spy for China. The reported ties between Mr. Huang and a suspected spy ​led to his resignation as CEO. They sparked investigations by the U.S. securities regulator and the FBI, congressional hearings, a review by the company’s independent directors and a proposed investor class action lawsuit. Below is a ‌look at how the rehiring, which sparked a massive rally in Nvidia’s stock, could impact the legal exposure for the company and its ​directors. Mr. Huang allegedly had intimate relations with Alice Huang, an unrelated Chinese businesswoman who is accused of having ties to Beijing. Mr. Huang ⁠is also accused of having had intimate relationships with at least two Nvidia employees. He resigned on November 12. Mr. Huang has acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife and apologised, but has not publicly addressed the alleged relationships in detail. China has denied the espionage allegations. Attempts by Reuters to reach Ms. Alice Huang have been unsuccessful. Nvidia said in a statement that, based on U.S. government input, the board ‌was confident that “Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk,” a claim backed by Mr. Trump in an interview with CNBC . Mr. Trump said that Mr. Huang did nothing wrong and that his intervention led to Mr. Huang’s return. Nvidia sits at the centre of the technological rivalry between the United States and China. Washington has ‌imposed restrictions on exports of advanced AI chips to China since 2022, including those made by Nvidia. An investor ‌filed ⁠a so-called derivative lawsuit in federal court on November 11, seeking to hold the board liable for failing to make a good-faith effort to ⁠oversee the business and Mr. Huang. The lawsuit said the board allowed Nvidia to make repeated assurances about Mr. Huang’s relationship with Ms. Alice Huang and her former company, Megaspeed, until the allegations were public. Nvidia formed a committee of independent directors that hired law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to assist in an internal investigation. The committee is still investigating, Nvidia said on Monday (November 23, 2026).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Trump’s statement that Mr. Huang did not pose a national security risk could strengthen ​the directors’ legal defences, according to legal experts. The directors could argue ‌that Mr. Trump’s assurances mean the company will not be prosecuted for export control violations, removing the threat that rehiring Mr. Huang could damage the company.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Nvidia and board still face legal risks after Jensen Huang's return

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 12:23:00 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Nvidia’s board reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO, pressured by U.S. authorities, sparked a rapid stock rally but left the company facing multiple investigations, including an SEC probe and a shareholder lawsuit over governance

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO at the urging of U.S. President Donald Trump, less than two weeks after the co-founder of the AI chip powerhouse resigned following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged spy for China. The reported ties between Mr. Huang and a suspected spy ​led to his resignation as CEO. They sparked investigations by the U.S. securities regulator and the FBI, congressional hearings, a review by the company’s independent directors and a proposed investor class action lawsuit. Below is a ‌look at how the rehiring, which sparked a massive rally in Nvidia’s stock, could impact the legal exposure for the company and its ​directors. Mr. Huang allegedly had intimate relations with Alice Huang, an unrelated Chinese businesswoman who is accused of having ties to Beijing. Mr. Huang ⁠is also accused of having had intimate relationships with at least two Nvidia employees. He resigned on November 12. Mr. Huang has acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife and apologised, but has not publicly addressed the alleged relationships in detail. China has denied the espionage allegations. Attempts by Reuters to reach Ms. Alice Huang have been unsuccessful. Nvidia said in a statement that, based on U.S. government input, the board ‌was confident that “Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk,” a claim backed by Mr. Trump in an interview with CNBC . Mr. Trump said that Mr. Huang did nothing wrong and that his intervention led to Mr. Huang’s return. Nvidia sits at the centre of the technological rivalry between the United States and China. Washington has ‌imposed restrictions on exports of advanced AI chips to China since 2022, including those made by Nvidia. An investor ‌filed ⁠a so-called derivative lawsuit in federal court on November 11, seeking to hold the board liable for failing to make a good-faith effort to ⁠oversee the business and Mr. Huang. The lawsuit said the board allowed Nvidia to make repeated assurances about Mr. Huang’s relationship with Ms. Alice Huang and her former company, Megaspeed, until the allegations were public. Nvidia formed a committee of independent directors that hired law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to assist in an internal investigation. The committee is still investigating, Nvidia said on Monday (November 23, 2026).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Trump’s statement that Mr. Huang did not pose a national security risk could strengthen ​the directors’ legal defences, according to legal experts. The directors could argue ‌that Mr. Trump’s assurances mean the company will not be prosecuted for export control violations, removing the threat that rehiring Mr. Huang could damage the company.

articles.title: ‘The Private Diary of Pope Francis,’ by Argentine Cardinal Fernandez: The Pope revealed in personal diary having seen devil three times
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The book by Argentine Cardinal Fernandez, includes passages taken from a journal the former Jorge Bergoglio kept between 1992 and 2024

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The late Pope Francis saw the devil three times and once saw the "gates of hell", he revealed in his personal diary, excerpts of which were published Tuesday (November 24, 2026) in a new book. "The Private Diary of Pope Francis," by Argentine Cardinal Victor Manuel Fernandez, includes passages taken from a journal the former Jorge Bergoglio kept between 1992 and 2024, a document that reveals his worries, regrets and self-critiques, as well as his enormous humanity and faith. Cardinal Fernandez, head of the Vatican's Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith, said he was asked by late Pope Francis to help make known to the world the musings inside the black plastic journal. Upon Pope Francis's death last year, Cardinal Fernandez expressed concern to his successor, Leo XIV, that the book would be "left forgotten in some storage". He was allowed to publish passages, noting that "the spiritual concerns present in his ( Cardinal Francis's) heart are very clear and can do us good". In one of the most intriguing revelations, Pope Francis writes that while Archbishop of Buenos Aires, he saw the devil three different times including "from the car while I was going home, and in the choir during the mass", and once in Rome following a visit to Chile. "I discovered that the demon was prowling brazenly, hovering cunningly," wrote Pope Francis in his journal on January 24, 2021, according to an advance copy of the French language version of the book published by Albin Michel and viewed by AFP . Pope Francis wrote that he recalled three episodes "where I'm sure he actually appeared physically." "About 15 years ago. I saw him from the car window. I won't forget his threatening and, at the same time, alluring eyes," he wrote. During the second episode inside a Carmelite chapel, Pope Francis wrote: "He looked at me with flaming eyes.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "I won't forget that look, more intense than the previous one. They were like flashes of fire."

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 ‘The Private Diary of Pope Francis,’ by Argentine Cardinal Fernandez: The Pope revealed in personal diary having seen devil three times

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 11:45:39 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The book by Argentine Cardinal Fernandez, includes passages taken from a journal the former Jorge Bergoglio kept between 1992 and 2024

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The late Pope Francis saw the devil three times and once saw the "gates of hell", he revealed in his personal diary, excerpts of which were published Tuesday (November 24, 2026) in a new book. "The Private Diary of Pope Francis," by Argentine Cardinal Victor Manuel Fernandez, includes passages taken from a journal the former Jorge Bergoglio kept between 1992 and 2024, a document that reveals his worries, regrets and self-critiques, as well as his enormous humanity and faith. Cardinal Fernandez, head of the Vatican's Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith, said he was asked by late Pope Francis to help make known to the world the musings inside the black plastic journal. Upon Pope Francis's death last year, Cardinal Fernandez expressed concern to his successor, Leo XIV, that the book would be "left forgotten in some storage". He was allowed to publish passages, noting that "the spiritual concerns present in his ( Cardinal Francis's) heart are very clear and can do us good". In one of the most intriguing revelations, Pope Francis writes that while Archbishop of Buenos Aires, he saw the devil three different times including "from the car while I was going home, and in the choir during the mass", and once in Rome following a visit to Chile. "I discovered that the demon was prowling brazenly, hovering cunningly," wrote Pope Francis in his journal on January 24, 2021, according to an advance copy of the French language version of the book published by Albin Michel and viewed by AFP . Pope Francis wrote that he recalled three episodes "where I'm sure he actually appeared physically." "About 15 years ago. I saw him from the car window. I won't forget his threatening and, at the same time, alluring eyes," he wrote. During the second episode inside a Carmelite chapel, Pope Francis wrote: "He looked at me with flaming eyes.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "I won't forget that look, more intense than the previous one. They were like flashes of fire."

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "‘The Private Diary of Pope Francis,’ by Argentine Cardinal Fernandez: The Pope revealed in personal diary having seen devil three times", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The book by Argentine Cardinal Fernandez, includes passages taken from a journal the former Jorge Bergoglio kept between 1992 and 2024.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of '‘The Private Diary of Pope Francis,’ by Argentin' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to '‘The Private Diary of Pope Francis,’ by Argen' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that '‘The Private Diary of Pope Francis,’ by Argen' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The book by Argentine Cardinal Fernandez, includes passages taken from a journal the former Jorge Bergoglio kept between 1992 and 2024." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "‘The Private Diary of Pope Francis,’ by Argentine Cardinal Fernandez: The Pope revealed in personal diary having seen devil three times"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. "I won't forget that look, more intense than the previous one.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.

✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: ""I won't forget that look, more intense than the previous one." (Hinglish Arth: "मैं उस लुक को नहीं भूलूंगा, पिछले वाले से भी ज्यादा गहन।)

articles.title: Motorola launches Edge 70 Neo for premium segment buyers in India

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Motorola Edge 70 Neo ships with a 7,000 mAh battery, supported by a 45W TurboPower charging and 7.5W wired reverse charging support

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Motorola on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) launched the Edge 70 Neo in India for the premium segment buyers , complementing the Edge 70 series with phones like Edge 70 Pro, Fusion and Max. Motorola Edge 70 Neo has a 6.8 inch 1.5K Extreme AMOLED Super HD quad-curved display with a 144Hz refresh rate, up to 5,200 nits peak brightness. Motorola Edge 70 Neo ships with a 7,000 mAh battery, supported by a 45W TurboPower charging and 7.5W wired reverse charging support. Motorola Edge 70 Neo comes with Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection and IP64-rated water resistance. Motorola Edge 70 Neo sports a 50 MP Sony Lytia 710 main camera with optical image stabilisation (OIS), and a 2 MP macro lens. It has a 32 MP selfie camera and supports 4K video recording on both the main lens and selfie camera. Motorola Edge 70 Neo runs on Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset with 8 GB RAM and 128 GB UFS 3.1 storage. It operates on Hello UX based on Android 16. The phone will get three Android OS upgrades and security maintenance releases. Motorola Edge 70 Neo comes in Pantone validated Mountain View, Gray Lilac, Milky Blue and Sage colours. Motorola Edge 70 Neo will go on sale starting December 1 on Flipkart, Motorola and leading retail stores including Reliance Digital at ₹40,999.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: technology (general) / gadgets (general) / PDAs and smartphones

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Motorola launches Edge 70 Neo for premium segment buyers in India

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 12:58:46 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Motorola Edge 70 Neo ships with a 7,000 mAh battery, supported by a 45W TurboPower charging and 7.5W wired reverse charging support

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Motorola on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) launched the Edge 70 Neo in India for the premium segment buyers , complementing the Edge 70 series with phones like Edge 70 Pro, Fusion and Max. Motorola Edge 70 Neo has a 6.8 inch 1.5K Extreme AMOLED Super HD quad-curved display with a 144Hz refresh rate, up to 5,200 nits peak brightness. Motorola Edge 70 Neo ships with a 7,000 mAh battery, supported by a 45W TurboPower charging and 7.5W wired reverse charging support. Motorola Edge 70 Neo comes with Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection and IP64-rated water resistance. Motorola Edge 70 Neo sports a 50 MP Sony Lytia 710 main camera with optical image stabilisation (OIS), and a 2 MP macro lens. It has a 32 MP selfie camera and supports 4K video recording on both the main lens and selfie camera. Motorola Edge 70 Neo runs on Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset with 8 GB RAM and 128 GB UFS 3.1 storage. It operates on Hello UX based on Android 16. The phone will get three Android OS upgrades and security maintenance releases. Motorola Edge 70 Neo comes in Pantone validated Mountain View, Gray Lilac, Milky Blue and Sage colours. Motorola Edge 70 Neo will go on sale starting December 1 on Flipkart, Motorola and leading retail stores including Reliance Digital at ₹40,999.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: technology (general) / gadgets (general) / PDAs and smartphones

articles.title: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO: 6 other CEOs who reclaimed their top positions
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had resigned due to an alleged Chinese spy scandal on November 12, 2026.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Jensen Huang, co-founder of Nvidia, who had stepped down as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the chipmaker, was re-instated in the top job on November 23, 2026. Mr Huang had resigned due to an alleged Chinese spy scandal on November 12, and CFO Colette Kress was appointed as interim CEO. The board voted unanimously to bring Mr Huang back as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately, after a series of meetings left directors satisfied with his “candor and ability to lead”, Nvidia said in a statement. Huang’s return has put the spotlight on the ouster and return of other top bosses. Here’s a look at some of the major names. Former Twitter CEO Jack Dorsey | Photo Credit: Sandeep Saxena

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The return of Mr Jensen Huang at the helm of Nvidia is unique, as reports suggest that senior U.S. government officials left the company’s board confident that he posed no national security risk amid concerns of China vying for the company’s advanced chips. U.S. President Donald Trump also welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision.” I believe my ​intervention was very important to get Jensen Huang back,” Mr Trump told CNBC after Mr Huang’s reinstatement, marking an unprecedented intervention by U.S. government officials into the matters of a publicly traded company.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO: 6 other CEOs who reclaimed their top positions

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 12:35:18 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had resigned due to an alleged Chinese spy scandal on November 12, 2026.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Jensen Huang, co-founder of Nvidia, who had stepped down as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the chipmaker, was re-instated in the top job on November 23, 2026. Mr Huang had resigned due to an alleged Chinese spy scandal on November 12, and CFO Colette Kress was appointed as interim CEO. The board voted unanimously to bring Mr Huang back as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately, after a series of meetings left directors satisfied with his “candor and ability to lead”, Nvidia said in a statement. Huang’s return has put the spotlight on the ouster and return of other top bosses. Here’s a look at some of the major names. Former Twitter CEO Jack Dorsey | Photo Credit: Sandeep Saxena

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The return of Mr Jensen Huang at the helm of Nvidia is unique, as reports suggest that senior U.S. government officials left the company’s board confident that he posed no national security risk amid concerns of China vying for the company’s advanced chips. U.S. President Donald Trump also welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision.” I believe my ​intervention was very important to get Jensen Huang back,” Mr Trump told CNBC after Mr Huang’s reinstatement, marking an unprecedented intervention by U.S. government officials into the matters of a publicly traded company.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Reinstatement (Adjective)
बहाली — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Reinstatement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Intervention (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Intervention' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Executive (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Executive' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Effective (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Effective' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO: 6 other CEOs who reclaimed their top positions", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had resigned due to an alleged Chinese spy scandal on November 12, 2026.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO: 6 other CEOs' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO: 6 other C' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO: 6 other C' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had resigned due to an alleged Chinese spy scandal on November 12, 2026." (Hinglish Arth: एनवीडिया के सीईओ जेन्सेन हुआंग ने 12 नवंबर, 2026 को एक कथित चीनी जासूसी घोटाले के कारण इस्तीफा दे दिया था।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO: 6 other CEOs who reclaimed their top positions"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. government officials into the matters of a publicly traded company.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "government officials into the matters of a publicly traded company." (Hinglish Arth: सार्वजनिक रूप से कारोबार करने वाली कंपनी के मामलों में सरकारी अधिकारी।)

articles.title: SAMPADA data claims lower anaemia prevalence in India than previous surveys
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India stopped collecting anaemia data as part of NFHS, after the 5th round. This is the first time anaemia data is being published, after the measure was withdrawn from the NFHS on the grounds that the government intended to conduct a gold-standard test of drawing venous blood, instead of the finger prick test

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Data put out by the Ministry of health and Family Welfare as per the latest SAMPADA (Survey for Assessment of Markers of Population Health, Activity, Diet and Anthropometry), claims a drop in prevalence of anaemia levels across age and gender groups. Among children, it has dropped to 41.8 %, as against the previous figure from National Family Health Survey-5 data of 64%; among women it has dropped to 56% from 57%, and in pregnant women, the current survey puts it at 44% (down from 52%). Among men, SAMPADA says, anaemia has dropped to 19% (from 25% in NFHS-5).
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: health / health and hygiene / survey / government / disease

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India stopped collecting anaemia data as part of NFHS, after the 5th round. articles.title: Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Tamil Nadu BJP chief arrested, tight security in hillock on Karthigai Deepam day
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: All eyes are on Thirupparankundram on the day of Karthigai Deepam festival on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) following the Supreme Court's recent interim order allowing lighting of lamp on the controversial 'deepathoon' atop the hill in Madurai district.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Former Union Minister and BJP leader L. Murugan who was stopped by the police near the Annur bus stop in Coimbatore district, questioned the imposition of restrictions on his movement in Coimbatore district when the prohibitory orders were applicable to Madurai district. Speaking to reporters, Mr. Murugan said: “There is no relevance to the prohibitory orders imposed in Madurai to restrict movement in Coimbatore district. The police have not given me proper information or explained the reason for stopping me,” he said on Tuesday — T.C. Sibi Sreevathson Nainar Nagenthran, who left his home in Tirunelveli district at 2.35 pm for Thirupparankundram, was arrested at Thatchanallur check-post on Tirunelveli City outskirts at 3.15 pm along with a group of party functionaries. Police team led by Assistant Commissioner of Police, Palayamkottai, Rajamurali Ramachandran has been deployed in front of the house of Mr. Nagenthran to stop him from going to Thirupparankundram to participate in Karthigai Deepam festival. Here’s a look at the history and legal background of this long-running dispute. When a row broke out over lighting of Karthigai Deepam at the hill in Madurai, four Sthaneeka Bhattars of the Subramaniaswami Temple testified that the lamp had been lit at the Uchipillaiyar Temple since “time immemorial” The Bhattars conveyed this in a communication written to the temple authorities against the backdrop of a raging row over the Hindu Munnani’s demand for lighting the deepam at a different place. Explore the 30-year-old controversy over Karthigai Deepam lighting at Thirupparankundram, featuring testimonies from Sthaneeka Bhattars. In Thirupparankundram in Madurai, Hindus and Muslims live in camaraderie, but that has not kept the hill, which holds a couple of temples, a dargah, and some Jain beds, out of dispute. Here, we outline the history of judgments involving different petitioners through the years, in an attempt to understand the current crisis.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Explore the legal and political tensions in Thirupparankundram, where communal harmony faces challenges over religious practices and land disputes.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Tamil Nadu BJP chief arrested, tight security in hillock on Karthigai Deepam day

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 05:11:12 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: All eyes are on Thirupparankundram on the day of Karthigai Deepam festival on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) following the Supreme Court's recent interim order allowing lighting of lamp on the controversial 'deepathoon' atop the hill in Madurai district.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Former Union Minister and BJP leader L. Murugan who was stopped by the police near the Annur bus stop in Coimbatore district, questioned the imposition of restrictions on his movement in Coimbatore district when the prohibitory orders were applicable to Madurai district. Speaking to reporters, Mr. Murugan said: “There is no relevance to the prohibitory orders imposed in Madurai to restrict movement in Coimbatore district. The police have not given me proper information or explained the reason for stopping me,” he said on Tuesday — T.C. Sibi Sreevathson Nainar Nagenthran, who left his home in Tirunelveli district at 2.35 pm for Thirupparankundram, was arrested at Thatchanallur check-post on Tirunelveli City outskirts at 3.15 pm along with a group of party functionaries. Police team led by Assistant Commissioner of Police, Palayamkottai, Rajamurali Ramachandran has been deployed in front of the house of Mr. Nagenthran to stop him from going to Thirupparankundram to participate in Karthigai Deepam festival. Here’s a look at the history and legal background of this long-running dispute. When a row broke out over lighting of Karthigai Deepam at the hill in Madurai, four Sthaneeka Bhattars of the Subramaniaswami Temple testified that the lamp had been lit at the Uchipillaiyar Temple since “time immemorial” The Bhattars conveyed this in a communication written to the temple authorities against the backdrop of a raging row over the Hindu Munnani’s demand for lighting the deepam at a different place. Explore the 30-year-old controversy over Karthigai Deepam lighting at Thirupparankundram, featuring testimonies from Sthaneeka Bhattars. In Thirupparankundram in Madurai, Hindus and Muslims live in camaraderie, but that has not kept the hill, which holds a couple of temples, a dargah, and some Jain beds, out of dispute. Here, we outline the history of judgments involving different petitioners through the years, in an attempt to understand the current crisis.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Explore the legal and political tensions in Thirupparankundram, where communal harmony faces challenges over religious practices and land disputes.

articles.title: Bomb threat email targets Diljit Dosanjh’s Bengaluru concert; North Cybercrime Police register FIR
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The email threatened an IED blast during Mr. Dosanjh’s concert as well as at Madavara Metro Station. The email ended with the slogan “Khalistan Zindabad”.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The North Division Cybercrime Police have registered an FIR after unidentified persons sent a bomb threat email warning of an improvised explosive device (IED) blast at singer Diljit Dosanjh’s upcoming concert in Bengaluru on November 29. The concert is scheduled to be held at NICE Grounds in Madavara. The FIR was registered on November 9 based on a complaint filed by Shivaraj M.J., a Police Sub-Inspector attached to Madanayakanahalli police station. According to the FIR, the PSI received a call from the police control room around 3 p.m. on November 9, alerting him to a threatening email sent from the ID weismith3727@gmail.com to the Hubballi-Dharwad Municipal Corporation (HDMC) Commissioner’s official email ID and another address. The email threatened an IED blast during Mr. Dosanjh’s concert as well as at Madavara Metro Station. It also warned people against bringing children to the event and advised them not to travel by Metro. The email ended with the slogan “Khalistan Zindabad”. Following the alert, Mr. Shivaraj contacted the manager of the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (BIEC), who confirmed that Mr. Dosanjh’s concert was scheduled at NICE Grounds on November 29. After bringing the matter to the notice of senior police officers, the PSI lodged a formal complaint with the North Division Cybercrime Police.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The unidentified accused have been booked under Section 66 of the Information Technology Act, 2000, and Sections 351(4) (criminal intimidation by anonymous communication) and 353(1)(b) (statements conducing to public mischief) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Bomb threat email targets Diljit Dosanjh’s Bengaluru concert; North Cybercrime Police register FIR

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 03:24:56 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The email threatened an IED blast during Mr. Dosanjh’s concert as well as at Madavara Metro Station. The email ended with the slogan “Khalistan Zindabad”.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The North Division Cybercrime Police have registered an FIR after unidentified persons sent a bomb threat email warning of an improvised explosive device (IED) blast at singer Diljit Dosanjh’s upcoming concert in Bengaluru on November 29. The concert is scheduled to be held at NICE Grounds in Madavara. The FIR was registered on November 9 based on a complaint filed by Shivaraj M.J., a Police Sub-Inspector attached to Madanayakanahalli police station. According to the FIR, the PSI received a call from the police control room around 3 p.m. on November 9, alerting him to a threatening email sent from the ID weismith3727@gmail.com to the Hubballi-Dharwad Municipal Corporation (HDMC) Commissioner’s official email ID and another address. The email threatened an IED blast during Mr. Dosanjh’s concert as well as at Madavara Metro Station. It also warned people against bringing children to the event and advised them not to travel by Metro. The email ended with the slogan “Khalistan Zindabad”. Following the alert, Mr. Shivaraj contacted the manager of the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (BIEC), who confirmed that Mr. Dosanjh’s concert was scheduled at NICE Grounds on November 29. After bringing the matter to the notice of senior police officers, the PSI lodged a formal complaint with the North Division Cybercrime Police.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The unidentified accused have been booked under Section 66 of the Information Technology Act, 2000, and Sections 351(4) (criminal intimidation by anonymous communication) and 353(1)(b) (statements conducing to public mischief) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Intimidation (Adjective / Verb)
डराना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intimidation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: Security tightened in Madurai for Thirupparankundram Karthigai Deepam festival
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The security blanket follows the promulgation of prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) across Madurai district

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Security has been heavily intensified across Madurai city and around the Thirupparankundram hill, with thousands of police personnel deployed and strict surveillance measures put in place to prevent any untoward incidents during the Maha Karthigai Deepam festival on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). The security blanket follows the promulgation of prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) across Madurai district by District Magistrate and Collector Nishanth Krishna. Thirupparankundram row LIVE: Police security tightened in hillock on Karthigai Deepam day amid ‘deepathoon’ row Acting on intelligence inputs from the City Police Commissioner and the Superintendent of Police, which warned of large-scale mobilisation and potential confrontation between groups over the festival rituals, the administration enforced the restrictions from 9 p.m. on Monday (November 23) until 10 a.m. on November 25. As per the order, all unauthorised public assemblies, demonstrations, processions, and agitations have been banned, and the general public has been strictly prohibited from climbing the Thirupparankundram hill. To enforce the prohibitory orders and maintain law and order, around 6,000 police personnel have been stationed at key strategic points across the city and the hillock. Heavy deployments have been made along the temple steps, the Girivalam path, the nine hill routes, the hilltop, and sensitive zones near the Sri Subramaniya Swamy temple, Kasi Viswanathar temple, Nellithoppu, and the Sikandar Badhusha Dargah. Hundreds of devotees are already walking along the Girivalam path around the Subramaniaswamy temple. Similarly, devotees have also been allowed to offer prayers at the temple. “Our focus is on troublemongers; there is no bar on devotees entering the temple or the Girivalam path,” said a police officer. As a precautionary measure, devotees are not being allowed to climb the hill to offer worship at either the Kasi Viswanathar temple or the Sikandar Badhusha dargah.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Meanwhile, Madurai Collector and Commissioner of Police S. Rajendiran inspected the security arrangements.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Security has been heavily intensified across Madurai city and around the Thirupparankundram hill, with thousands of police personnel deployed and strict surveillance measures put in place to prevent any untoward incidents during the Maha Karthigai Deepam festival on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). Thirupparankundram row LIVE: Police security tightened in hillock on Karthigai Deepam day amid ‘deepathoon’ row Acting on intelligence inputs from the City Police Commissioner and the Superintendent of Police, which warned of large-scale mobilisation and potential confrontation between groups over the festival rituals, the administration enforced the restrictions from 9 p.m. on Monday (November 23) until 10 a.m. on November 25. To enforce the prohibitory orders and maintain law and order, around 6,000 police personnel have been stationed at key strategic points across the city and the hillock. Heavy deployments have been made along the temple steps, the Girivalam path, the nine hill routes, the hilltop, and sensitive zones near the Sri Subramaniya Swamy temple, Kasi Viswanathar temple, Nellithoppu, and the Sikandar Badhusha Dargah. Hundreds of devotees are already walking along the Girivalam path around the Subramaniaswamy temple. Similarly, devotees have also been allowed to offer prayers at the temple. “Our focus is on troublemongers; there is no bar on devotees entering the temple or the Girivalam path,” said a police officer. As a precautionary measure, devotees are not being allowed to climb the hill to offer worship at either the Kasi Viswanathar temple or the Sikandar Badhusha dargah.
