articles.title: Former members say EPG report was ‘highly positive’ for India-Nepal ties
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Their reaction comes a day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group “not relevant”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of the India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group (EPG) “not relevant”, arguing that India will take a “forward looking” approach regarding boundary issues with Nepal, a former member of the EPG has said the report was “highly positive” for both India and Nepal and that it was “odd” that the group did not get a chance to present the report to the Government of India. “The EPG report was produced after extensive research and field visits. We visited Visakhapatnam and other ports that are of interest to Nepal and spoke with many stakeholders before compiling the report and there are interesting recommendations in the report that could be of great use for India and Nepal and it was highly positive for Delhi-Kathmandu relations,” said Mahendra P. Lama, former professor of Jawaharlal Nehru University, who served as a member of the EPG. ALSO WATCH India-Nepal ties: What does Modi-Balen partnership promise? | Above the Fold | Nov 23, 2026 The EPG returned to the spotlight on Monday (November 23, 2026) when Mr. Misri announced in a press conference held after the visit of Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah that New Delhi would adopt a “forward-looking” approach to the border issues. “The leaders have given a direction as part of the overall very forward-looking discussions that have been held today for the foreign secretaries to take the task forward. We will do so in a forward-looking manner, taking inspiration from the vision document and from the directions and indeed the spirit in which the discussions were held. I would say that EPG is in the past. We are not looking backward,” said Mr. Misri in response to a question. He described the EPG report as “not relevant”. Former Nepali ambassador and coordinator of the EPG on the Nepali side, Bhek Bahadur Thapa, described the EPG report as a step forward for the bilateral consultation process. “It was not a unilateral document, it was a document created through bilateral consultation among experts appointed by New Delhi and Kathmandu,” said Mr. Thapa, who has also served as Foreign Minister of Nepal during 2004-05. The EPG report dealing with a broad spectrum of India-Nepal relations, including the Kalapani dispute and the 1950 India-Nepal Friendship Treaty was completed in 2018 but it remained under sealed covers. “It is odd that the report could not be launched here in Delhi. The Nepali side said the EPG report should be unveiled first by the Indian Prime Minister and on the same day we were supposed to return to Kathmandu for the report’s unveiling by the Nepali Prime Minister, “ said Prof. Lama, informing that they made a mistake as Kathmandu could have also unveiled the report first. “Our recommendations now can be accessed by other stakeholders in Kathmandu and I don’t think that is a positive thing,” said Mr. Lama. The EPG was institutionalised according to an understanding that was reached during the delegation-level talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former Nepali Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli in February 2016. The visit of Mr. Oli took place against the backdrop of months-long blockade on Nepal-India border that Kathmandu said was imposed by India but India blamed the Madhesi agitators of Nepal for imposing the blockade that hindered flow of essential items such as cooking gas into Nepal. During the time of its existence, a part of the Institute of Defence Studies and Analyses (IDSA) in Delhi served as the secretariat for the EPG. The then Director General of the IDSA Jayant Prasad was also part of the EPG.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Incidentally, officials who are currently playing key roles in India-Nepal relations were also involved in the EPG process. Former members recounted that the newly appointed Indian ambassador to Nepal Sudhakar Dalela was the Joint Secretary (North) in the Ministry of External Affairs and was part of the EPG process during 2016-18. That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Former members say EPG report was ‘highly positive’ for India-Nepal ties"?

That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.

Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu." (Hinglish Arth: इसके अलावा, भारत में नए नेपाली राजदूत निश्चल नाथ पांडे भी काठमांडू में ईपीजी प्रक्रिया का हिस्सा थे।)

hinglishTracks.en: Their reaction comes a day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group “not relevant”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उनकी यह प्रतिक्रिया विदेश सचिव विक्रम मिस्री द्वारा भारत-नेपाल प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्ति समूह की रिपोर्ट को ''प्रासंगिक नहीं'' बताए जाने के एक दिन बाद आई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of the India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group (EPG) “not relevant”, arguing that India will take a “forward looking” approach regarding boundary issues with Nepal, a former member of the EPG has said the report was “highly positive” for both India and Nepal and that it was “odd” that the group did not get a chance to present the report to the Government of India.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — विदेश सचिव विक्रम मिस्री द्वारा भारत-नेपाल प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्ति समूह (ईपीजी) की रिपोर्ट को "प्रासंगिक नहीं" बताए जाने के एक दिन बाद, उन्होंने तर्क दिया कि भारत नेपाल के साथ सीमा मुद्दों के संबंध में "आगे की ओर देखने वाला" दृष्टिकोण अपनाएगा, ईपीजी के एक पूर्व सदस्य ने कहा है कि रिपोर्ट भारत और नेपाल दोनों के लिए "अत्यधिक सकारात्मक" थी और यह "अजीब" था कि समूह को भारत सरकार को रिपोर्ट पेश करने का मौका नहीं मिला।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The EPG report was produced after extensive research and field visits.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “ईपीजी रिपोर्ट व्यापक शोध और क्षेत्र के दौरे के बाद तैयार की गई थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: We visited Visakhapatnam and other ports that are of interest to Nepal and spoke with many stakeholders before compiling the report and there are interesting recommendations in the report that could be of great use for India and Nepal and it was highly positive for Delhi-Kathmandu relations,” said Mahendra P.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हमने विशाखापत्तनम और नेपाल के लिए रुचि रखने वाले अन्य बंदरगाहों का दौरा किया और रिपोर्ट संकलित करने से पहले कई हितधारकों से बात की और रिपोर्ट में दिलचस्प सिफारिशें हैं जो भारत और नेपाल के लिए बहुत उपयोगी हो सकती हैं और यह दिल्ली-काठमांडू संबंधों के लिए बेहद सकारात्मक थी, ”महेंद्र पी ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Lama, former professor of Jawaharlal Nehru University, who served as a member of the EPG.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लामा, जवाहरलाल नेहरू विश्वविद्यालय के पूर्व प्रोफेसर, जिन्होंने ईपीजी के सदस्य के रूप में कार्य किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: ALSO WATCH India-Nepal ties: What does Modi-Balen partnership promise?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह भी देखें भारत-नेपाल संबंध: मोदी-बालेन साझेदारी क्या वादा करती है?।

hinglishTracks.en: | Above the Fold | Nov 23, 2026
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — | तह के ऊपर | 23 नवंबर, 2026।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPG returned to the spotlight on Monday (November 23, 2026) when Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ईपीजी सोमवार (नवंबर 23, 2026) को फिर से सुर्खियों में आया जब श्री.।

hinglishTracks.en: Misri announced in a press conference held after the visit of Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah that New Delhi would adopt a “forward-looking” approach to the border issues.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मिस्री ने नेपाली प्रधान मंत्री बालेंद्र शाह की यात्रा के बाद आयोजित एक संवाददाता सम्मेलन में घोषणा की कि नई दिल्ली सीमा मुद्दों पर "दूरंदेशी" दृष्टिकोण अपनाएगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The leaders have given a direction as part of the overall very forward-looking discussions that have been held today for the foreign secretaries to take the task forward.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “नेताओं ने विदेश सचिवों को कार्य को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए आज हुई समग्र दूरदर्शी चर्चाओं के एक भाग के रूप में एक दिशा दी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: We will do so in a forward-looking manner, taking inspiration from the vision document and from the directions and indeed the spirit in which the discussions were held.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हम विज़न दस्तावेज़, निर्देशों और वास्तव में जिस भावना से चर्चा हुई उससे प्रेरणा लेते हुए दूरदर्शी तरीके से ऐसा करेंगे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inspiration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Inspiration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: I would say that EPG is in the past.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — मैं कहूंगा कि ईपीजी अतीत में है।।

hinglishTracks.en: We are not looking backward,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हम पीछे मुड़कर नहीं देख रहे हैं,'' श्री ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Misri in response to a question.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मिस्री ने एक सवाल के जवाब में कहा.।

hinglishTracks.en: He described the EPG report as “not relevant”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उन्होंने ईपीजी रिपोर्ट को "प्रासंगिक नहीं" बताया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Former Nepali ambassador and coordinator of the EPG on the Nepali side, Bhek Bahadur Thapa, described the EPG report as a step forward for the bilateral consultation process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पूर्व नेपाली राजदूत और नेपाली पक्ष में ईपीजी के समन्वयक भेक बहादुर थापा ने ईपीजी रिपोर्ट को द्विपक्षीय परामर्श प्रक्रिया के लिए एक कदम आगे बताया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Bilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत। इसके Synonyms हैं: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way।

hinglishTracks.en: “It was not a unilateral document, it was a document created through bilateral consultation among experts appointed by New Delhi and Kathmandu,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “यह एकतरफा दस्तावेज़ नहीं था, यह नई दिल्ली और काठमांडू द्वारा नियुक्त विशेषज्ञों के बीच द्विपक्षीय परामर्श के माध्यम से बनाया गया दस्तावेज़ था,” श्री ने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Bilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत। इसके Synonyms हैं: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way।

hinglishTracks.en: Thapa, who has also served as Foreign Minister of Nepal during 2004-05.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — थापा, जो 2004-05 के दौरान नेपाल के विदेश मंत्री भी रह चुके हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPG report dealing with a broad spectrum of India-Nepal relations, including the Kalapani dispute and the 1950 India-Nepal Friendship Treaty was completed in 2018 but it remained under sealed covers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — कालापानी विवाद और 1950 की भारत-नेपाल मैत्री संधि सहित भारत-नेपाल संबंधों के व्यापक स्पेक्ट्रम से संबंधित ईपीजी रिपोर्ट 2018 में पूरी हो गई थी, लेकिन यह सीलबंद कवर के तहत रही।।

hinglishTracks.en: “It is odd that the report could not be launched here in Delhi.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “यह अजीब है कि रिपोर्ट यहां दिल्ली में लॉन्च नहीं की जा सकी।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Nepali side said the EPG report should be unveiled first by the Indian Prime Minister and on the same day we were supposed to return to Kathmandu for the report’s unveiling by the Nepali Prime Minister, “ said Prof.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नेपाली पक्ष ने कहा कि ईपीजी रिपोर्ट का अनावरण सबसे पहले भारतीय प्रधान मंत्री द्वारा किया जाना चाहिए और उसी दिन हमें नेपाली प्रधान मंत्री द्वारा रिपोर्ट के अनावरण के लिए काठमांडू लौटना था, "प्रोफेसर ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Lama, informing that they made a mistake as Kathmandu could have also unveiled the report first.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लामा ने सूचित करते हुए कहा कि उनसे गलती हुई क्योंकि काठमांडू भी पहले रिपोर्ट का अनावरण कर सकता था।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Our recommendations now can be accessed by other stakeholders in Kathmandu and I don’t think that is a positive thing,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — श्री ने कहा, "हमारी सिफारिशें अब काठमांडू में अन्य हितधारकों तक पहुंच सकती हैं और मुझे नहीं लगता कि यह कोई सकारात्मक बात है।"।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPG was institutionalised according to an understanding that was reached during the delegation-level talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former Nepali Prime Minister K.P.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी और पूर्व नेपाली प्रधान मंत्री के.पी. के बीच प्रतिनिधिमंडल स्तर की वार्ता के दौरान बनी सहमति के अनुसार ईपीजी को संस्थागत बनाया गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: Sharma Oli in February 2016.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — फरवरी 2016 में शर्मा ओली।।

hinglishTracks.en: The visit of Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — श्रीमान का दौरा।

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Former members say EPG report was ‘highly positive’ for India-Nepal ties

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 11:01:38 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Their reaction comes a day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group “not relevant”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of the India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group (EPG) “not relevant”, arguing that India will take a “forward looking” approach regarding boundary issues with Nepal, a former member of the EPG has said the report was “highly positive” for both India and Nepal and that it was “odd” that the group did not get a chance to present the report to the Government of India. “The EPG report was produced after extensive research and field visits. We visited Visakhapatnam and other ports that are of interest to Nepal and spoke with many stakeholders before compiling the report and there are interesting recommendations in the report that could be of great use for India and Nepal and it was highly positive for Delhi-Kathmandu relations,” said Mahendra P. Lama, former professor of Jawaharlal Nehru University, who served as a member of the EPG. ALSO WATCH India-Nepal ties: What does Modi-Balen partnership promise? | Above the Fold | Nov 23, 2026 The EPG returned to the spotlight on Monday (November 23, 2026) when Mr. Misri announced in a press conference held after the visit of Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah that New Delhi would adopt a “forward-looking” approach to the border issues. “The leaders have given a direction as part of the overall very forward-looking discussions that have been held today for the foreign secretaries to take the task forward. We will do so in a forward-looking manner, taking inspiration from the vision document and from the directions and indeed the spirit in which the discussions were held. I would say that EPG is in the past. We are not looking backward,” said Mr. Misri in response to a question. He described the EPG report as “not relevant”. Former Nepali ambassador and coordinator of the EPG on the Nepali side, Bhek Bahadur Thapa, described the EPG report as a step forward for the bilateral consultation process. “It was not a unilateral document, it was a document created through bilateral consultation among experts appointed by New Delhi and Kathmandu,” said Mr. Thapa, who has also served as Foreign Minister of Nepal during 2004-05. The EPG report dealing with a broad spectrum of India-Nepal relations, including the Kalapani dispute and the 1950 India-Nepal Friendship Treaty was completed in 2018 but it remained under sealed covers. “It is odd that the report could not be launched here in Delhi. The Nepali side said the EPG report should be unveiled first by the Indian Prime Minister and on the same day we were supposed to return to Kathmandu for the report’s unveiling by the Nepali Prime Minister, “ said Prof. Lama, informing that they made a mistake as Kathmandu could have also unveiled the report first. “Our recommendations now can be accessed by other stakeholders in Kathmandu and I don’t think that is a positive thing,” said Mr. Lama. The EPG was institutionalised according to an understanding that was reached during the delegation-level talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former Nepali Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli in February 2016. The visit of Mr. Oli took place against the backdrop of months-long blockade on Nepal-India border that Kathmandu said was imposed by India but India blamed the Madhesi agitators of Nepal for imposing the blockade that hindered flow of essential items such as cooking gas into Nepal. During the time of its existence, a part of the Institute of Defence Studies and Analyses (IDSA) in Delhi served as the secretariat for the EPG. The then Director General of the IDSA Jayant Prasad was also part of the EPG.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Incidentally, officials who are currently playing key roles in India-Nepal relations were also involved in the EPG process. Former members recounted that the newly appointed Indian ambassador to Nepal Sudhakar Dalela was the Joint Secretary (North) in the Ministry of External Affairs and was part of the EPG process during 2016-18. That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Consultation (Noun)
परामर्श — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consultation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Inspiration (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Inspiration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: APEPDCL warns consumers of fake electricity bill messages

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Electricity consumers should beware of fraudulent SMS and WhatsApp messages threatening disconnection over alleged unpaid bills, B. Simhachalam Naidu, Superintending Engineer, APEPDCL Visakhapatnam Circle, warned on Tuesday.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: He said that cybercriminals were sending messages from unknown numbers claiming that the electricity supply would be disconnected after 8 p.m. the same day unless pending bills were paid immediately. Consumers should not click the links, call the numbers or make payments mentioned in such messages, he said. Sharing one-time passwords (OTPs), bank account details or other personal information could expose them to fraud. Consumers should verify bills and payment details only through official channels.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For queries or complaints, they may call the toll-free number 1912 or contact APEPDCL through WhatsApp at 9493681912.

📰 APEPDCL warns consumers of fake electricity bill messages

1. Core Context & Background: Electricity consumers should beware of fraudulent SMS and WhatsApp messages threatening disconnection over alleged unpaid bills, B. Simhachalam Naidu, Superintending Engineer, APEPDCL Visakhapatnam Circle, warned on Tuesday.

2. Sharing one-time passwords (OTPs), bank account details or other personal information could expose them to fraud. Consumers should verify bills and payment details only through official channels.

articles.title: Iran rules out talks with U.S. until its seven conditions are met
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Iran also said three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Iran reiterated Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that it would not hold talks with the United States to end the conflict, saying that seven conditions must be met first, though it didn't specify the conditions. Iran also said three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection. Meanwhile, at least nine Palestinians were killed in several Israeli strikes in Gaza, local officials said. Iran's chief negotiator and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that Tehran wouldn't negotiate with the U.S. "until Iran's seven conditions are met,” according to Iranian state television. Iranian authorities haven't publicly stated what those conditions are. But Iranian state media have said they include the lifting of sanctions, the ending of the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports and the release of seized Iranian assets. He also warned that Iran would “shift the geographical scope of the conflict should the enemy make a mistake.” The naval arm of Iran's Revolutionary Guard said the three oil tankers struck the naval mines because they were “in violation of regulations” regarding passage through the Strait of Hormuz. The Guard's navy said in a post on Telegram Monday (November 23, 2026) that the strait “is not a place to test unauthorised routes or to disregard maritime warnings.” It said the tankers were “engulfed in flames” after hitting the mines despite being under U.S. aerial escort.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: At least nine people were killed in four Israeli strikes Monday night (November 23, 2026) and Tuesday morning (November 24, 2026), officials in Gaza said. Among those killed was a senior security official in the Hamas-run government's Interior Ministry.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Iran rules out talks with U.S. until its seven conditions are met

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 11:06:11 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Iran also said three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Iran reiterated Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that it would not hold talks with the United States to end the conflict, saying that seven conditions must be met first, though it didn't specify the conditions. Iran also said three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection. Meanwhile, at least nine Palestinians were killed in several Israeli strikes in Gaza, local officials said. Iran's chief negotiator and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that Tehran wouldn't negotiate with the U.S. "until Iran's seven conditions are met,” according to Iranian state television. Iranian authorities haven't publicly stated what those conditions are. But Iranian state media have said they include the lifting of sanctions, the ending of the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports and the release of seized Iranian assets. He also warned that Iran would “shift the geographical scope of the conflict should the enemy make a mistake.” The naval arm of Iran's Revolutionary Guard said the three oil tankers struck the naval mines because they were “in violation of regulations” regarding passage through the Strait of Hormuz. The Guard's navy said in a post on Telegram Monday (November 23, 2026) that the strait “is not a place to test unauthorised routes or to disregard maritime warnings.” It said the tankers were “engulfed in flames” after hitting the mines despite being under U.S. aerial escort.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: At least nine people were killed in four Israeli strikes Monday night (November 23, 2026) and Tuesday morning (November 24, 2026), officials in Gaza said. Among those killed was a senior security official in the Hamas-run government's Interior Ministry.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A Russian nighttime attack on Zaporizhzhia in southern Ukraine has killed two civilians and wounded 48 others including four children

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Russian nighttime attack on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia killed two civilians and wounded 48 others, including four children, officials said Tuesday (November 24, 2026), as authorities in Ukraine and Libya debated the legitimacy of an unprecedented Ukrainian strike on a Russian warship docked in Benghazi. The Zaporizhzhia glide bomb attack destroyed a private house and partially destroyed a five-story apartment building, according to Mykhailo Semikin, the head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration. The youngest wounded child was less than a year old, he said, adding that the others were ages 4, 6 and 16. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that the Ukrainian military is sending reinforcements to the Zaporizhzhia region, which lies on the roughly 1,250-kilometer (almost 800-mile) front line snaking through eastern and southern Ukraine. Russia and Ukraine have escalated their aerial strikes in recent months even as they engage in U.S.-mediated talks to end the war that began with Moscow’s full-scale invasion of its neighbor nearly five years ago. Mr. Zelenskyy noted in a speech that Ukraine needs 115 billion euros ($126 billion) in aid from foreign countries next year to keep up the fight. Funding of 90 billion euros ($98.7 billion) is already assured, he said, but Ukraine needs to find another 25 billion euros ($27.4 billion). The United Nations says the war has killed close to 18,000 Ukrainian civilians and wounded more than 57,000 others since the all-out war broke out on Feb. 24, 2022. Hundreds of thousands of soldiers from both sides are believed to have died on the battlefield. Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship in Libya Russia says four killed in major Ukraine drone barrage More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in the war, according to an estimate by independent Russian news outlets Meduza and Mediazona, which have been tracking Russian military losses for several years.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: They said that they received a huge dataset earlier this month that was hacked from Russia’s state statistics agency Rosstat by Belarusian activist group Cyber Partisans and a Ukrainian hacker group, Silent Crow. They added projected deaths not yet recorded by Russian authorities.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 A Russian strike on Ukraine kills two, wounds 48 as Kyiv explains its attack in Libya

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 10:44:46 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A Russian nighttime attack on Zaporizhzhia in southern Ukraine has killed two civilians and wounded 48 others including four children

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Russian nighttime attack on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia killed two civilians and wounded 48 others, including four children, officials said Tuesday (November 24, 2026), as authorities in Ukraine and Libya debated the legitimacy of an unprecedented Ukrainian strike on a Russian warship docked in Benghazi. The Zaporizhzhia glide bomb attack destroyed a private house and partially destroyed a five-story apartment building, according to Mykhailo Semikin, the head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration. The youngest wounded child was less than a year old, he said, adding that the others were ages 4, 6 and 16. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that the Ukrainian military is sending reinforcements to the Zaporizhzhia region, which lies on the roughly 1,250-kilometer (almost 800-mile) front line snaking through eastern and southern Ukraine. Russia and Ukraine have escalated their aerial strikes in recent months even as they engage in U.S.-mediated talks to end the war that began with Moscow’s full-scale invasion of its neighbor nearly five years ago. Mr. Zelenskyy noted in a speech that Ukraine needs 115 billion euros ($126 billion) in aid from foreign countries next year to keep up the fight. Funding of 90 billion euros ($98.7 billion) is already assured, he said, but Ukraine needs to find another 25 billion euros ($27.4 billion). The United Nations says the war has killed close to 18,000 Ukrainian civilians and wounded more than 57,000 others since the all-out war broke out on Feb. 24, 2022. Hundreds of thousands of soldiers from both sides are believed to have died on the battlefield. Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship in Libya Russia says four killed in major Ukraine drone barrage More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in the war, according to an estimate by independent Russian news outlets Meduza and Mediazona, which have been tracking Russian military losses for several years.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: They said that they received a huge dataset earlier this month that was hacked from Russia’s state statistics agency Rosstat by Belarusian activist group Cyber Partisans and a Ukrainian hacker group, Silent Crow. They added projected deaths not yet recorded by Russian authorities.

articles.title: Yemen officials say strike on buses, trucks kills 26
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Yemen, one of the world's poorest countries, has become the most active front in the West Asia war, with the Iran-backed Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition exchanging frequent attacks

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: An airstrike on trucks and buses killed 26 people in Yemen's southwest, local officials told AFP on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), as the Houthis and government forces traded blame for the attack. Yemen, one of the world's poorest countries, has become the most active front in the West Asia war, with the Iran-backed Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition exchanging frequent attacks. Two officials said coalition warplanes struck Houthi vehicles on Monday (November 23, 2026) in Lahj province, where the group has advanced in recent weeks towards Aden, the government's interim capital. The aircraft "targeted two vehicles belonging to the Houthis at the moment when a truck and a bus were passing by, in an area considered a front line", one of the officials said, adding 12 Houthi fighters and 14 civilians were killed. The second official confirmed the death toll. Witnesses reported seeing charred bodies at the scene. The Houthis' military spokesman blamed the Saudi air force for the strike, saying it would not go "unanswered". But government forces said the Houthis carried out the attack. The pro-Iran group targeted "civilian vehicles bearing no military markings, on a road that is a vital artery for the population", government forces spokesman Majed al-Nazli said. Separate strikes on Monday (November 23, 2026) killed 17 people and destroyed several buildings in the coastal province of Hodeida, the Houthis' telecommunications ministry said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Yemen, embroiled in more than a decade of civil war, was sucked into the wider U.S.-Iran conflict in July when a truce between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government unravelled.

📰 Yemen officials say strike on buses, trucks kills 26

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Yemen, one of the world's poorest countries, has become the most active front in the West Asia war, with the Iran-backed Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition exchanging frequent attacks

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: An airstrike on trucks and buses killed 26 people in Yemen's southwest, local officials told AFP on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), as the Houthis and government forces traded blame for the attack. Yemen, one of the world's poorest countries, has become the most active front in the West Asia war, with the Iran-backed Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition exchanging frequent attacks. Two officials said coalition warplanes struck Houthi vehicles on Monday (November 23, 2026) in Lahj province, where the group has advanced in recent weeks towards Aden, the government's interim capital. The aircraft "targeted two vehicles belonging to the Houthis at the moment when a truck and a bus were passing by, in an area considered a front line", one of the officials said, adding 12 Houthi fighters and 14 civilians were killed. The second official confirmed the death toll. Witnesses reported seeing charred bodies at the scene. The Houthis' military spokesman blamed the Saudi air force for the strike, saying it would not go "unanswered". But government forces said the Houthis carried out the attack. The pro-Iran group targeted "civilian vehicles bearing no military markings, on a road that is a vital artery for the population", government forces spokesman Majed al-Nazli said. Separate strikes on Monday (November 23, 2026) killed 17 people and destroyed several buildings in the coastal province of Hodeida, the Houthis' telecommunications ministry said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Yemen, embroiled in more than a decade of civil war, was sucked into the wider U.S.-Iran conflict in July when a truce between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government unravelled.

articles.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill seven including senior security official
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ‌Israeli military and the Shin ‌Bet domestic ​security service said in ⁠a joint statement they ‌had struck a senior Hamas member, without identifying ‌him, adding ​that further details would ⁠be provided later

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli airstrikes in Gaza on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) killed seven people including Hamas’s director of internal security, Palestinian officials and Israel said, despite a ceasefire in place since last year. Israel’s military said it “eliminated the terrorist Naim Muhammad Ashour Abu Nahal”, adding that he had been appointed to his post only two months ago but had been part of Hamas for a long time. “His elimination constitutes a blow to the apparatus’s management capabilities,” it said in a joint statement with Israel’s Shin Bet security agency. Israel’s caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defence Minister Israel Katz congratulated security forces, saying “no terrorist will escape the long arm” of their country. Mahmoud Bassal, spokesman for Gaza’s civil defence agency, which operates under Hamas authority, told AFP that several other people were in critical condition following the strike in Gaza City that killed Abu Nahal. The attack comes with talks underway in Israel to form a new government after October legislative elections produced no clear winner. Centrist Gadi Eisenkot is seeking to form a coalition to end Mr. Netanyahu’s long tenure. But Mr. Netanyahu, who has staked his reputation on ensuring security for Israel after the Hamas attack of October 7, 2023, remains in charge of military operations while negotiations continue. Mr. Bassal said earlier on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that three people, including a 17-year-old, had been killed in a separate Israeli airstrike near Gaza City.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Three more were also killed in a third strike on a police station in the Al-Mawasi area in southern Gaza, he added.

articles.title: U.S. blacklists Megaspeed chip firm linked to Nvidia scandal
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The move coincided ‌with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago over revelations of extramarital affairs

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The ​United States on Monday (November 24, 2026) added Singapore-based chip firm Megaspeed, which is closely tied to ‌an espionage investigation involving Nvidia, to its trade blacklist. The addition ​of the company follows revelations that Nvidia CEO Jensen ⁠Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman and Megaspeed's controlling shareholder who is reportedly alleged to be a spy for Beijing. The move coincided ‌with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago over revelations of extramarital affairs. U.S. companies ‌cannot ship goods, software and technology to companies on the ‌entity ⁠list without a license, which is likely to be denied. ⁠Firms on the list can find it harder to get access to U.S.-origin spare parts, software updates or licenses for intellectual property. Megaspeed did not immediately return a request ​for comment. The New York Times ‌reported last month that U.S. authorities had concluded Alice Huang was a Chinese intelligence asset who passed information to Beijing while developing a close relationship with the Nvidia CEO. Reuters could not independently verify ‌the intelligence allegation. China has said the spy accusations are "groundless." Alice ​Huang led Singapore-based Megaspeed, historically a large Nvidia chip customer, people familiar with the matter have said. US authorities ⁠have been investigating Megaspeed since 2024 over possible violations of export controls related to alleged shipments of Nvidia AI chips to China, the U.S. ‌Justice and Commerce departments said this week. Megaspeed has said Alice Huang left the company in August 2025 and that it conducted "lawful business." Jensen Huang admitted to an affair in a November 8 statement following the reports of his relationship with Alice Huang, without referring to her by name.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Nvidia lists Megaspeed as an official cloud partner in its directory. Megaspeed ‌attracted public attention in October 2025, when the New York Times reported it ​was under U.S. investigation over whether it was helping Chinese customers obtain advanced Nvidia chips subject to Washington's export controls.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 U.S. blacklists Megaspeed chip firm linked to Nvidia scandal

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 10:14:57 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The move coincided ‌with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago over revelations of extramarital affairs

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The ​United States on Monday (November 24, 2026) added Singapore-based chip firm Megaspeed, which is closely tied to ‌an espionage investigation involving Nvidia, to its trade blacklist. The addition ​of the company follows revelations that Nvidia CEO Jensen ⁠Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman and Megaspeed's controlling shareholder who is reportedly alleged to be a spy for Beijing. The move coincided ‌with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago over revelations of extramarital affairs. U.S. companies ‌cannot ship goods, software and technology to companies on the ‌entity ⁠list without a license, which is likely to be denied. ⁠Firms on the list can find it harder to get access to U.S.-origin spare parts, software updates or licenses for intellectual property. Megaspeed did not immediately return a request ​for comment. The New York Times ‌reported last month that U.S. authorities had concluded Alice Huang was a Chinese intelligence asset who passed information to Beijing while developing a close relationship with the Nvidia CEO. Reuters could not independently verify ‌the intelligence allegation. China has said the spy accusations are "groundless." Alice ​Huang led Singapore-based Megaspeed, historically a large Nvidia chip customer, people familiar with the matter have said. US authorities ⁠have been investigating Megaspeed since 2024 over possible violations of export controls related to alleged shipments of Nvidia AI chips to China, the U.S. ‌Justice and Commerce departments said this week. Megaspeed has said Alice Huang left the company in August 2025 and that it conducted "lawful business." Jensen Huang admitted to an affair in a November 8 statement following the reports of his relationship with Alice Huang, without referring to her by name.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Nvidia lists Megaspeed as an official cloud partner in its directory. Megaspeed ‌attracted public attention in October 2025, when the New York Times reported it ​was under U.S. investigation over whether it was helping Chinese customers obtain advanced Nvidia chips subject to Washington's export controls.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The ​United States on Monday (November 24, 2026) added Singapore-based chip firm Megaspeed, which is closely tied to ‌an espionage investigation involving Nvidia, to its trade blacklist. The addition ​of the company follows revelations that Nvidia CEO Jensen ⁠Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman and Megaspeed's controlling shareholder who is reportedly alleged to be a spy for Beijing. The move coincided ‌with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago over revelations of extramarital affairs. U.S. companies ‌cannot ship goods, software and technology to companies on the ‌entity ⁠list without a license, which is likely to be denied. ⁠Firms on the list can find it harder to get access to U.S.-origin spare parts, software updates or licenses for intellectual property. The New York Times ‌reported last month that U.S. authorities had concluded Alice Huang was a Chinese intelligence asset who passed information to Beijing while developing a close relationship with the Nvidia CEO. Reuters could not independently verify ‌the intelligence allegation. China has said the spy accusations are "groundless." US authorities ⁠have been investigating Megaspeed since 2024 over possible violations of export controls related to alleged shipments of Nvidia AI chips to China, the U.S. ‌Justice and Commerce departments said this week. Jensen Huang admitted to an affair in a November 8 statement following the reports of his relationship with Alice Huang, without referring to her by name.

articles.title: Core accountability: On core sector performance
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Even a low base effect could not push India’s oil and gas sectors into growth

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The core sector performance in October is a good example of how statistical distortions can create incorrect assessments of the economy. The 10.9% growth rate, a series high, has been celebrated as a sign of the Indian economy’s strength and resilience. There is, no doubt, an aspect of this has been reflected in the numbers, especially to do with infrastructure creation. However, the much more impactful factor behind the high core sector growth was a low base effect. The overall Index of Core Industries grew just 0.8% in October 2025 and so, in relation, the performance in October 2026 looked that much faster. This low base effect is even starker when looking at individual sectors within the index. The coal sector grew at a blistering 23% in October, more than twice its growth rate in the previous month. Yet, a large part of this was propelled by the fact that the sector had contracted nearly 8.5% last October. The rest of the sector’s growth was driven by demand of the electricity and iron ore sectors, or so the data show. The electricity sector also grew at a series high of nearly 22% in October, but on the back of a near-7% contraction in October last year. This base effect anomaly is likely down to the fact that the festive season starts at different but similar points every year. As such, a more accurate reading of the economy will be possible once the data for November are available.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The construction-related sectors seem to have seen genuine growth, a reflection of the government’s ongoing infrastructure push. The iron ore sector’s growth rate accelerated to a three-month high of 26.4% in October 2026 as compared to a growth of 8.7% in the same month last year. Steel grew at 7.3% versus 9.5% last year, and cement by 15.4% versus 5.2%. The economy’s dependence on government spending is not going to ease in the near future, and might even intensify as higher costs eat into companies’ profit margins. The core sector data once again highlighted a major reason for these higher costs — the oil and gas sectors. The crude oil sector shrank by 4.1%, its 22nd consecutive month of contraction. The natural gas sector, similarly, contracted 7.6%, a series-worst performance and the 28th straight month of contraction. A major reason behind high inflation in India is the underperformance of these two sectors and the resultant dependence on imported fuel. It is time the Petroleum Ministry candidly explains — to Parliament in December or to the public directly — why India’s fuel output has been continuously falling. If it is a matter of a lack of resources underground, that is one thing, but the underperformance of oil and gas public sector undertakings is quite another. Accountability needs to be set.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अक्टूबर में कोर सेक्टर का प्रदर्शन इस बात का अच्छा उदाहरण है कि कैसे सांख्यिकीय विकृतियाँ अर्थव्यवस्था का गलत आकलन कर सकती हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The 10.9% growth rate, a series high, has been celebrated as a sign of the Indian economy’s strength and resilience.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 10.9% की विकास दर, जो एक श्रृंखला की उच्चतम स्तर है, को भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था की ताकत और लचीलेपन के संकेत के रूप में मनाया गया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Resilience' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability और Antonyms हैं: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness।

hinglishTracks.en: However, the much more impactful factor behind the high core sector growth was a low base effect.

hinglishTracks.en: The overall Index of Core Industries grew just 0.8% in October 2025 and so, in relation, the performance in October 2026 looked that much faster.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — जवाबदेही तय करने की जरूरत है.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #5 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Core accountability: On core sector performance

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:09:58 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Even a low base effect could not push India’s oil and gas sectors into growth

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The core sector performance in October is a good example of how statistical distortions can create incorrect assessments of the economy. The 10.9% growth rate, a series high, has been celebrated as a sign of the Indian economy’s strength and resilience. There is, no doubt, an aspect of this has been reflected in the numbers, especially to do with infrastructure creation. However, the much more impactful factor behind the high core sector growth was a low base effect. The overall Index of Core Industries grew just 0.8% in October 2025 and so, in relation, the performance in October 2026 looked that much faster. This low base effect is even starker when looking at individual sectors within the index. The coal sector grew at a blistering 23% in October, more than twice its growth rate in the previous month. Yet, a large part of this was propelled by the fact that the sector had contracted nearly 8.5% last October. The rest of the sector’s growth was driven by demand of the electricity and iron ore sectors, or so the data show. The electricity sector also grew at a series high of nearly 22% in October, but on the back of a near-7% contraction in October last year. This base effect anomaly is likely down to the fact that the festive season starts at different but similar points every year. As such, a more accurate reading of the economy will be possible once the data for November are available.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The construction-related sectors seem to have seen genuine growth, a reflection of the government’s ongoing infrastructure push. The iron ore sector’s growth rate accelerated to a three-month high of 26.4% in October 2026 as compared to a growth of 8.7% in the same month last year. Steel grew at 7.3% versus 9.5% last year, and cement by 15.4% versus 5.2%. The economy’s dependence on government spending is not going to ease in the near future, and might even intensify as higher costs eat into companies’ profit margins. The core sector data once again highlighted a major reason for these higher costs — the oil and gas sectors. The crude oil sector shrank by 4.1%, its 22nd consecutive month of contraction. The natural gas sector, similarly, contracted 7.6%, a series-worst performance and the 28th straight month of contraction. A major reason behind high inflation in India is the underperformance of these two sectors and the resultant dependence on imported fuel. It is time the Petroleum Ministry candidly explains — to Parliament in December or to the public directly — why India’s fuel output has been continuously falling. If it is a matter of a lack of resources underground, that is one thing, but the underperformance of oil and gas public sector undertakings is quite another. Accountability needs to be set.

Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Inflation (Noun)
महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए।
✓ Syn: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness  |  ✖ Ant: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession
Underperformance (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Underperformance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Core accountability: On core sector performan' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Core accountability: On core sector performan' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

articles.title: Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval. After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014. But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021. Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form. The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year. The outlay was ₹46,000 crore. In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds. In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लेकिन पर्यावरण मंत्रालय फिर भी आगे बढ़ा और 2021 में मिशन को संशोधित करते समय काफी हद तक वही व्यवस्था बरकरार रखी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक की रिपोर्ट के बाद, 19 नवंबर को, लोक लेखा समिति (पीएसी) ने मिशन की आभासी विफलता और संशोधित फॉर्म के लिए कार्यान्वयन दिशानिर्देश अभी तक जारी नहीं करने के लिए मंत्रालय को फटकार लगाई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मूल 10-वर्षीय दृष्टिकोण वन और वृक्ष आवरण को 5 मिलियन हेक्टेयर (एमएचए) तक विस्तारित करना, अन्य 5 एमएचए पर वन की गुणवत्ता में सुधार करना, 3 मिलियन परिवारों के लिए वन-संबंधी आजीविका में सुधार करना और प्रति वर्ष 60 मिलियन टन तक कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड को अलग करना था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The outlay was ₹46,000 crore.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — परिव्यय ₹46,000 करोड़ था।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 2014 में, कैबिनेट ने 2018 तक पहले दो उद्देश्यों में से प्रत्येक 1.4 एमएचए के लिए ₹13,000 करोड़ की मंजूरी दी, लेकिन प्रतिपूरक वनीकरण निधि प्रबंधन और योजना प्राधिकरण (सीएएमपीए), राष्ट्रीय वनीकरण कार्यक्रम (एनएपी), और एमजीएनआरईजीएस फंड द्वारा 81.5% तक का समर्थन किया जाएगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — 2021-22 में, मंत्रालय ने एनएपी को मिशन में शामिल कर लिया और 2025 के मध्य में, 2030 तक 25 एमएचए पर वन क्षेत्र में सुधार करने के लिए ₹12,190 करोड़ के आवंटन के साथ एक संशोधित संस्करण का अनावरण किया, जिसमें अन्य योजनाओं के माध्यम से 24 एमएचए भी शामिल था।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — व्यवहार में जलवायु समर्थक कार्य में कार्रवाई और न्याय प्रदान करने के लिए सरकारी योजनाओं का विस्तार होना चाहिए, और मंत्रालय को जिम्मेदारियों और लेखा प्रणाली के विभाजन को औपचारिक रूप देना चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — पीएसी की नई मांग कि मंत्रालय एक कार्यान्वयन समय सारिणी प्रस्तुत करे, अपर्याप्त है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 2019 में जल शक्ति अभियान से लेकर 2024 में धरती आबा जनजातीय ग्राम उत्कर्ष अभियान तक, सरकार ने अक्सर मौजूदा योजनाओं के फंड पर महत्वपूर्ण रूप से नए कार्यक्रम शुरू किए हैं - एक अस्थिर नीति जब बाद वाले के भी अपने दायित्व होते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #6 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:07:54 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval. After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014. But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021. Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form. The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year. The outlay was ₹46,000 crore. In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds. In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Responsibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring." (Hinglish Arth: पर्याप्त संसाधनों और निगरानी के साथ जलवायु कार्रवाई समय पर होनी चाहिए)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are..." (Hinglish Arth: जलवायु कार्रवाई समय पर होनी चाहिए, जिसके लिए केंद्र सरकार को पर्याप्त संसाधन समर्पित करने चाहिए और सक्रिय रूप से यह सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि उसकी पहल लागू हो।)

In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

articles.title: Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls. This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore. The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3. As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead. It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors. Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi . The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls. Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address. EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number. These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”. The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR. But the measures are limited. They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States. Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll. In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact. Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test. The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed. The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way. Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses. The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #5 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:31:27 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls. This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore. The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3. As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead. It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors. Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi . The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls. Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address. EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number. These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”. The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR. But the measures are limited. They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States. Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll. In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact. Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test. The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed. The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way. Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses. The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India
