🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Mumbai Police to issue cards with QR code for identity checks

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:22:59 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the measure on November 21, 2026, and cards were distributed to personnel, including traffic police, as part of steps to digitise the force

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Mumbai Police will issue cards with QR code and NFC to personnel, and citizens can scan the code through the Mumbai Police Citizen App to check a person’s photograph, name, date of joining and posting, a measure that follows cases in which fraudsters posed as police and sought money from citizens. Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the measure on Saturday (November 21, 2026), and cards were distributed to personnel, including traffic police, as part of steps to digitise the force. Mumbai Police states that printing has been completed, that personnel will receive cards within a month, that the project covers 51,308 posts and that the government sanctioned about ₹4 crore in February. Personnel must carry the card while on duty, in uniform or not; officers who visit premises where people live, question citizens or approach people during investigations will have to carry it, so that those whom they approach can verify credentials; and a scan through the app directs users to a platform that displays photograph, name, date of joining and posting, which citizens can compare with the person who presents the card. The card will have NFC technology, which personnel with authorisation can use for access to police establishments and for purposes, and the measure comes against a pattern in which criminals use cards that carry police identity and claim to be from crime branch to intimidate people into handing over cash or valuables, with fraudsters stopping citizens during walks and businessmen while claiming to conduct checks. The system could offer a means of verification in scams in which fraudsters pose as police, CBI or officials from law enforcement during video calls and circulate cards with identity to establish credibility, and citizens can check credentials of anyone who claims to be a Mumbai Police officer rather than rely on a card.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Fadnavis said criminals use technology and police must stay ahead, and that technology works without bias and can improve efficiency.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Enforcement (Noun)
सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना।
✓ Syn: Implementation, Execution, Administration  |  ✖ Ant: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver
Authorisation (Noun)
प्राधिकार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Authorisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Verification (Noun)
सत्यापन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Verification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Credibility (Noun)
साख — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Credibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

A. Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the measure on November 21, 2026, and cards were distributed to personnel, including traffic police, as part of steps...

Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the measure on November 21, 2026, and cards were distributed to personnel, including traffic police, as part of steps..." C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.

articles.title: SIR: Voters in Karnataka challenge deletions, say officials asking them to withdraw appeals, file Form 6
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who challenged their deletion, some of whom said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: After the final electoral rolls from the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) were published, several people whose names had been deleted challenged their exclusion. They argued that they were left out despite having completed the entire process, including attending hearings and submitting the required documents. More than 350 appeals have been filed across Karnataka so far. The Deputy Commissioner or District Election Officer (DEO) serves as the first appellate authority in the SIR, while the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) is the second and final appellate authority if the first-stage response is unsatisfactory. According to the CEO’s office, all appeals received so far remain pending or have been disposed of at the first appellate stage. The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who have challenged their deletion. While some said officials advised them to withdraw their appeals and apply afresh through Form 6, others said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal. A few of them said they had since received an Elector’s Photo Identity Card (EPIC) and were told that their names would figure in a supplementary list. While Form 6 applications are accepted throughout the year as part of the ECI’s “continuous updation” process, this route could leave those excluded from the SIR rolls unable to vote in the upcoming local body elections, including the Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) elections. The GBA elections have been directed to be conducted using the SIR final rolls by December, before even the summary revision process begins or a supplementary list is published. Those who have appealed argue that they are not new voters seeking fresh inclusion, but people who have been voting from the same addresses and were wrongly deleted. They also questioned why they should be asked to make a declaration through Form 6 that does not reflect their circumstances, when they had already submitted documents to address the discrepancies flagged during the SIR. Iqbal, a resident of Sarjapura, told The Hindu that he received a notice over “no mapping.” He had mapped his father’s details, whose name is on the electoral roll in Bihar,but his name was still flagged. Mr. Iqbal said that although he had shifted his residence within the city more than five years ago, his EPIC had been updated and he had submitted the required documents. His name was deleted from the final SIR rolls after figuring in the draft list. Several people also said that while the names of all members of their families figured in the draft rolls, some were deleted from the final list. They argued that even when appeals were disposed of, the outcomes were not uniform within families.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sahiba, a resident of Jayanagar, said she was flagged over an anomaly indicating that the age gap between two children was less than nine months. She has twins and submitted their birth certificates to establish this. However, officials subsequently raised a discrepancy in her mother’s name across records. “I explained that it was the same person and that only the spelling had changed during translation. I submitted all my documents as well as my mother’s. But I was then questioned about why I had mapped to my mother and not my father or husband. Both my father and husband are in Saudi Arabia and were not part of the 2002 rolls. Now the officials are telling me to withdraw my appeal and file Form 6,” she said.

Mr. Iqbal said that although he had shifted his residence within the city more than five years ago, his EPIC had been updated and he had submitted the required documents. His name was deleted from the final SIR rolls after figuring in the draft list. Several people also said that while the names of all members of their families figured in the draft rolls, some were deleted from the final list. They argued that even when appeals were disposed of, the outcomes were not uniform within families.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sahiba, a resident of Jayanagar, said she was flagged over an anomaly indicating that the age gap between two children was less than nine months. She has twins and submitted their birth certificates to establish this. However, officials subsequently raised a discrepancy in her mother’s name across records. “I explained that it was the same person and that only the spelling had changed during translation. I submitted all my documents as well as my mother’s. But I was then questioned about why I had mapped to my mother and not my father or husband. Both my father and husband are in Saudi Arabia and were not part of the 2002 rolls. Now the officials are telling me to withdraw my appeal and file Form 6,” she said.

hinglishTracks.en: The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who challenged their deletion, some of whom said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — द हिंदू ने बेंगलुरु में कई लोगों से बात की, जिन्होंने अपने विलोपन को चुनौती दी थी, जिनमें से कुछ ने कहा कि जब उन्होंने अपील के माध्यम से अपने विलोपन को वापस लेने की मांग की तो अधिकारियों ने उनकी ओर से फॉर्म 6 आवेदन जमा किए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: After the final electoral rolls from the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) were published, several people whose names had been deleted challenged their exclusion.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (एसआईआर) से अंतिम मतदाता सूची प्रकाशित होने के बाद, कई लोगों जिनके नाम हटा दिए गए थे, ने अपने बहिष्कार को चुनौती दी।।

hinglishTracks.en: They argued that they were left out despite having completed the entire process, including attending hearings and submitting the required documents.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने तर्क दिया कि सुनवाई में भाग लेने और आवश्यक दस्तावेज जमा करने सहित पूरी प्रक्रिया पूरी करने के बावजूद उन्हें छोड़ दिया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: More than 350 appeals have been filed across Karnataka so far.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — पूरे कर्नाटक में अब तक 350 से अधिक अपीलें दायर की जा चुकी हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Deputy Commissioner or District Election Officer (DEO) serves as the first appellate authority in the SIR, while the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) is the second and final appellate authority if the first-stage response is unsatisfactory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यदि प्रथम चरण की प्रतिक्रिया असंतोषजनक है तो उपायुक्त या जिला निर्वाचन अधिकारी (डीईओ) एसआईआर में प्रथम अपीलीय प्राधिकारी के रूप में कार्य करते हैं, जबकि मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी (सीईओ) दूसरे और अंतिम अपीलीय प्राधिकारी होते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: According to the CEO’s office, all appeals received so far remain pending or have been disposed of at the first appellate stage.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सीईओ कार्यालय के अनुसार, अब तक प्राप्त सभी अपीलें लंबित हैं या प्रथम अपीलीय चरण में उनका निपटारा कर दिया गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who have challenged their deletion.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — द हिंदू ने बेंगलुरु में कई लोगों से बात की जिन्होंने खुद को हटाए जाने को चुनौती दी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: While some said officials advised them to withdraw their appeals and apply afresh through Form 6, others said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — जबकि ईसीआई की "निरंतर अद्यतन" प्रक्रिया के हिस्से के रूप में फॉर्म 6 आवेदन पूरे वर्ष स्वीकार किए जाते हैं, यह मार्ग एसआईआर रोल से बाहर किए गए लोगों को ग्रेटर बेंगलुरु अथॉरिटी (जीबीए) चुनावों सहित आगामी स्थानीय निकाय चुनावों में मतदान करने में असमर्थ बना सकता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Continuous' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: निरंतर — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Continuous' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 SIR: Voters in Karnataka challenge deletions, say officials asking them to withdraw appeals, file Form 6

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 05:11:33 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who challenged their deletion, some of whom said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: After the final electoral rolls from the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) were published, several people whose names had been deleted challenged their exclusion. They argued that they were left out despite having completed the entire process, including attending hearings and submitting the required documents. More than 350 appeals have been filed across Karnataka so far. The Deputy Commissioner or District Election Officer (DEO) serves as the first appellate authority in the SIR, while the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) is the second and final appellate authority if the first-stage response is unsatisfactory. According to the CEO’s office, all appeals received so far remain pending or have been disposed of at the first appellate stage. The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who have challenged their deletion. While some said officials advised them to withdraw their appeals and apply afresh through Form 6, others said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal. A few of them said they had since received an Elector’s Photo Identity Card (EPIC) and were told that their names would figure in a supplementary list. While Form 6 applications are accepted throughout the year as part of the ECI’s “continuous updation” process, this route could leave those excluded from the SIR rolls unable to vote in the upcoming local body elections, including the Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) elections. The GBA elections have been directed to be conducted using the SIR final rolls by December, before even the summary revision process begins or a supplementary list is published. Those who have appealed argue that they are not new voters seeking fresh inclusion, but people who have been voting from the same addresses and were wrongly deleted. They also questioned why they should be asked to make a declaration through Form 6 that does not reflect their circumstances, when they had already submitted documents to address the discrepancies flagged during the SIR. Iqbal, a resident of Sarjapura, told The Hindu that he received a notice over “no mapping.” He had mapped his father’s details, whose name is on the electoral roll in Bihar,but his name was still flagged. Mr. Iqbal said that although he had shifted his residence within the city more than five years ago, his EPIC had been updated and he had submitted the required documents. His name was deleted from the final SIR rolls after figuring in the draft list. Several people also said that while the names of all members of their families figured in the draft rolls, some were deleted from the final list. They argued that even when appeals were disposed of, the outcomes were not uniform within families.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sahiba, a resident of Jayanagar, said she was flagged over an anomaly indicating that the age gap between two children was less than nine months. She has twins and submitted their birth certificates to establish this. However, officials subsequently raised a discrepancy in her mother’s name across records. “I explained that it was the same person and that only the spelling had changed during translation. I submitted all my documents as well as my mother’s. But I was then questioned about why I had mapped to my mother and not my father or husband. Both my father and husband are in Saudi Arabia and were not part of the 2002 rolls. Now the officials are telling me to withdraw my appeal and file Form 6,” she said.

Translation (Noun)
अनुवाद — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Translation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

निरंतर — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Continuous' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

D. The author contends that 'SIR: Voters in Karnataka challenge deletions,' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "SIR: Voters in Karnataka challenge deletions, say officials asking them to withdraw appeals, file Form 6"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Now the officials are telling me to withdraw my appeal and file Form 6,” she said.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: Police in Karnataka prevent Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee chief Y.S. Sharmila from entering disputed property
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The North East Division police of Bengaluru on Sunday stopped Y.S. Sharmila, president of the Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee and sister of YSRCP chief and former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, from entering a disputed property in Yelahanka, citing an interim injunction order issued by a court in Devanahalli

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The North East Division police of Bengaluru on Sunday stopped Y.S. Sharmila, president of the Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee (APCC) and sister of YSRCP chief and former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, from entering a disputed property in Yelahanka, citing an interim injunction order issued by a court in Devanahalli. Ms. Sharmila was stopped by the police at Bagalur Road in Yelahanka while she was travelling towards Yelahanka Palace at Kattigenahalli village in Jala hobli, Bengaluru North taluk. She had arrived at Bengaluru airport from Hyderabad and was proceeding by road to the property. APCC leaders condemn ‘Sakshi report’ against Sharmila, demand public apology She reportedly intended to visit the bungalow along with her mother, Y.S. Vijayalakshmi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The police informed Ms. Sharmila about the interim injunction order, which restrains her from entering the disputed property. The court order also prohibits her family members, agents, representatives and anyone acting on her behalf from obstructing or interfering with the property.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Police in Karnataka prevent Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee chief Y.S. Sharmila from entering disputed property

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:15:50 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The North East Division police of Bengaluru on Sunday stopped Y.S. Sharmila, president of the Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee and sister of YSRCP chief and former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, from entering a disputed property in Yelahanka, citing an interim injunction order issued by a court in Devanahalli

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The North East Division police of Bengaluru on Sunday stopped Y.S. Sharmila, president of the Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee (APCC) and sister of YSRCP chief and former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, from entering a disputed property in Yelahanka, citing an interim injunction order issued by a court in Devanahalli. Ms. Sharmila was stopped by the police at Bagalur Road in Yelahanka while she was travelling towards Yelahanka Palace at Kattigenahalli village in Jala hobli, Bengaluru North taluk. She had arrived at Bengaluru airport from Hyderabad and was proceeding by road to the property. APCC leaders condemn ‘Sakshi report’ against Sharmila, demand public apology She reportedly intended to visit the bungalow along with her mother, Y.S. Vijayalakshmi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The police informed Ms. Sharmila about the interim injunction order, which restrains her from entering the disputed property. The court order also prohibits her family members, agents, representatives and anyone acting on her behalf from obstructing or interfering with the property.

articles.title: Wanted man held after 14 months for mob attack on Delhi police team in Chhatarpur
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The accused, identified as Arbaj Khan alias Baiju, a resident of Chandan Holla village in Chhatarpur, was apprehended by the Special Staff of South district from Village Gadpur in Bhiwadi on November 20, police said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 20-year-old man wanted in connection with a mob attack on police personnel in south Delhi’s Chhatarpur, in which four policemen were injured, has been arrested from Rajasthan after evading arrest for over 14 months, police said on Sunday (November 22, 2026) The accused, identified as Arbaj Khan alias Baiju, a resident of Chandan Holla village in Chhatarpur, was apprehended by the Special Staff of South district from Village Gadpur in Bhiwadi on November 20, following a tip-off received two days earlier, police said. According to the police, the incident took place on September 15, 2025, when a police team performing official duties in Chandan Holla village was attacked by a mob armed with bricks, sticks and stones. Four police personnel sustained injuries in the attack, while the mob also obstructed the team from carrying out its duties. An FIR was registered at Fatehpur Beri police station on September 16, 2025, under sections 221, 132, 121(1), 110, 351(2) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Police said a team of the Special Staff developed the intelligence input about Khan’s whereabouts and conducted an operation in Bhiwadi to apprehend him. He was subsequently brought to Delhi and arrested on November 20 in connection with the case.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The police said the accused had no previous criminal involvement. Further investigation remains under way.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Wanted man held after 14 months for mob attack on Delhi police team in Chhatarpur

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 02:11:35 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The accused, identified as Arbaj Khan alias Baiju, a resident of Chandan Holla village in Chhatarpur, was apprehended by the Special Staff of South district from Village Gadpur in Bhiwadi on November 20, police said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 20-year-old man wanted in connection with a mob attack on police personnel in south Delhi’s Chhatarpur, in which four policemen were injured, has been arrested from Rajasthan after evading arrest for over 14 months, police said on Sunday (November 22, 2026) The accused, identified as Arbaj Khan alias Baiju, a resident of Chandan Holla village in Chhatarpur, was apprehended by the Special Staff of South district from Village Gadpur in Bhiwadi on November 20, following a tip-off received two days earlier, police said. According to the police, the incident took place on September 15, 2025, when a police team performing official duties in Chandan Holla village was attacked by a mob armed with bricks, sticks and stones. Four police personnel sustained injuries in the attack, while the mob also obstructed the team from carrying out its duties. An FIR was registered at Fatehpur Beri police station on September 16, 2025, under sections 221, 132, 121(1), 110, 351(2) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Police said a team of the Special Staff developed the intelligence input about Khan’s whereabouts and conducted an operation in Bhiwadi to apprehend him. He was subsequently brought to Delhi and arrested on November 20 in connection with the case.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The police said the accused had no previous criminal involvement. Further investigation remains under way.

articles.title: Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut alleged at a conference on November 22 that the Bharatiya Janata Party is offering ₹150 crore to Members of Parliament to gain backing for the Delimitation Bill, while also alleging that the government is delaying the session of the Parliament because it lacks the support of 40 to 45 MPs to pass the legislation and is attempting to pressure parties or buy lawmakers. Editorial | Deservedly dead: On the defeat of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 The Delimitation Bill contains a provision to increase the number of seats in the Lok Sabha to 850, which has resulted in a dispute between the National Democratic Alliance and the INDIA bloc, where the National Democratic Alliance states that carrying out delimitation is required by the Constitution to reflect data from a census and to enable reservation for women, while the Opposition demands implementation of 33% reservation for women within a Lok Sabha that contains 543 members. Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification, and he claimed that a Minister from Maharashtra has taken responsibility for the situation and promised to provide funds for the purpose, further alleging that the government has delayed the session of the Parliament because it does not concern itself with the nation, the Constitution, or the Parliament, adding that if parties do not defect, MPs would be purchased, and he referenced a statement regarding a rate on an exchange of ₹150 crore per MP.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Shiv Sena-Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray / Bharatiya Janata Party / National Democratic Alliance

hinglishTracks.en: Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — संजय राउत ने सम्मेलन के दौरान आरोप लगाया कि एक सांसद को अयोग्यता का सामना किए बिना परिसीमन विधेयक का समर्थन करने के लिए पार्टी से अलग होने पर ₹150 करोड़ मिलेंगे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Disqualification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Disqualification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut alleged at a conference on November 22 that the Bharatiya Janata Party is offering ₹150 crore to Members of Parliament to gain backing for the Delimitation Bill, while also alleging that the government is delaying the session of the Parliament because it lacks the support of 40 to 45 MPs to pass the legislation and is attempting to pressure parties or buy lawmakers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शिवसेना (यूबीटी) नेता संजय राउत ने 22 नवंबर को एक सम्मेलन में आरोप लगाया कि भारतीय जनता पार्टी परिसीमन विधेयक पर समर्थन हासिल करने के लिए संसद सदस्यों को ₹150 करोड़ की पेशकश कर रही है, साथ ही यह भी आरोप लगाया कि सरकार संसद के सत्र में देरी कर रही है क्योंकि उसके पास कानून पारित करने के लिए 40 से 45 सांसदों का समर्थन नहीं है और वह पार्टियों पर दबाव बनाने या सांसदों को खरीदने का प्रयास कर रही है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Editorial | Deservedly dead: On the defeat of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — संपादकीय | उचित रूप से मृत: संविधान (131वां संशोधन) विधेयक, 2026 की हार पर। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: The Delimitation Bill contains a provision to increase the number of seats in the Lok Sabha to 850, which has resulted in a dispute between the National Democratic Alliance and the INDIA bloc, where the National Democratic Alliance states that carrying out delimitation is required by the Constitution to reflect data from a census and to enable reservation for women, while the Opposition demands implementation of 33% reservation for women within a Lok Sabha that contains 543 members.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — परिसीमन विधेयक में लोकसभा में सीटों की संख्या 850 तक बढ़ाने का प्रावधान है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप राष्ट्रीय जनतांत्रिक गठबंधन और भारत ब्लॉक के बीच विवाद हुआ है, जहां राष्ट्रीय जनतांत्रिक गठबंधन का कहना है कि जनगणना से डेटा को प्रतिबिंबित करने और महिलाओं के लिए आरक्षण सक्षम करने के लिए संविधान द्वारा परिसीमन करना आवश्यक है, जबकि विपक्ष महिलाओं के लिए 33% आरक्षण लागू करने की मांग करता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:48:09 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut alleged at a conference on November 22 that the Bharatiya Janata Party is offering ₹150 crore to Members of Parliament to gain backing for the Delimitation Bill, while also alleging that the government is delaying the session of the Parliament because it lacks the support of 40 to 45 MPs to pass the legislation and is attempting to pressure parties or buy lawmakers. Editorial | Deservedly dead: On the defeat of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 The Delimitation Bill contains a provision to increase the number of seats in the Lok Sabha to 850, which has resulted in a dispute between the National Democratic Alliance and the INDIA bloc, where the National Democratic Alliance states that carrying out delimitation is required by the Constitution to reflect data from a census and to enable reservation for women, while the Opposition demands implementation of 33% reservation for women within a Lok Sabha that contains 543 members. Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification, and he claimed that a Minister from Maharashtra has taken responsibility for the situation and promised to provide funds for the purpose, further alleging that the government has delayed the session of the Parliament because it does not concern itself with the nation, the Constitution, or the Parliament, adding that if parties do not defect, MPs would be purchased, and he referenced a statement regarding a rate on an exchange of ₹150 crore per MP.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Shiv Sena-Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray / Bharatiya Janata Party / National Democratic Alliance

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Disqualification (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Disqualification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Responsibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure suppo' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill..." A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Shiv Sena-Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray / Bharatiya Janata Party / National Democratic Alliance.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewish settlers in West Bank
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Gadi Eisenkot called the attacks ‘Jewish terrorism’, saying that ‘extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli militant settlers attacked Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank ‌early on Sunday (November 22, 2026), starting fires and scrawling racist graffiti, residents said, prompting an ​accusation of “Jewish terrorism” from the man trying to form an Israeli government. The attacks come nearly a month after an inconclusive election stripped incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his ‌majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has been asked to form a government, though his prospects seem little better. Reuters saw burned-out Palestinian vehicles and walls spray-painted with slogans ‌such as “Revenge” and “Death to Arabs” in villages near Ramallah. No one immediately claimed responsibility and ‌no ⁠injuries were reported. Mr. Eisenkot called the attacks “Jewish terrorism”, saying that “extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations”. He said the policies of Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, ultra-nationalist ministers in Mr. Netanyahu’s cabinet, had “brought the ​area to the brink of anarchy, ‌and the authorities have yet to address the crisis”. Mr. Netanyahu has not yet commented, but Foreign Minister Gideon Saar condemned the attacks by a “handful of extremists” and said they are “against our values and do not represent the law-abiding citizens of Judea and Samaria” — the biblical ‌names for the West Bank. “Israeli authorities are firmly committed to enforcing the law against extremist ​violence,” he told the ELNET Jerusalem Summit. UN bodies and most countries of the world deny the legality of the settlements, which make the ⁠prospect of an independent Palestinian state ever more remote, a position Israel disputes. Israeli police said they opened an investigation into the attacks, while the military condemned the violence, saying soldiers and police ‌had been dispatched to the areas of Deir as-Sudan, Deir Abu Masha’al, Kafr Malik and At-Tuwani “following reports and footage showing vehicles being set on fire and graffiti being sprayed in the area”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Ben-Gvir replied in an X post that Mr. Eisenkot’s condemnation amounted to selling out to Arab parties, which could become part of a possible new government. Mr. Smotrich favours settlement expansion and wants Israel to annex the West Bank.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewish settlers in West Bank

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 03:32:28 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Gadi Eisenkot called the attacks ‘Jewish terrorism’, saying that ‘extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli militant settlers attacked Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank ‌early on Sunday (November 22, 2026), starting fires and scrawling racist graffiti, residents said, prompting an ​accusation of “Jewish terrorism” from the man trying to form an Israeli government. The attacks come nearly a month after an inconclusive election stripped incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his ‌majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has been asked to form a government, though his prospects seem little better. Reuters saw burned-out Palestinian vehicles and walls spray-painted with slogans ‌such as “Revenge” and “Death to Arabs” in villages near Ramallah. No one immediately claimed responsibility and ‌no ⁠injuries were reported. Mr. Eisenkot called the attacks “Jewish terrorism”, saying that “extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations”. He said the policies of Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, ultra-nationalist ministers in Mr. Netanyahu’s cabinet, had “brought the ​area to the brink of anarchy, ‌and the authorities have yet to address the crisis”. Mr. Netanyahu has not yet commented, but Foreign Minister Gideon Saar condemned the attacks by a “handful of extremists” and said they are “against our values and do not represent the law-abiding citizens of Judea and Samaria” — the biblical ‌names for the West Bank. “Israeli authorities are firmly committed to enforcing the law against extremist ​violence,” he told the ELNET Jerusalem Summit. UN bodies and most countries of the world deny the legality of the settlements, which make the ⁠prospect of an independent Palestinian state ever more remote, a position Israel disputes. Israeli police said they opened an investigation into the attacks, while the military condemned the violence, saying soldiers and police ‌had been dispatched to the areas of Deir as-Sudan, Deir Abu Masha’al, Kafr Malik and At-Tuwani “following reports and footage showing vehicles being set on fire and graffiti being sprayed in the area”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Ben-Gvir replied in an X post that Mr. Eisenkot’s condemnation amounted to selling out to Arab parties, which could become part of a possible new government. Mr. Smotrich favours settlement expansion and wants Israel to annex the West Bank.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli militant settlers attacked Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank ‌early on Sunday (November 22, 2026), starting fires and scrawling racist graffiti, residents said, prompting an ​accusation of “Jewish terrorism” from the man trying to form an Israeli government. The attacks come nearly a month after an inconclusive election stripped incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his ‌majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has been asked to form a government, though his prospects seem little better. Reuters saw burned-out Palestinian vehicles and walls spray-painted with slogans ‌such as “Revenge” and “Death to Arabs” in villages near Ramallah. No one immediately claimed responsibility and ‌no ⁠injuries were reported. Mr. Eisenkot called the attacks “Jewish terrorism”, saying that “extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations”. He said the policies of Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, ultra-nationalist ministers in Mr. Netanyahu’s cabinet, had “brought the ​area to the brink of anarchy, ‌and the authorities have yet to address the crisis”. Mr. Netanyahu has not yet commented, but Foreign Minister Gideon Saar condemned the attacks by a “handful of extremists” and said they are “against our values and do not represent the law-abiding citizens of Judea and Samaria” — the biblical ‌names for the West Bank. “Israeli authorities are firmly committed to enforcing the law against extremist ​violence,” he told the ELNET Jerusalem Summit. UN bodies and most countries of the world deny the legality of the settlements, which make the ⁠prospect of an independent Palestinian state ever more remote, a position Israel disputes. Israeli police said they opened an investigation into the attacks, while the military condemned the violence, saying soldiers and police ‌had been dispatched to the areas of Deir as-Sudan, Deir Abu Masha’al, Kafr Malik and At-Tuwani “following reports and footage showing vehicles being set on fire and graffiti being sprayed in the area”.

articles.title: West Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya calls for protest over attacks on Hindus in Bangladesh
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: State BJP chief claims Bangladesh was created on the basis of religion, not language, as Bengali-speaking Hindus are now being persecuted and bearing the consequences of Partition

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: West Bengal Bharatiya Janata Party ( BJP ) president Samik Bhattacharya on Sunday (November 22, 2026) called for a protest against the alleged persecution of Hindus in Bangladesh . “Blood is being shed in Bangladesh, and it is our brothers who are suffering. As a Bengali Hindu, I believe we must take to the streets,” the BJP leader told media persons. Noting that India had played a crucial role in the creation of Bangladesh, the BJP Rajya Sabha MP expressed his opinion that Bangladesh was created on the basis of religion, not on the basis of the Bengali language. “Bangladesh was not created for the sake of language. If it had been, Bengali-speaking Hindus in Bangladesh would not be dying like this today,” he said. Mr. Bhattacharya said that the fundamental question at that time should have been the protection of people and the creation of a democratic environment. Instead, the leadership surrendered to religious fundamentalism, he said. Claiming that the wounds of Partition continued to haunt the subcontinent, the BJP leader said that it was religious minorities, particularly Hindus in Bangladesh, who were bearing the consequences. Blaming Partition on Jawaharlal Nehru and Mahatma Gandhi, Mr. Bhattacharya claimed that had Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose become independent India’s first Prime Minister, he would never have accepted the two-nation theory or allowed the subcontinent to be divided into India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The remarks by the West Bengal BJP leader come at a time when fresh political tensions have erupted in Bangladesh. Attempts at normalising the India-Bangladesh relationship in recent months have been hindered by former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina’s presence in India, where she took refuge on August 5, 2024. Ms. Hasina has announced that she is keen to return to Bangladesh.

articles.title: FSSAI orders prosecution against Bisleri International for unsafe packaged drinking water
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: "The sample was found non-compliant with the prescribed bromate limits and declared unsafe under the FSS Act, 2006," the regulator said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Food regulator FSSAI on Sunday (November 22, 2026) said it has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International, as it found its sample of packaged drinking water "unsafe". In a social media post, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said it has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd regarding "unsafe packaged drinking water". A regulatory sample of "Packaged Drinking Water (other than Mineral Water)" was collected from the premises of Bisleri International for analysis. "The sample was found non-compliant with the prescribed bromate limits and declared unsafe under the FSS Act, 2006," the regulator said. Upon appeal by the company, the sample was sent to the referral food laboratory, which also declared it "unsafe" due to the detection of polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), the regulator added. The findings of the lab established violations relating to unsafe food under the law. Hence, the FSSAI said it has granted sanction to launch prosecution under the FSS Act, 2006, against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd. Through a social media post, FSSAI said it has sanctioned prosecution against a few other companies, including Vasant Masala Pvt Ltd, Tit-Bit Foods India Pvt Ltd, Mimansa Industries and Asha Confectionery. The regulator has suspended the licence of Urmi Lifesciences LLP and Gaur Ayurvedic Store for non-compliance of rules and regulations. FSSAI has also issued a product recall order against Asha Confectionery. The company has been asked to withdraw pre-pack chocolate filled cookies as they were found unsafe.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: During this calendar year, the FSSAI has stepped up enforcement actions against food business operators (FBOs) and also e-commerce companies.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 FSSAI orders prosecution against Bisleri International for unsafe packaged drinking water

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 06:50:38 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: "The sample was found non-compliant with the prescribed bromate limits and declared unsafe under the FSS Act, 2006," the regulator said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Food regulator FSSAI on Sunday (November 22, 2026) said it has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International, as it found its sample of packaged drinking water "unsafe". In a social media post, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said it has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd regarding "unsafe packaged drinking water". A regulatory sample of "Packaged Drinking Water (other than Mineral Water)" was collected from the premises of Bisleri International for analysis. "The sample was found non-compliant with the prescribed bromate limits and declared unsafe under the FSS Act, 2006," the regulator said. Upon appeal by the company, the sample was sent to the referral food laboratory, which also declared it "unsafe" due to the detection of polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), the regulator added. The findings of the lab established violations relating to unsafe food under the law. Hence, the FSSAI said it has granted sanction to launch prosecution under the FSS Act, 2006, against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd. Through a social media post, FSSAI said it has sanctioned prosecution against a few other companies, including Vasant Masala Pvt Ltd, Tit-Bit Foods India Pvt Ltd, Mimansa Industries and Asha Confectionery. The regulator has suspended the licence of Urmi Lifesciences LLP and Gaur Ayurvedic Store for non-compliance of rules and regulations. FSSAI has also issued a product recall order against Asha Confectionery. The company has been asked to withdraw pre-pack chocolate filled cookies as they were found unsafe.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: During this calendar year, the FSSAI has stepped up enforcement actions against food business operators (FBOs) and also e-commerce companies.

सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना।

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Prosecution (Noun)
अभियोग पक्ष — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Prosecution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Compliance (Noun)
अनुपालन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Compliance' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "FSSAI orders prosecution against Bisleri International for unsafe packaged drinking water", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. "The sample was found non-compliant with the prescribed bromate limits and declared unsafe under the FSS Act, 2006," the regulator said.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'FSSAI orders prosecution against Bisleri Interna' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'FSSAI orders prosecution against Bisleri Inte' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: ""The sample was found non-compliant with the prescribed bromate limits and declared unsafe under the FSS Act, 2006," the regulator said." (Hinglish Arth: नियामक ने कहा, "नमूना निर्धारित ब्रोमेट सीमाओं के अनुरूप नहीं पाया गया और एफएसएस अधिनियम, 2006 के तहत असुरक्षित घोषित किया गया।")
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "FSSAI orders prosecution against Bisleri International for unsafe packaged drinking water"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. During this calendar year, the FSSAI has stepped up enforcement actions against food business operators (FBOs) and also e-commerce companies.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "During this calendar year, the FSSAI has stepped up enforcement actions against food business operators (FBOs) and also e-commerce companies." (Hinglish Arth: इस कैलेंडर वर्ष के दौरान, एफएसएसएआई ने खाद्य व्यवसाय ऑपरेटरों (एफबीओ) और ई-कॉमर्स कंपनियों के खिलाफ प्रवर्तन कार्रवाई तेज कर दी है।)

articles.title: Suspected Ukrainian sea drones hit Russian warship at Benghazi naval base, Libyan officials say
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A suspected Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship on Sunday (November 22, 2026) at a naval base in Libya, officials said, the latest attack in the North African nation linked to the Russia-Ukraine war. The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said. They said that several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya, according to an initial investigation into the attack. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, they said. The officials, affiliated with the self-styled Libyan National Army, which controls eastern and southern Libya, spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't allowed to talk with reporters. Libya has been divided since a NATO-backed uprising toppled longtime dictator Muammar Gaddafi, who was later killed, in 2011. A UN-supported government is based in Tripoli, and a rival administration is located in the east. The oil-rich nation remains a focal point for a long-running rivalry between Russia and the West. The eastern Libya-based government said in a statement that the strike on Sunday (November 22) caused an explosion and fire at the base, which was later extinguished. The Almasar satellite television channel aired footage showing a vessel erupting into flames. It said the Libyan navy rescued the crew of the Maltese-flagged ship. A corvette is a warship smaller than a frigate or destroyer and is built to patrol coastal waters and escort other ships. The vessel had docked at the Libyan base for refuelling and supplies as part of a cooperation agreement between Russia and the eastern-based government in Libya, the statement said, without providing details on the vessel or its cargo. A joint investigation was launched with Russia to “uncover the circumstances of the attack, its source, and the party behind it,” the statement said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: No group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack. There was no immediate comment from either Russia or Ukraine.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Suspected Ukrainian sea drones hit Russian warship at Benghazi naval base, Libyan officials say

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:07:13 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A suspected Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship on Sunday (November 22, 2026) at a naval base in Libya, officials said, the latest attack in the North African nation linked to the Russia-Ukraine war. The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said. They said that several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya, according to an initial investigation into the attack. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, they said. The officials, affiliated with the self-styled Libyan National Army, which controls eastern and southern Libya, spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't allowed to talk with reporters. Libya has been divided since a NATO-backed uprising toppled longtime dictator Muammar Gaddafi, who was later killed, in 2011. A UN-supported government is based in Tripoli, and a rival administration is located in the east. The oil-rich nation remains a focal point for a long-running rivalry between Russia and the West. The eastern Libya-based government said in a statement that the strike on Sunday (November 22) caused an explosion and fire at the base, which was later extinguished. The Almasar satellite television channel aired footage showing a vessel erupting into flames. It said the Libyan navy rescued the crew of the Maltese-flagged ship. A corvette is a warship smaller than a frigate or destroyer and is built to patrol coastal waters and escort other ships. The vessel had docked at the Libyan base for refuelling and supplies as part of a cooperation agreement between Russia and the eastern-based government in Libya, the statement said, without providing details on the vessel or its cargo. A joint investigation was launched with Russia to “uncover the circumstances of the attack, its source, and the party behind it,” the statement said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: No group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack. There was no immediate comment from either Russia or Ukraine.

articles.title: Father, daughter detained by ICE at Seattle airport were travelling to family baptism, says lawyer
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A father and daughter detained by masked immigration officers on an airport jet bridge in Seattle, causing chaos in front of other passengers, were heading to a family baptism ceremony in California, their lawyer said Sunday (November 22, 2026). Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday (November 21) used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants. The recordings were widely viewed on social media. The videos show the officers struggling with someone on the ground. The flight, bound for Los Angeles, was delayed. Immigration and Customs Enforcement said in a statement that its officers detained Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, an immigrant from Mexico who, it said, had overstayed his visa "in violation of our nation's laws.” During the confrontation, another passenger “hurled hot coffee on the officers,” the ICE statement said. That woman, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, was determined to be in the U.S. illegally from Mexico and to have also overstayed her visa, ICE said. She could be charged with assaulting a federal officer. The father and daughter were travelling to attend a baptism ceremony in California and are seeking asylum in the U.S., where they have lived since 2015, their lawyer, Olia Catala, told The Associated Press in a telephone interview on Sunday (November 22). They have no criminal record, Ms. Catala said. Ms. Mejia, in her mid-20s, had married a U.S. citizen and filed paperwork for adjustment of her status, the attorney said. Ms. Mejia's husband was accompanying Ms. Mejia and her father when they were detained Saturday (November 21), Ms. Catala added. 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A father and daughter detained by masked immigration officers on an airport jet bridge in Seattle, causing chaos in front of other passengers, were heading to a family baptism ceremony in California, their lawyer said Sunday (November 22, 2026). Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday (November 21) used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants. The recordings were widely viewed on social media. The videos show the officers struggling with someone on the ground. The flight, bound for Los Angeles, was delayed. Immigration and Customs Enforcement said in a statement that its officers detained Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, an immigrant from Mexico who, it said, had overstayed his visa "in violation of our nation's laws.” During the confrontation, another passenger “hurled hot coffee on the officers,” the ICE statement said. That woman, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, was determined to be in the U.S. illegally from Mexico and to have also overstayed her visa, ICE said. She could be charged with assaulting a federal officer. The father and daughter were travelling to attend a baptism ceremony in California and are seeking asylum in the U.S., where they have lived since 2015, their lawyer, Olia Catala, told The Associated Press in a telephone interview on Sunday (November 22). They have no criminal record, Ms. Catala said. Ms. Mejia, in her mid-20s, had married a U.S. citizen and filed paperwork for adjustment of her status, the attorney said. Ms. Mejia's husband was accompanying Ms. Mejia and her father when they were detained Saturday (November 21), Ms. Catala added. The husband was not detained, the attorney said. “They've done everything correctly, and these are educated people," Ms. Catala said of the father and daughter. "She went to college, to university; she worked for a nonprofit. No criminal history [for] any of them. So it's just heartbreaking.” Both were being held at the Northwest ICE Processing Centre in Tacoma, Ms. Catala said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: She said Ms. Mejia was carrying a cup of coffee when the confrontation occurred.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Father, daughter detained by ICE at Seattle airport were travelling to family baptism, says lawyer

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 05:37:05 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A father and daughter detained by masked immigration officers on an airport jet bridge in Seattle, causing chaos in front of other passengers, were heading to a family baptism ceremony in California, their lawyer said Sunday (November 22, 2026). Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday (November 21) used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants. The recordings were widely viewed on social media. The videos show the officers struggling with someone on the ground. The flight, bound for Los Angeles, was delayed. Immigration and Customs Enforcement said in a statement that its officers detained Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, an immigrant from Mexico who, it said, had overstayed his visa "in violation of our nation's laws.” During the confrontation, another passenger “hurled hot coffee on the officers,” the ICE statement said. That woman, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, was determined to be in the U.S. illegally from Mexico and to have also overstayed her visa, ICE said. She could be charged with assaulting a federal officer. The father and daughter were travelling to attend a baptism ceremony in California and are seeking asylum in the U.S., where they have lived since 2015, their lawyer, Olia Catala, told The Associated Press in a telephone interview on Sunday (November 22). They have no criminal record, Ms. Catala said. Ms. Mejia, in her mid-20s, had married a U.S. citizen and filed paperwork for adjustment of her status, the attorney said. Ms. Mejia's husband was accompanying Ms. Mejia and her father when they were detained Saturday (November 21), Ms. Catala added. The husband was not detained, the attorney said. “They've done everything correctly, and these are educated people," Ms. Catala said of the father and daughter. "She went to college, to university; she worked for a nonprofit. No criminal history [for] any of them. So it's just heartbreaking.” Both were being held at the Northwest ICE Processing Centre in Tacoma, Ms. Catala said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: She said Ms. Mejia was carrying a cup of coffee when the confrontation occurred.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

अप्रवासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Immigration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Children who lived in Brazilian neighbourhoods buzzing with a special kind of mosquito were far less likely to catch dengue or another worrisome virus, chikungunya, researchers reported Saturday. The major study of more than 5,700 children in one of the world's dengue hot spots offers new evidence that breeding mosquitoes unable to transmit these viruses can be a viable strategy rather than solely relying on pesticides and trying to avoid getting bitten. In neighbourhoods populated by these so-called Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes, researchers found about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections in schoolchildren compared to similar neighbourhoods — an effect sustained even during Brazil's severe 2024 dengue outbreak, said Dr. Sri Edupuganti of Emory University, part of the international research team. The researchers reported the findings at a meeting of the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene. “This is really exciting,” said David Hamer, a global health expert at Boston University who wasn't involved with the Brazilian study. He predicts that pairing more use of these Wolbachia mosquitoes with existing steps to fight mosquito-borne disease could “knock dengue down to much lower levels” in many places. The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s. Usually in the continental US, dengue is found mostly in people who travelled internationally. But as of Friday, Florida health officials had tallied more than 650 locally acquired cases, about three-quarters of them in Hillsborough County, home to Tampa. Outside the U.S., the nonprofit World Mosquito Program has pioneered the Wolbachia strategy. How it works: Scientists breed mosquitoes to carry a kind of bacteria called Wolbachia. It is harmless to people and common in many insects, although not dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The bacteria dramatically reduce the mosquitoes' ability to transmit certain viruses. Female mosquitoes spread the bacteria to their offspring, so releasing enough of the specially bred insects — males and females — into an area allows Wolbachia to gradually become established in the local mosquito population.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Field trials and other studies in Indonesia and elsewhere have shown the strategy can significantly lower dengue diagnoses. But because people with mild symptoms may not be diagnosed, the new study in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, went further. Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.

hinglishTracks.en: But because people with mild symptoms may not be diagnosed, the new study in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, went further.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लेकिन क्योंकि हल्के लक्षण वाले लोगों का निदान नहीं किया जा सकता है, बेलो होरिज़ोंटे, ब्राज़ील में नया अध्ययन आगे बढ़ गया।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — शोधकर्ताओं ने डेंगू, चिकनगुनिया या जीका वायरस के लक्षणों के लिए रक्त का परीक्षण किया।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:02:29 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Children who lived in Brazilian neighbourhoods buzzing with a special kind of mosquito were far less likely to catch dengue or another worrisome virus, chikungunya, researchers reported Saturday. The major study of more than 5,700 children in one of the world's dengue hot spots offers new evidence that breeding mosquitoes unable to transmit these viruses can be a viable strategy rather than solely relying on pesticides and trying to avoid getting bitten. In neighbourhoods populated by these so-called Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes, researchers found about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections in schoolchildren compared to similar neighbourhoods — an effect sustained even during Brazil's severe 2024 dengue outbreak, said Dr. Sri Edupuganti of Emory University, part of the international research team. The researchers reported the findings at a meeting of the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene. “This is really exciting,” said David Hamer, a global health expert at Boston University who wasn't involved with the Brazilian study. He predicts that pairing more use of these Wolbachia mosquitoes with existing steps to fight mosquito-borne disease could “knock dengue down to much lower levels” in many places. The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s. Usually in the continental US, dengue is found mostly in people who travelled internationally. But as of Friday, Florida health officials had tallied more than 650 locally acquired cases, about three-quarters of them in Hillsborough County, home to Tampa. Outside the U.S., the nonprofit World Mosquito Program has pioneered the Wolbachia strategy. How it works: Scientists breed mosquitoes to carry a kind of bacteria called Wolbachia. It is harmless to people and common in many insects, although not dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The bacteria dramatically reduce the mosquitoes' ability to transmit certain viruses. Female mosquitoes spread the bacteria to their offspring, so releasing enough of the specially bred insects — males and females — into an area allows Wolbachia to gradually become established in the local mosquito population.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Field trials and other studies in Indonesia and elsewhere have shown the strategy can significantly lower dengue diagnoses. But because people with mild symptoms may not be diagnosed, the new study in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, went further. Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
International (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Continental (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Continental' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Scientists report strong new evidence that speci' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Scientists report strong new evidence that sp' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Scientists report strong new evidence that sp' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S." (Hinglish Arth: नवीनतम शोध तब आया है जब फ्लोरिडा असामान्य रूप से बड़े पैमाने पर वायरस के प्रकोप से जूझ रहा है, जो किसी भी यू.एस. में सबसे बड़ा प्रतीत होता है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus." (Hinglish Arth: शोधकर्ताओं ने डेंगू, चिकनगुनिया या जीका वायरस के लक्षणों के लिए रक्त का परीक्षण किया।)

articles.title: Congress MLA Gokul Setia writes letter in blood to Haryana CM, claims briefly detained by police
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Responding to a question about Mr. Setia's alleged detention by police, Mr. Saini said the opposition MLA had neither been arrested nor taken into custody

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress Sirsa MLA Gokul Setia on Sunday (November 22, 2026) claimed he was briefly detained by police as he wanted to give Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini a letter written in blood to highlight multiple civic issues in his constituency. Mr. Saini was in Sirsa to flag off the Kalanwali Youth Marathon, aimed at spreading awareness against drug abuse and encouraging youngsters to take up sports and adopt a healthy lifestyle, and to chair a meeting of the District Grievance Redressal Committee. Mr. Setia had earlier said that he would sit at Shaheed Bhagat Singh Chowk on Sunday (November 22) morning and write a letter using his blood to draw the government's attention to the issues in his constituency. "When people of Sirsa are shedding tears of blood, is it not my duty to stand in their support? Don't we say that we will give our blood and sweat for our people," the MLA told the media on Sunday (November 22). "I was not raising any party slogan, I only wanted to hand over the letter to the chief minister. But I was detained by such heavy police force which they had deployed to stop me," he said. He asked why the government was so scared that heavy police deployment was made to stop him. There are civic issues related to canal water, blocked sewerage system and garbage, he said. "But the government does not see the problems which people are facing," he added. "I am only discharging my duties towards my electorate. What is the condition of Sirsa? People are facing so many problems. The drug problem has grown," the MLA claimed.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Station House Officer (City), Sirsa, Santosh Kumar, said Mr. Setia was told to write a letter with a pen.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सैनी ने कहा कि विपक्षी विधायक को न तो गिरफ्तार किया गया है और न ही हिरासत में लिया गया है। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Opposition' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विरोध — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Opposition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।
