hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह कदम मलप्पुरम की एक 17 वर्षीय लड़की के मामले के बाद उठाया गया है, जिसे पारा युक्त फेयरनेस क्रीम का उपयोग करने के बाद गुर्दे की बीमारी हो गई थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: The girl had used the cream for about a year to remove dark patches on her face before developing health problems.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लड़की ने स्वास्थ्य समस्याएं विकसित होने से पहले अपने चेहरे पर काले धब्बे हटाने के लिए लगभग एक साल तक क्रीम का इस्तेमाल किया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: She was diagnosed with membranous nephropathy, a serious kidney disorder.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उन्हें मेम्ब्रेनस नेफ्रोपैथी नामक एक गंभीर किडनी विकार का पता चला था।।

hinglishTracks.en: Health Minister K.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — स्वास्थ्य मंत्री के.।

hinglishTracks.en: Muraleedharan has sought legal action against social media influencers promoting fake and substandard cosmetics.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — मुरलीधरन ने नकली और घटिया सौंदर्य प्रसाधनों को बढ़ावा देने वाले सोशल मीडिया प्रभावशाली लोगों के खिलाफ कानूनी कार्रवाई की मांग की है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In a letter to Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala, he urged him to direct the State Police Chief to identify those involved and initiate action against them.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — गृह मंत्री रमेश चेन्निथला को लिखे पत्र में उन्होंने उनसे राज्य पुलिस प्रमुख को इसमें शामिल लोगों की पहचान करने और उनके खिलाफ कार्रवाई शुरू करने का निर्देश देने का आग्रह किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Muraleedharan said cosmetics containing excess chemicals were being promoted online through paid endorsements by celebrities and influencers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मुरलीधरन ने कहा कि अतिरिक्त रसायनों वाले सौंदर्य प्रसाधनों को मशहूर हस्तियों और प्रभावशाली लोगों द्वारा भुगतान किए गए समर्थन के माध्यम से ऑनलाइन प्रचारित किया जा रहा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Endorsement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बेचान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Endorsement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: He warned that promoters, sellers and distributors would face legal action.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उन्होंने चेतावनी दी कि प्रमोटरों, विक्रेताओं और वितरकों को कानूनी कार्रवाई का सामना करना पड़ेगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Distribution' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: वितरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Distribution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: He also urged the public not to be misled by such advertisements.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने जनता से ऐसे विज्ञापनों से गुमराह न होने का भी आग्रह किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Meanwhile, the Chief Minister’s office has asked the Health department to consider setting up special squads in all districts to check the sale and distribution of cosmetics containing mercury and other harmful chemicals.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इस बीच, मुख्यमंत्री कार्यालय ने स्वास्थ्य विभाग से पारा और अन्य हानिकारक रसायनों वाले सौंदर्य प्रसाधनों की बिक्री और वितरण की जांच के लिए सभी जिलों में विशेष दस्ते गठित करने पर विचार करने को कहा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Distribution' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: वितरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Distribution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The directive followed a complaint by medical officer K.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह निर्देश चिकित्सा अधिकारी के की शिकायत के बाद दिया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Prathibha, which flagged the difficulty in monitoring online sales, particularly products shipped from other States.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — प्रतिभा, जिसने ऑनलाइन बिक्री, विशेषकर अन्य राज्यों से भेजे जाने वाले उत्पादों की निगरानी में कठिनाई को चिह्नित किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Indian Medical Association (IMA) has urged the Drugs Control department to conduct State-wide inspections, test suspicious cosmetics, seize unlicensed products and prosecute those responsible.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इंडियन मेडिकल एसोसिएशन (आईएमए) ने औषधि नियंत्रण विभाग से राज्यव्यापी निरीक्षण करने, संदिग्ध सौंदर्य प्रसाधनों का परीक्षण करने, बिना लाइसेंस वाले उत्पादों को जब्त करने और जिम्मेदार लोगों पर मुकदमा चलाने का आग्रह किया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Association' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संगठन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Association' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: It also called for a joint surveillance system involving the Health department, police, cybercrime wing and consumer protection authorities.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसने स्वास्थ्य विभाग, पुलिस, साइबर अपराध विंग और उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिकारियों को शामिल करते हुए एक संयुक्त निगरानी प्रणाली का भी आह्वान किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Surveillance' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: निगरानी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Surveillance' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The State branch of the Indian Association of Dermatologists, Venereologists and Leprologists (IADVL) has warned against fairness creams promising instant results.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इंडियन एसोसिएशन ऑफ डर्मेटोलॉजिस्ट, वेनेरोलॉजिस्ट और लेप्रोलॉजिस्ट (आईएडीवीएल) की राज्य शाखा ने तुरंत परिणाम देने का वादा करने वाली फेयरनेस क्रीम के खिलाफ चेतावनी दी है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Association' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संगठन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Association' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: IADVL president Vinod Nair and secretary Ebi Chacko said manufacturers often failed to disclose ingredients, which could include mercury and other chemicals harmful to the skin and internal organs.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — आईएडीवीएल के अध्यक्ष विनोद नायर और सचिव एबी चाको ने कहा कि निर्माता अक्सर उन सामग्रियों का खुलासा करने में विफल रहते हैं, जिनमें पारा और त्वचा और आंतरिक अंगों के लिए हानिकारक अन्य रसायन शामिल हो सकते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Meanwhile, hepatologist Cyriac Abby Philips, popularly known as The LiverDoc on social media, named 10 influencers who allegedly promoted Vevoria’s F-Tune fairness cream.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इस बीच, सोशल मीडिया पर द लिवरडॉक के नाम से मशहूर हेपेटोलॉजिस्ट सिरिएक एबी फिलिप्स ने 10 प्रभावशाली लोगों के नाम बताए, जिन्होंने कथित तौर पर वेवोरिया की एफ-ट्यून फेयरनेस क्रीम का प्रचार किया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: They were Jasmin Jaffar, Appu Vava, Amaya Vishnu, Sneha, Sukanya Harish, Reneesha Rahiman, Arunya Binu, Dilana Shinod, Asna Asharaf and Haritha Nambiar.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — वे थे जैस्मीन जाफर, अप्पू वावा, अमाया विष्णु, स्नेहा, सुकन्या हरीश, रेनीशा रहिमन, अरुण्या बीनू, दिलाना शिनोद, असना अशरफ और हरिता नांबियार।।

hinglishTracks.en: Philips also urged Amazon to delist the cream, which was still available on the platform at ₹689 for a 30-gm pack.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — फिलिप्स ने अमेज़ॅन से क्रीम को डीलिस्ट करने का भी आग्रह किया, जो अभी भी प्लेटफॉर्म पर 30 ग्राम पैक के लिए 689 रुपये में उपलब्ध था।।

hinglishTracks.en: He noted that Vevoria had removed the cream’s Instagram profile.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्होंने नोट किया कि वेवोरिया ने क्रीम की इंस्टाग्राम प्रोफ़ाइल हटा दी थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Actress and social media influencer Reneesha Rahiman has defended her decision to promote the fairness cream.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — अभिनेत्री और सोशल मीडिया इन्फ्लुएंसर रेनीशा रहीमन ने फेयरनेस क्रीम को बढ़ावा देने के अपने फैसले का बचाव किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Rahiman said she had tested the product on her own skin before endorsing it on social media.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — रहिमन ने कहा कि उन्होंने सोशल मीडिया पर उत्पाद का समर्थन करने से पहले अपनी त्वचा पर इसका परीक्षण किया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Endorsement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बेचान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Endorsement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: She said she was shocked to learn that the girl had developed serious health problems after using the cream.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उन्होंने कहा कि वह यह जानकर हैरान रह गईं कि क्रीम का उपयोग करने के बाद लड़की को गंभीर स्वास्थ्य समस्याएं हो गईं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Rahiman said she was not someone who promoted products simply for money and had agreed to the endorsement only after using the cream and being satisfied with the results.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — रहिमन ने कहा कि वह उन लोगों में से नहीं थीं जो केवल पैसे के लिए उत्पादों का प्रचार करती थीं और क्रीम का उपयोग करने और परिणामों से संतुष्ट होने के बाद ही विज्ञापन के लिए सहमत हुई थीं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Endorsement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बेचान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Endorsement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The promotion was carried out about a year ago, she said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्होंने बताया कि यह प्रमोशन करीब एक साल पहले किया गया था।।

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Influencers, sellers of unsafe cosmetics to face legal action

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:22:50 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The move follows the case of a 17-year-old girl from Malappuram who developed kidney disease after using a fairness cream laced with mercury

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The crackdown on spurious cosmetics continued in Keralam on Monday, with demands growing for State-wide inspections and legal action against those involved in their sale and promotion. The move follows the case of a 17-year-old girl from Malappuram who developed kidney disease after using a fairness cream laced with mercury. The girl had used the cream for about a year to remove dark patches on her face before developing health problems. She was diagnosed with membranous nephropathy, a serious kidney disorder. Health Minister K. Muraleedharan has sought legal action against social media influencers promoting fake and substandard cosmetics. In a letter to Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala, he urged him to direct the State Police Chief to identify those involved and initiate action against them. Mr. Muraleedharan said cosmetics containing excess chemicals were being promoted online through paid endorsements by celebrities and influencers. He warned that promoters, sellers and distributors would face legal action. He also urged the public not to be misled by such advertisements. Meanwhile, the Chief Minister’s office has asked the Health department to consider setting up special squads in all districts to check the sale and distribution of cosmetics containing mercury and other harmful chemicals. articles.title: Oil and gas production to pick up in 4-5 years as recent measures take effect, Petroleum Ministry says
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In a note accessed by The Hindu, the Ministry has said that the oil and gas industry has a long gestation period and so exploration and finance decisions taken more than a decade ago are affecting the industry now

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The government expects domestic oil and gas production to pick up in the next 4-5 years as several steps taken in the recent past begin to bear fruit in an industry typically characterised by long gestation periods, The Hindu has learnt. According to an analysis by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, the current contraction in domestic oil and gas production is due to factors that took place more than a decade ago. However, since then, the government has taken steps such as increasing drilling and exploration to record levels, changing laws and rules to provide stable terms to explorers, and opening new avenues for exploration. “The steps taken in the last few years — new acreage, record drilling, deepwater wells and the revival of Mumbai High — will start showing up in production over the next three to four years,” the note asserted. “That is the nature of this sector: the decisions of one decade decide the output of the next.” The note also argues that now, unlike earlier, the profits of oil and gas companies upstream companies like ONGC and Oil India are being used to fund exploration rather than subsidies. “Until 2015, ONGC and Oil India were made to fund a large share of the subsidy on diesel, LPG and kerosene, through discounts on the crude they sold to oil marketing companies,” the note said. According to data with the Ministry, ONGC paid ₹49,421 crore towards this subsidy in 2012-13 against a profit of ₹20,926 crore, and in 2013-14 paid ₹56,384 crore towards this subsidy against a net profit of ₹22,095 crore. “In both years ONGC gave away more than twice what it earned,” the note said. “Money that should have gone into finding new oil and gas went into keeping retail prices down. This burden was ended from 2015-16. ONGC now keeps its earnings and has sharply raised its spending on exploration.” According to the latest data on the Index of Core Industries, the oil and gas sectors have contracted continuously for 22 and 28 months, respectively.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “In this sector it takes five to ten years to go from awarding a block to first production,” a note prepared by the Ministry and accessed by The Hindu said. “Output in 2026 is the result of what was, and was not, done a decade ago.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #14 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Oil and gas production to pick up in 4-5 years as recent measures take effect, Petroleum Ministry says

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 08:32:08 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In a note accessed by The Hindu, the Ministry has said that the oil and gas industry has a long gestation period and so exploration and finance decisions taken more than a decade ago are affecting the industry now

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The government expects domestic oil and gas production to pick up in the next 4-5 years as several steps taken in the recent past begin to bear fruit in an industry typically characterised by long gestation periods, The Hindu has learnt. According to an analysis by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, the current contraction in domestic oil and gas production is due to factors that took place more than a decade ago. However, since then, the government has taken steps such as increasing drilling and exploration to record levels, changing laws and rules to provide stable terms to explorers, and opening new avenues for exploration. “The steps taken in the last few years — new acreage, record drilling, deepwater wells and the revival of Mumbai High — will start showing up in production over the next three to four years,” the note asserted. “That is the nature of this sector: the decisions of one decade decide the output of the next.” The note also argues that now, unlike earlier, the profits of oil and gas companies upstream companies like ONGC and Oil India are being used to fund exploration rather than subsidies. “Until 2015, ONGC and Oil India were made to fund a large share of the subsidy on diesel, LPG and kerosene, through discounts on the crude they sold to oil marketing companies,” the note said. According to data with the Ministry, ONGC paid ₹49,421 crore towards this subsidy in 2012-13 against a profit of ₹20,926 crore, and in 2013-14 paid ₹56,384 crore towards this subsidy against a net profit of ₹22,095 crore. “In both years ONGC gave away more than twice what it earned,” the note said. “Money that should have gone into finding new oil and gas went into keeping retail prices down. This burden was ended from 2015-16. ONGC now keeps its earnings and has sharply raised its spending on exploration.” According to the latest data on the Index of Core Industries, the oil and gas sectors have contracted continuously for 22 and 28 months, respectively.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “In this sector it takes five to ten years to go from awarding a block to first production,” a note prepared by the Ministry and accessed by The Hindu said. “Output in 2026 is the result of what was, and was not, done a decade ago.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Production (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Production' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Gestation (Noun)
गर्भधारण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Gestation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "Oil and gas production to pick up in 4-5 years as recent measures take effect, Petroleum Ministry says", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. In a note accessed by The Hindu, the Ministry has said that the oil and gas industry has a long gestation period and so exploration and finance...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Oil and gas production to pick up in 4-5 years a' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Oil and gas production to pick up in 4-5 year' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Oil and gas production to pick up in 4-5 year' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "In a note accessed by The Hindu, the Ministry has said that the oil and gas industry has a long gestation period and so exploration and finance..." (Hinglish Arth: द हिंदू द्वारा प्राप्त एक नोट में, मंत्रालय ने कहा है कि तेल और गैस उद्योग की विकास अवधि लंबी है और इसलिए एक दशक से अधिक पहले लिए गए अन्वेषण और वित्त निर्णय अब उद्योग को प्रभावित कर रहे हैं।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Oil and gas production to pick up in 4-5 years as recent measures take effect, Petroleum Ministry says"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. “Output in 2026 is the result of what was, and was not, done a decade ago.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“Output in 2026 is the result of what was, and was not, done a decade ago." (Hinglish Arth: “2026 में आउटपुट एक दशक पहले जो किया गया था और जो नहीं किया गया था उसका परिणाम है।)

articles.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after U.S. government input
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nvidia on Monday (November 23, 2026) reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive after input from senior U.S. government officials left its board confident he posed no national security risk, less than two weeks after the co-founder resigned due to an alleged spy scandal. U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision.” The board voted unanimously to bring Mr. Huang back as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately, after a series of meetings left directors satisfied with his “candor and ability to lead”, the company said in a statement. Nvidia did not name the government officials it consulted or say what they told the board. The decision came three days after Mr. Trump publicly urged Nvidia to take Mr. Huang back, calling him “one of the truly most brilliant minds in the world” and saying he would “love to see Jensen be given a second chance.” Mr. Trump described Mr. Huang as “a good man” who “made some bad decisions" and said the company should rehire him “if they were smart". Mr. Huang had offered to return, but the board initially refused. Board chair Harvey Jones had said on an earnings call last week that directors had unanimously accepted his resignation and did “not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO". “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment,” Mr. Huang said, thanking the board, staff, shareholders and his family. “I can’t wait to get back to work.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Huang, 63, stepped down on November 12 following reports that he had a relationship with Alice Huang — no relation — a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, a company that bought billions of dollars’ worth of Nvidia chips.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after U.S. government input

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:45:03 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nvidia on Monday (November 23, 2026) reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive after input from senior U.S. government officials left its board confident he posed no national security risk, less than two weeks after the co-founder resigned due to an alleged spy scandal. U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed the move as a “correct and proper decision.” The board voted unanimously to bring Mr. Huang back as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately, after a series of meetings left directors satisfied with his “candor and ability to lead”, the company said in a statement. Nvidia did not name the government officials it consulted or say what they told the board. The decision came three days after Mr. Trump publicly urged Nvidia to take Mr. Huang back, calling him “one of the truly most brilliant minds in the world” and saying he would “love to see Jensen be given a second chance.” Mr. Trump described Mr. Huang as “a good man” who “made some bad decisions" and said the company should rehire him “if they were smart". Mr. Huang had offered to return, but the board initially refused. Board chair Harvey Jones had said on an earnings call last week that directors had unanimously accepted his resignation and did “not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO". “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment,” Mr. Huang said, thanking the board, staff, shareholders and his family. “I can’t wait to get back to work.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Huang, 63, stepped down on November 12 following reports that he had a relationship with Alice Huang — no relation — a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, a company that bought billions of dollars’ worth of Nvidia chips.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nvidia on Monday (November 23, 2026) reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive after input from senior U.S. government officials left its board confident he posed no national security risk, less than two weeks after the co-founder resigned due to an alleged spy scandal. Nvidia did not name the government officials it consulted or say what they told the board. The decision came three days after Mr. Trump publicly urged Nvidia to take Mr. Huang back, calling him “one of the truly most brilliant minds in the world” and saying he would “love to see Jensen be given a second chance.” Mr. Trump described Mr. Huang as “a good man” who “made some bad decisions" and said the company should rehire him “if they were smart". Mr. Huang had offered to return, but the board initially refused. Board chair Harvey Jones had said on an earnings call last week that directors had unanimously accepted his resignation and did “not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO". “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment,” Mr. Huang said, thanking the board, staff, shareholders and his family. “I can’t wait to get back to work.”

articles.title: Tajikistan becomes fourth country to withdraw from International Criminal Court
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger announced their exits the previous year, ‌denouncing the Court as an instrument of "neocolonial ​repression"

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tajikistan has become the fourth country to ​formally begin withdrawing from the International Criminal Court ‌since the U.S. launched what it called ​a diplomatic push to "dismantle the ⁠court", the Presidency of the Court's governing body said in a statement on Monday (November 23, 2026). Tajikistan joins Chad, ‌Venezuela and Naoero, a tiny Pacific island nation formerly known as Nauru, which ‌have also announced their withdrawal since the ‌U.S. ⁠called for countries to leave the court ⁠in July. In March this year, the Court criticised Tajikistan for failing to arrest Russian President Vladimir Putin, wanted ​by the ICC for ‌alleged war crimes in Ukraine, when he visited Tajikistan in 2025. Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger announced their exits the previous year, ‌denouncing the Court as an instrument of "neocolonial ​repression". The ICC is the world's permanent war crimes tribunal, which prosecutes ⁠individuals accused of genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes and the crime of aggression when national courts ‌are unwilling or unable to act. In a statement published on Monday (November 23, 2026), the Presidency of the ICC's governing body said the move to formally start the one-year process of withdrawing from the ICC risks undermining the collective ‌pursuit of justice and weakens global efforts to end impunity. ​The statement also said the decision to withdraw does not release a state ⁠from obligations incurred while it was still a party ⁠to the treaty.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Currently the ICC has 125 member states but that ‌still includes the seven states that have formally started the withdrawal process, which takes a ​year to complete.

• 1. Core Context & Background: Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger announced their exits the previous year, ‌denouncing the Court as an instrument of "neocolonial ​repression"
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tajikistan has become the fourth country to ​formally begin withdrawing from the International Criminal Court ‌since the U.S. launched what it called ​a diplomatic push to "dismantle the ⁠court", the Presidency of the Court's governing body said in a statement on Monday (November 23, 2026). Tajikistan joins Chad, ‌Venezuela and Naoero, a tiny Pacific island nation formerly known as Nauru, which ‌have also announced their withdrawal since the ‌U.S. ⁠called for countries to leave the court ⁠in July. In March this year, the Court criticised Tajikistan for failing to arrest Russian President Vladimir Putin, wanted ​by the ICC for ‌alleged war crimes in Ukraine, when he visited Tajikistan in 2025. Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger announced their exits the previous year, ‌denouncing the Court as an instrument of "neocolonial ​repression". The ICC is the world's permanent war crimes tribunal, which prosecutes ⁠individuals accused of genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes and the crime of aggression when national courts ‌are unwilling or unable to act. In a statement published on Monday (November 23, 2026), the Presidency of the ICC's governing body said the move to formally start the one-year process of withdrawing from the ICC risks undermining the collective ‌pursuit of justice and weakens global efforts to end impunity. ​The statement also said the decision to withdraw does not release a state ⁠from obligations incurred while it was still a party ⁠to the treaty.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Currently the ICC has 125 member states but that ‌still includes the seven states that have formally started the withdrawal process, which takes a ​year to complete.

articles.title: Nepal PM India visit highlights: PM Modi announces offshore campus of IIT in Nepal
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Establishment of offshore IIT campus in Nepal, scholarships to Nepali students in India, a development package of over ₹15,000 crore for Nepal announced

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah flag off the ‘Saryu-Kamala Express’ via video conferencing, connecting Ayodhya with Janakpur. Under the leadership of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, the new direct rail link marks a significant step towards strengthening India-Nepal cultural and religious ties, boosting pilgrimage tourism and facilitating travel for devotees. Regular weekly services will begin on November 28. Prime Minister Narendra Modi gifted his Nepalese counterpart, Balendra Shah, a Kalamkari Sampoorna Ramayana painting, a Banarasi brocade stole in a Sadeli box, and ‘Gangajal’. Mr. Modi gifted Mr. Shah the painting, depicting major episodes of Lord Rama’s journey, from his birth and exile to his victory over Ravana and return to Ayodhya, official sources said. Hand-painted on cotton in the traditional Srikalahasthi style of Andhra Pradesh using a bamboo pen and natural dyes, the artwork showcases India’s rich heritage of storytelling, devotion and traditional craftsmanship. It also symbolises the enduring spiritual and cultural bond between India and Nepal, connecting Ayodhya, the land of Lord Rama, with Janakpur, revered as the birthplace of Goddess Sita, and reflecting the shared heritage, friendship and values of the two nations. Nepali PM Balendra Shah called on President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi. Nepal PM Balen Shah, on an X post said, “With the aim of further strengthening our centuries-old historical relationship and making it relevant to the times, we have held in-depth, meaningful and far-reaching discussions on the many dimensions of our bilateral relations. During these discussions, important agreements on various areas of Nepal–India cooperation were reached, and infrastructure projects were inaugurated and had their foundation stones laid”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “As a dependable and trusted neighbour, India consistently stood as the first responder in times of natural disasters and difficult times in Nepal,” Nepal PM Balen Shah said, adding that mutual respect, steadfast trust and unbroken goodwill are the bedrock of the relations.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Nepal PM India visit highlights: PM Modi announces offshore campus of IIT in Nepal

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:27:34 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Establishment of offshore IIT campus in Nepal, scholarships to Nepali students in India, a development package of over ₹15,000 crore for Nepal announced

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah flag off the ‘Saryu-Kamala Express’ via video conferencing, connecting Ayodhya with Janakpur. Under the leadership of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, the new direct rail link marks a significant step towards strengthening India-Nepal cultural and religious ties, boosting pilgrimage tourism and facilitating travel for devotees. Regular weekly services will begin on November 28. Prime Minister Narendra Modi gifted his Nepalese counterpart, Balendra Shah, a Kalamkari Sampoorna Ramayana painting, a Banarasi brocade stole in a Sadeli box, and ‘Gangajal’. Mr. Modi gifted Mr. Shah the painting, depicting major episodes of Lord Rama’s journey, from his birth and exile to his victory over Ravana and return to Ayodhya, official sources said. Hand-painted on cotton in the traditional Srikalahasthi style of Andhra Pradesh using a bamboo pen and natural dyes, the artwork showcases India’s rich heritage of storytelling, devotion and traditional craftsmanship. It also symbolises the enduring spiritual and cultural bond between India and Nepal, connecting Ayodhya, the land of Lord Rama, with Janakpur, revered as the birthplace of Goddess Sita, and reflecting the shared heritage, friendship and values of the two nations. Nepali PM Balendra Shah called on President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi. Nepal PM Balen Shah, on an X post said, “With the aim of further strengthening our centuries-old historical relationship and making it relevant to the times, we have held in-depth, meaningful and far-reaching discussions on the many dimensions of our bilateral relations. During these discussions, important agreements on various areas of Nepal–India cooperation were reached, and infrastructure projects were inaugurated and had their foundation stones laid”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “As a dependable and trusted neighbour, India consistently stood as the first responder in times of natural disasters and difficult times in Nepal,” Nepal PM Balen Shah said, adding that mutual respect, steadfast trust and unbroken goodwill are the bedrock of the relations.

articles.title: Rotary Club of Madras partners with Tamil Nadu government to vaccinate 3.5 lakh girls against HPV
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The club aims to vaccinate one million children as it approaches its centenary in 2028-29

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Rotary Club of Madras (RCM) and the Tamil Nadu government have entered into a partnership to provide human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination to 3.5 lakh adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer. The partnership, valued at approximately ₹200 crore, is among the largest public-private initiatives for HPV vaccination in India. It was acknowledged in the presence of Darez Ahamed, Secretary, Health and Family Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu government. High-risk HPV infections account for more than 95% of cervical cancer cases. HPV vaccination during adolescence helps prevent infections caused by high-risk HPV types and reduces the risk of cervical cancer later in life.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Bobby Krishna, president of the Rotary Club of Madras, said the partnership was part of Rotary’s efforts to work with the government on large-scale vaccination programmes. The club also aims to vaccinate one million children as it approaches its centenary in 2028-29, building on its work under the Polio Plus programme.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Rotary Club of Madras partners with Tamil Nadu government to vaccinate 3.5 lakh girls against HPV

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 08:37:17 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The club aims to vaccinate one million children as it approaches its centenary in 2028-29

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Rotary Club of Madras (RCM) and the Tamil Nadu government have entered into a partnership to provide human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination to 3.5 lakh adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer. The partnership, valued at approximately ₹200 crore, is among the largest public-private initiatives for HPV vaccination in India. It was acknowledged in the presence of Darez Ahamed, Secretary, Health and Family Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu government. High-risk HPV infections account for more than 95% of cervical cancer cases. HPV vaccination during adolescence helps prevent infections caused by high-risk HPV types and reduces the risk of cervical cancer later in life.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Bobby Krishna, president of the Rotary Club of Madras, said the partnership was part of Rotary’s efforts to work with the government on large-scale vaccination programmes. The club also aims to vaccinate one million children as it approaches its centenary in 2028-29, building on its work under the Polio Plus programme.

articles.title: Severe anaemia affects less than 2% of population: ICMR survey
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: SAMPADA covered more than 2 lakh individuals from over 81,000 households across 183 districts in 35 States and Union Territories

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: According to a survey by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), severe anaemia was observed in less than 2% of people in the majority of age groups. The Survey for Assessment of Markers of Population Health, Activity, Diet and Anthropometry (SAMPADA) 2023-2025 was released on Monday (November 23, 2026). It showed that children aged 12-59 months had 42% anaemia prevalence, adolescent girls aged 10-19 years had anaemia prevalence of 46%, adolescent boys aged 10-19 years and men aged 20–59 years had 22-23% anaemia prevalence, whereas women of reproductive age had 56% prevalence. The survey also found that mild anaemia constitutes a substantial proportion of the overall anaemia burden. “SAMPADA provides nationally representative estimates of anaemia across children, adolescents, adults, pregnant and lactating women and older adults, together with detailed information on micronutrient deficiencies to evaluate potential causes of anaemia. It is encouraging that prevalence of anaemia is lower in SAMPADA compared to previous national surveys. The comprehensive anaemia profiling in the SAMPADA survey provides an evidence base to strengthen the ongoing national efforts towards Anaemia Mukt Bharat,” said Rajiv Bahl, secretary, Department of Health Research. The report noted that about half of anaemic women, including pregnant and lactating women, adolescent girls, and children, have mild anaemia, indicating considerably lower risk of serious health consequences than moderate or severe anaemia. Anaemia prevalence is much lower among adolescent boys, adult and older men, and even among those affected, three-fourths have only mild anaemia, said the release issued by the Union Health Ministry. SAMPADA represents one of the largest and most comprehensive nutrition surveys undertaken globally. The survey covered more than 2 lakh individuals from over 81,000 households across 183 districts in 35 States and Union Territories. More than 1.7 lakh blood samples were analysed for haemoglobin estimation across different age, sex, and physiological groups. “A major strength of SAMPADA is the use of gold standard method of venous blood sampling and automated analysers for haemoglobin estimation, providing greater accuracy and reproducibility. In a sub-sample, the survey also assessed iron status, folate, vitamin B12, together with inflammatory biomarkers C-reactive protein (CRP) and alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (AGP) to obtain national level prevalence estimates,” the release said. Iron deficiency accounts for about half of the anaemia cases in women, adolescent girls, and children, said the report. The micronutrient assessment showed that although iron deficiency is the predominant contributor to anaemia in vulnerable population groups, it accounts for about half of the overall anaemia burden, highlighting the need to simultaneously address multiple nutritional and non-nutritional causes of anaemia, including infections, hemoglobinopathies, and inflammation related to chronic disease.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: However, the prevalence of vitamin B12 and folate deficiency was similar in both anaemic and non-anaemic individuals across population groups, indicating a limited contribution of these micronutrient deficiencies to anaemia in India.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Severe anaemia affects less than 2% of population: ICMR survey

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 09:45:22 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: SAMPADA covered more than 2 lakh individuals from over 81,000 households across 183 districts in 35 States and Union Territories

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: According to a survey by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), severe anaemia was observed in less than 2% of people in the majority of age groups. The Survey for Assessment of Markers of Population Health, Activity, Diet and Anthropometry (SAMPADA) 2023-2025 was released on Monday (November 23, 2026). It showed that children aged 12-59 months had 42% anaemia prevalence, adolescent girls aged 10-19 years had anaemia prevalence of 46%, adolescent boys aged 10-19 years and men aged 20–59 years had 22-23% anaemia prevalence, whereas women of reproductive age had 56% prevalence. The survey also found that mild anaemia constitutes a substantial proportion of the overall anaemia burden. “SAMPADA provides nationally representative estimates of anaemia across children, adolescents, adults, pregnant and lactating women and older adults, together with detailed information on micronutrient deficiencies to evaluate potential causes of anaemia. It is encouraging that prevalence of anaemia is lower in SAMPADA compared to previous national surveys. The comprehensive anaemia profiling in the SAMPADA survey provides an evidence base to strengthen the ongoing national efforts towards Anaemia Mukt Bharat,” said Rajiv Bahl, secretary, Department of Health Research. The report noted that about half of anaemic women, including pregnant and lactating women, adolescent girls, and children, have mild anaemia, indicating considerably lower risk of serious health consequences than moderate or severe anaemia. Anaemia prevalence is much lower among adolescent boys, adult and older men, and even among those affected, three-fourths have only mild anaemia, said the release issued by the Union Health Ministry. SAMPADA represents one of the largest and most comprehensive nutrition surveys undertaken globally. The survey covered more than 2 lakh individuals from over 81,000 households across 183 districts in 35 States and Union Territories. More than 1.7 lakh blood samples were analysed for haemoglobin estimation across different age, sex, and physiological groups. “A major strength of SAMPADA is the use of gold standard method of venous blood sampling and automated analysers for haemoglobin estimation, providing greater accuracy and reproducibility. In a sub-sample, the survey also assessed iron status, folate, vitamin B12, together with inflammatory biomarkers C-reactive protein (CRP) and alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (AGP) to obtain national level prevalence estimates,” the release said. Iron deficiency accounts for about half of the anaemia cases in women, adolescent girls, and children, said the report. The micronutrient assessment showed that although iron deficiency is the predominant contributor to anaemia in vulnerable population groups, it accounts for about half of the overall anaemia burden, highlighting the need to simultaneously address multiple nutritional and non-nutritional causes of anaemia, including infections, hemoglobinopathies, and inflammation related to chronic disease.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: However, the prevalence of vitamin B12 and folate deficiency was similar in both anaemic and non-anaemic individuals across population groups, indicating a limited contribution of these micronutrient deficiencies to anaemia in India.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: SAMPADA covered more than 2 lakh individuals from over 81,000 households across 183 districts in 35 States and Union Territories
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: According to a survey by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), severe anaemia was observed in less than 2% of people in the majority of age groups. The Survey for Assessment of Markers of Population Health, Activity, Diet and Anthropometry (SAMPADA) 2023-2025 was released on Monday (November 23, 2026). It showed that children aged 12-59 months had 42% anaemia prevalence, adolescent girls aged 10-19 years had anaemia prevalence of 46%, adolescent boys aged 10-19 years and men aged 20–59 years had 22-23% anaemia prevalence, whereas women of reproductive age had 56% prevalence. The survey also found that mild anaemia constitutes a substantial proportion of the overall anaemia burden. “SAMPADA provides nationally representative estimates of anaemia across children, adolescents, adults, pregnant and lactating women and older adults, together with detailed information on micronutrient deficiencies to evaluate potential causes of anaemia. It is encouraging that prevalence of anaemia is lower in SAMPADA compared to previous national surveys. The comprehensive anaemia profiling in the SAMPADA survey provides an evidence base to strengthen the ongoing national efforts towards Anaemia Mukt Bharat,” said Rajiv Bahl, secretary, Department of Health Research. The report noted that about half of anaemic women, including pregnant and lactating women, adolescent girls, and children, have mild anaemia, indicating considerably lower risk of serious health consequences than moderate or severe anaemia. Anaemia prevalence is much lower among adolescent boys, adult and older men, and even among those affected, three-fourths have only mild anaemia, said the release issued by the Union Health Ministry. SAMPADA represents one of the largest and most comprehensive nutrition surveys undertaken globally. The survey covered more than 2 lakh individuals from over 81,000 households across 183 districts in 35 States and Union Territories. More than 1.7 lakh blood samples were analysed for haemoglobin estimation across different age, sex, and physiological groups. “A major strength of SAMPADA is the use of gold standard method of venous blood sampling and automated analysers for haemoglobin estimation, providing greater accuracy and reproducibility. In a sub-sample, the survey also assessed iron status, folate, vitamin B12, together with inflammatory biomarkers C-reactive protein (CRP) and alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (AGP) to obtain national level prevalence estimates,” the release said. Iron deficiency accounts for about half of the anaemia cases in women, adolescent girls, and children, said the report. The micronutrient assessment showed that although iron deficiency is the predominant contributor to anaemia in vulnerable population groups, it accounts for about half of the overall anaemia burden, highlighting the need to simultaneously address multiple nutritional and non-nutritional causes of anaemia, including infections, hemoglobinopathies, and inflammation related to chronic disease.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: However, the prevalence of vitamin B12 and folate deficiency was similar in both anaemic and non-anaemic individuals across population groups, indicating a limited contribution of these micronutrient deficiencies to anaemia in India.

articles.title: Rift emerges in LPST stir
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A rebel group from within the LPST rank-holders has accused the agitating leadership of sabotaging their job prospects by turning down four out of five demands that the State government had agreed to consider

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Even as the agitating Lower Primary School Teacher (LPST) rank-holders’ association denounced the government on Monday for “not taking adequate interest in expediting the discussions” and reaching a settlement, a rebel group from within the LPST rank-holders has accused the agitating leadership of sabotaging their job prospects by turning down four out of five demands that the State government had agreed to consider. On Monday, while talking to mediapersons, S. Valarmathi, who has been spearheading the 141-day agitation of LPST rank-holders in front of the Secretariat, accused the government of hypocrisy and of adopting a condescending stance towards the agitators. However, on the same day, a dissenting group of LPST rank-holders -- led by Ajmal Shah and Iqbal -- held a press conference and alleged that the current leadership leading the protest has abandoned the core interests of the rank-holders. Ajmal Shah alleged that though the government had agreed to meet four out of the five demands raised by rank-holders, the agitators’ leadership was taking an adamant stance and not accepting these concessions. He said that it was unprecedented for a strike leadership to reject demands that the government was ready to fulfill. He claimed that the strike leadership was now going off a tangent raising new demands and that its position now did not reflect the core demand of securing jobs for as many rank-holders as possible. He said that the 11,000-odd candidates in the LPST rank list had not authorised the leadership to take this stance and reject the concessions offered by the government. He said that the last round of talks had effectively been a private meeting between Ms. Valarmathy and the Education Minister. Securing retirement vacancies alone will not suffice, he added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: There was never any guarantee that everyone in the rank list would secure jobs and now the rank-holders were being made to protest in the name of retirement vacancies that do not exist. The rank-holders are being misled. At the district-level, less than 4 per cent of candidates would be able to secure jobs through retirement vacancies, the rebel faction alleged.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Rift emerges in LPST stir

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:23:36 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A rebel group from within the LPST rank-holders has accused the agitating leadership of sabotaging their job prospects by turning down four out of five demands that the State government had agreed to consider

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Even as the agitating Lower Primary School Teacher (LPST) rank-holders’ association denounced the government on Monday for “not taking adequate interest in expediting the discussions” and reaching a settlement, a rebel group from within the LPST rank-holders has accused the agitating leadership of sabotaging their job prospects by turning down four out of five demands that the State government had agreed to consider. On Monday, while talking to mediapersons, S. Valarmathi, who has been spearheading the 141-day agitation of LPST rank-holders in front of the Secretariat, accused the government of hypocrisy and of adopting a condescending stance towards the agitators. However, on the same day, a dissenting group of LPST rank-holders -- led by Ajmal Shah and Iqbal -- held a press conference and alleged that the current leadership leading the protest has abandoned the core interests of the rank-holders. Ajmal Shah alleged that though the government had agreed to meet four out of the five demands raised by rank-holders, the agitators’ leadership was taking an adamant stance and not accepting these concessions. He said that it was unprecedented for a strike leadership to reject demands that the government was ready to fulfill. He claimed that the strike leadership was now going off a tangent raising new demands and that its position now did not reflect the core demand of securing jobs for as many rank-holders as possible. He said that the 11,000-odd candidates in the LPST rank list had not authorised the leadership to take this stance and reject the concessions offered by the government. He said that the last round of talks had effectively been a private meeting between Ms. Valarmathy and the Education Minister. Securing retirement vacancies alone will not suffice, he added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: There was never any guarantee that everyone in the rank list would secure jobs and now the rank-holders were being made to protest in the name of retirement vacancies that do not exist. The rank-holders are being misled. At the district-level, less than 4 per cent of candidates would be able to secure jobs through retirement vacancies, the rebel faction alleged.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Conference (Noun)
सम्मेलन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Conference' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Retirement (Adjective)
निवृत्ति — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Retirement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Rift emerges in LPST stir", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. A rebel group from within the LPST rank-holders has accused the agitating leadership of sabotaging their job prospects by turning down four out of...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Rift emerges in LPST stir' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Rift emerges in LPST stir' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Rift emerges in LPST stir' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A rebel group from within the LPST rank-holders has accused the agitating leadership of sabotaging their job prospects by turning down four out of..." (Hinglish Arth: एलपीएसटी रैंक-धारकों के भीतर से एक विद्रोही समूह ने आंदोलनकारी नेतृत्व पर पांच में से चार मांगों को ठुकराकर उनकी नौकरी की संभावनाओं को नुकसान पहुंचाने का आरोप लगाया है, जिन पर राज्य सरकार विचार करने के लिए सहमत हुई थी।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Rift emerges in LPST stir"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. At the district-level, less than 4 per cent of candidates would be able to secure jobs through retirement vacancies, the rebel faction alleged.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: KSRTC to start Bengaluru–Sabarimala Volvo service
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) will introduce an Airavat Volvo bus service between Bengaluru and Nilakkal, the base camp for Sabarimala, from November 28 for devotees travelling to the hill shrine.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The online fare from Bengaluru to Nilakkal is ₹1,980, while the fare from Mysuru to Nilakkal is ₹1,880. The bus will leave Shantinagar Bus Stand in Bengaluru at 1:50 p.m. and reach Nilakkal at 6:45 a.m. the next day, travelling via Mysuru, Kozhikode, Thrissur, Kottayam and Erumeli.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On the return journey, the bus will leave Nilakkal at 6 p.m. and reach Bengaluru at 10 a.m. the next day via Mysuru.

articles.title: Rohingya refugee dies after former associate allegedly sets him ablaze in Bengaluru
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The incident comes close on the heels of the death of 44-year-old ragpicker Syed Haji, who also succumbed to burn injuries after being set ablaze in Girinagar on November 18

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 33-year-old Rohingya refugee and ragpicker, who was allegedly set ablaze by his former associate over personal rivalry in Jakkur on November 18, succumbed to his burn injuries at Victoria Hospital on Saturday night, before his dying declaration could be recorded by the police. The deceased, Zaheed Hussain, had sustained severe burns after Faisal, who was once close to him, allegedly poured petrol on him and set him on fire while they were travelling in an autorickshaw. The shocking incident comes close on the heels of the death of 44-year-old ragpicker Syed Haji, who also succumbed to burn injuries after being set ablaze in Girinagar on November 18. According to the police, Zaheed lived with his two children and his elderly, ailing mother in a labour shed behind Haj Bhavan near Bellahalli Cross. Faisal had allegedly taken him to Jakkur on the pretext of offering him work for an hour for ₹200. The two reportedly collected scrap and were returning in an autorickshaw, with Faisal driving while Zaheed was asleep on the scrap material loaded at the rear. They reportedly stopped at a liquor shop, consumed alcohol and resumed their journey. Zaheed later told those attending to him that Faisal had allegedly sprinkled petrol on him from a bottle and set him on fire while continuing to drive the autorickshaw. As the vehicle moved ahead, Zaheed screamed for help. A passerby noticed him engulfed in flames, alerted others and helped stop the vehicle. He was initially taken to a nearby hospital in Yelahanka and subsequently shifted to the burns ward at Victoria Hospital for advanced treatment. Faisal had fled by then. Before his condition deteriorated, Zaheed reportedly told those around him that he had developed a rivalry with Faisal after discontinuing work with him following personal differences. However, he could not give a formal dying declaration to the police before succumbing to his injuries. The Sampigehalli police have registered an unnatural death report under Section 194(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), based on a complaint filed by his mother, Khulshida. Police records state that Zaheed died at around 10 p.m. on November 21 while undergoing treatment at Victoria Hospital.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: However, in her complaint, Khulshida said that the family had no suspicion regarding his death, as Zaheed had initially told them that he did not know how he had caught fire. However, his subsequent account implicating Faisal has raised questions about the circumstances surrounding the incident.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Rohingya refugee dies after former associate allegedly sets him ablaze in Bengaluru

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:10:00 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The incident comes close on the heels of the death of 44-year-old ragpicker Syed Haji, who also succumbed to burn injuries after being set ablaze in Girinagar on November 18

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 33-year-old Rohingya refugee and ragpicker, who was allegedly set ablaze by his former associate over personal rivalry in Jakkur on November 18, succumbed to his burn injuries at Victoria Hospital on Saturday night, before his dying declaration could be recorded by the police. The deceased, Zaheed Hussain, had sustained severe burns after Faisal, who was once close to him, allegedly poured petrol on him and set him on fire while they were travelling in an autorickshaw. The shocking incident comes close on the heels of the death of 44-year-old ragpicker Syed Haji, who also succumbed to burn injuries after being set ablaze in Girinagar on November 18. According to the police, Zaheed lived with his two children and his elderly, ailing mother in a labour shed behind Haj Bhavan near Bellahalli Cross. Faisal had allegedly taken him to Jakkur on the pretext of offering him work for an hour for ₹200. The two reportedly collected scrap and were returning in an autorickshaw, with Faisal driving while Zaheed was asleep on the scrap material loaded at the rear. They reportedly stopped at a liquor shop, consumed alcohol and resumed their journey. Zaheed later told those attending to him that Faisal had allegedly sprinkled petrol on him from a bottle and set him on fire while continuing to drive the autorickshaw. As the vehicle moved ahead, Zaheed screamed for help. A passerby noticed him engulfed in flames, alerted others and helped stop the vehicle. He was initially taken to a nearby hospital in Yelahanka and subsequently shifted to the burns ward at Victoria Hospital for advanced treatment. Faisal had fled by then. Before his condition deteriorated, Zaheed reportedly told those around him that he had developed a rivalry with Faisal after discontinuing work with him following personal differences. However, he could not give a formal dying declaration to the police before succumbing to his injuries. The Sampigehalli police have registered an unnatural death report under Section 194(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), based on a complaint filed by his mother, Khulshida. Police records state that Zaheed died at around 10 p.m. on November 21 while undergoing treatment at Victoria Hospital.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: However, in her complaint, Khulshida said that the family had no suspicion regarding his death, as Zaheed had initially told them that he did not know how he had caught fire. However, his subsequent account implicating Faisal has raised questions about the circumstances surrounding the incident.

Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Declaration (Adjective / Verb)
घोषणा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Declaration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Treatment (Adjective)
इलाज — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Treatment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

articles.title: West Bengal CM announces ₹2,000 monthly allowance for unemployed youths
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Bhorsha Karmasuchi replaces the Yuva Sathi scheme announced by Mamata Banerjee in February, ahead of the State Assembly Election

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal Government will provide a monthly allowance of ₹2,000 from January to unemployed graduates and diploma holders from government vocational institutions and Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) under the ‘Bhorsha Karmasuchi’ scheme, Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari declared on Monday (November 23, 2026). Unemployed non-graduates will also receive ₹1,500 monthly under the scheme. The BJP Government’s Bhorsha Karmasuchi programme has replaced the Trinamool Congress’ ‘Banglar Yuva Sathi’ scheme, which was announced by Mamata Banerjee in February, months ahead of the State Assembly election. After a cabinet meeting at the State Secretariat, the CM said that allowances would be increased to ₹3,000 and ₹2,000, respectively, from 2028-29, as promised in the BJP’s manifesto. Eligible candidates under the scheme must be between 21 and 45 years of age, he added. A family can have a maximum of two beneficiaries, and those receiving the ₹3,000 monthly allowance under the Annapurna Yojana will not be eligible. Mr. Adhikari also said that the verification of the 54 lakh existing beneficiaries under the previous government’s scheme would be completed by December 31. Those who have not applied so far can submit their applications through the ‘Apnar Sarkar Apnar Pashe’ programme. The applications will be forwarded to the Youth Welfare Department, he added. The allowance will be transferred directly to beneficiaries’ bank accounts in the second week of every month. The Bhorsha Karmasuchi scheme will be formally launched at an event in February. “We urge our youngsters to be patient for some time, as we have initiated many new schemes, cleared arrears and taken on huge financial responsibilities. We will keep our commitments,” Mr. Adhikari told reporters after a Cabinet meeting. The CM said that the Government also has a target of hiring 1 lakh people by early 2027. “The Cabinet has already given its approval to 10,146 fresh recruitments. Most of them will happen in the Home Department. At least 650 sub-inspectors will also be recruited. Other recruitments will take place in the Tourism Department, Panchayats, and Urban Development Departments,” said the CM.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also said that he is set to hand over 1,331 appointment letters in December.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 West Bengal CM announces ₹2,000 monthly allowance for unemployed youths

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:09:13 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Bhorsha Karmasuchi replaces the Yuva Sathi scheme announced by Mamata Banerjee in February, ahead of the State Assembly Election

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal Government will provide a monthly allowance of ₹2,000 from January to unemployed graduates and diploma holders from government vocational institutions and Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) under the ‘Bhorsha Karmasuchi’ scheme, Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari declared on Monday (November 23, 2026). Unemployed non-graduates will also receive ₹1,500 monthly under the scheme. The BJP Government’s Bhorsha Karmasuchi programme has replaced the Trinamool Congress’ ‘Banglar Yuva Sathi’ scheme, which was announced by Mamata Banerjee in February, months ahead of the State Assembly election. After a cabinet meeting at the State Secretariat, the CM said that allowances would be increased to ₹3,000 and ₹2,000, respectively, from 2028-29, as promised in the BJP’s manifesto. Eligible candidates under the scheme must be between 21 and 45 years of age, he added. A family can have a maximum of two beneficiaries, and those receiving the ₹3,000 monthly allowance under the Annapurna Yojana will not be eligible. Mr. Adhikari also said that the verification of the 54 lakh existing beneficiaries under the previous government’s scheme would be completed by December 31. Those who have not applied so far can submit their applications through the ‘Apnar Sarkar Apnar Pashe’ programme. The applications will be forwarded to the Youth Welfare Department, he added. The allowance will be transferred directly to beneficiaries’ bank accounts in the second week of every month. The Bhorsha Karmasuchi scheme will be formally launched at an event in February. “We urge our youngsters to be patient for some time, as we have initiated many new schemes, cleared arrears and taken on huge financial responsibilities. We will keep our commitments,” Mr. Adhikari told reporters after a Cabinet meeting. The CM said that the Government also has a target of hiring 1 lakh people by early 2027. “The Cabinet has already given its approval to 10,146 fresh recruitments. Most of them will happen in the Home Department. At least 650 sub-inspectors will also be recruited. Other recruitments will take place in the Tourism Department, Panchayats, and Urban Development Departments,” said the CM.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also said that he is set to hand over 1,331 appointment letters in December.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Verification (Noun)
सत्यापन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Verification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Development (Adjective)
विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "West Bengal CM announces ₹2,000 monthly allowance for unemployed youths", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Bhorsha Karmasuchi replaces the Yuva Sathi scheme announced by Mamata Banerjee in February, ahead of the State Assembly Election.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'West Bengal CM announces ₹2,000 monthly allowanc' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'West Bengal CM announces ₹2,000 monthly allow' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'West Bengal CM announces ₹2,000 monthly allow' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Bhorsha Karmasuchi replaces the Yuva Sathi scheme announced by Mamata Banerjee in February, ahead of the State Assembly Election." (Hinglish Arth: भोरशा कर्मासुची ने राज्य विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले फरवरी में ममता बनर्जी द्वारा घोषित युवा साथी योजना की जगह ली है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "West Bengal CM announces ₹2,000 monthly allowance for unemployed youths"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. He also said that he is set to hand over 1,331 appointment letters in December.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "He also said that he is set to hand over 1,331 appointment letters in December." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि वह दिसंबर में 1,331 नियुक्ति पत्र सौंपने के लिए तैयार हैं।)

articles.title: Will use 'all available means' to counter U.S. blockade: Iran
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: War broke out between Iran and the United States on February 28 when U.S.-Israeli strikes killed the Islamic republic's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Iran said on Monday (November 23, 2026) it would use all means at its disposal to counter a U.S. naval blockade that was imposed in retaliation for its own push to block the Strait of Hormuz. "We will certainly not tolerate these actions and will use all available means to counter U.S. aggression," said Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei in a weekly press briefing. War broke out between Iran and the United States on February 28 when U.S.-Israeli strikes killed the Islamic republic's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The conflict has since expanded after Iran retaliated with missile and drone strikes across the region, and with militant groups it backs in Lebanon, Yemen and Iraq also entering the fray. The Strait of Hormuz has become the focus of the conflict, with Iran continuing in its efforts to blockade the waterway, vital to global energy supplies. In response, the U.S. imposed its own counterblockade of Iranian ports. It later announced a raft of economic sanctions, and launched a task force to disrupt land routes into Iran. "You should bear in mind that what the Americans have described as economic sanctions, an economic blockade and a naval blockade undoubtedly constitutes an act of military aggression against Iran," said Mr. Baqaei. "Under these circumstances, Iran is entitled, pursuant to Article 51 of the UN Charter, to use any means at its disposal to defend itself." Iranian forces have made multiple announcements in recent weeks of ships catching fire attempting to use routes that Tehran considers off-limits.

articles.summary: 1. Core Context & Background: War broke out between Iran and the United States on February 28 when U.S.-Israeli strikes killed the Islamic republic's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: War broke out between Iran and the United States on February 28 when U.S.-Israeli strikes killed the Islamic republic's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Iran said on Monday (November 23, 2026) it would use all means at its disposal to counter a U.S. naval blockade that was imposed in retaliation for its own push to block the Strait of Hormuz. "We will certainly not tolerate these actions and will use all available means to counter U.S. aggression," said Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei in a weekly press briefing. War broke out between Iran and the United States on February 28 when U.S.-Israeli strikes killed the Islamic republic's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The conflict has since expanded after Iran retaliated with missile and drone strikes across the region, and with militant groups it backs in Lebanon, Yemen and Iraq also entering the fray. The Strait of Hormuz has become the focus of the conflict, with Iran continuing in its efforts to blockade the waterway, vital to global energy supplies. In response, the U.S. imposed its own counterblockade of Iranian ports. It later announced a raft of economic sanctions, and launched a task force to disrupt land routes into Iran. "You should bear in mind that what the Americans have described as economic sanctions, an economic blockade and a naval blockade undoubtedly constitutes an act of military aggression against Iran," said Mr. Baqaei. "Under these circumstances, Iran is entitled, pursuant to Article 51 of the UN Charter, to use any means at its disposal to defend itself." Iranian forces have made multiple announcements in recent weeks of ships catching fire attempting to use routes that Tehran considers off-limits.
